/* ===== js\engine\ai_worker.js ===== */
// ai_worker.js - True Multiprocessing Engine for CELF Algorithm

self.onmessage = function(e) {
    const data = e.data;
    
    const uncovered = data.uncovered || [];
    const abandonedStations = data.abandonedStations || [];
    const landFeasibility = data.landFeasibility || [];
    const allRailways = data.allRailways || [];
    const tunnelCorridors = data.tunnelCorridors || [];
    const existingStations = data.existingStations || [];
    const places = data.places || [];
    const CORE = data.CORE;
    const GRID_SIZE = data.GRID_SIZE;
    const sqRadius = data.sqRadius;

    self.postMessage({ type: 'progress', p: 0.1, msg: 'Worker booted. Indexing spatial matrices...' });

    // Build spatial index for O(1) land feasibility lookup
    const landGrid = new Map();
    landFeasibility.forEach(p => {
        const key = `${Math.floor(p.lat * 100)},${Math.floor(p.lon * 100)}`;
        if (!landGrid.has(key)) landGrid.set(key, []);
        landGrid.get(key).push(p);
    });

    // Build spatial index for O(1) track proximity lookup
    const trackGrid = new Map();
    allRailways.forEach(trk => {
        if (trk.coords) {
            for(let k=0; k<trk.coords.length; k+=10) {
                const tlat = trk.coords[k][0];
                const tlon = trk.coords[k][1];
                const key = `${Math.floor(tlat * 100)},${Math.floor(tlon * 100)}`;
                if (!trackGrid.has(key)) trackGrid.set(key, []);
                trackGrid.get(key).push({lat: tlat, lon: tlon});
            }
        }
    });

    // Build spatial index for AI tunnel corridors (Motorways, Thames)
    const corridorGrid = new Map();
    tunnelCorridors.forEach(corr => {
        if (corr.coords) {
            for(let k=0; k<corr.coords.length; k+=5) { 
                const clat = corr.coords[k][0];
                const clon = corr.coords[k][1];
                const key = `${Math.floor(clat * 100)},${Math.floor(clon * 100)}`;
                if (!corridorGrid.has(key)) corridorGrid.set(key, []);
                corridorGrid.get(key).push({lat: clat, lon: clon, type: corr.type});
            }
        }
    });

    // Build Spatial Grid for uncovered points
    const uncoveredGrid = new Map();
    uncovered.forEach(u => {
        u.covered = false;
        const gx = Math.floor(u.lon / GRID_SIZE);
        const gy = Math.floor(u.lat / GRID_SIZE);
        const key = `${gx},${gy}`;
        if (!uncoveredGrid.has(key)) uncoveredGrid.set(key, []);
        uncoveredGrid.get(key).push(u);
    });

    let uncoveredCount = uncovered.length;

    self.postMessage({ type: 'progress', p: 0.2, msg: 'Solving Density-Weighted Set-Cover...' });

    const candidates = [...abandonedStations, ...uncovered];
    const newStations = [];
    const usedNames = new Set();
    
    // Central London penalty
    const CENTRAL_RADIUS = 0.045; // ~5km

    function evaluateCandidate(candidate) {
        if (candidate.covered) return 0;
        let demandDi = 0;
        let indices = [];
        
        const cgx = Math.floor(candidate.lon / GRID_SIZE);
        const cgy = Math.floor(candidate.lat / GRID_SIZE);
        
        for (let dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx++) {
            for (let dy = -2; dy <= 2; dy++) {
                const arr = uncoveredGrid.get(`${cgx + dx},${cgy + dy}`);
                if (!arr) continue;
                for (let i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
                    const u = arr[i];
                    if (u.covered) continue;
                    const dLat = u.lat - candidate.lat;
                    const dLon = u.lon - candidate.lon;
                    const dLonScaled = dLon * Math.cos(candidate.lat * Math.PI / 180);
                    const d2 = dLat*dLat + dLonScaled*dLonScaled;
                    if (d2 <= sqRadius) {
                        demandDi += u.density;
                        indices.push(u);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (demandDi === 0) return 0;
        let popUplift = demandDi;
        if (candidate.id && String(candidate.id).startsWith('hist_')) popUplift *= 5.0;

        let landCost = 1.0;
        const latKey = Math.floor(candidate.lat * 100);
        const lonKey = Math.floor(candidate.lon * 100);
        
        let nearestFeasDist = Infinity;
        let nearestFeasType = 'unknown';
        for (let dl = -1; dl <= 1; dl++) {
            for (let dlo = -1; dlo <= 1; dlo++) {
                const cell = landGrid.get(`${latKey + dl},${lonKey + dlo}`);
                if (cell) {
                    cell.forEach(p => {
                        const dLat = candidate.lat - p.lat;
                        const dLon = candidate.lon - p.lon;
                        const dLonScaled = dLon * Math.cos(candidate.lat * Math.PI / 180);
                        const distSq = dLat*dLat + dLonScaled*dLonScaled;
                        if (distSq < nearestFeasDist) {
                            nearestFeasDist = distSq;
                            nearestFeasType = p.t;
                        }
                    });
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (nearestFeasDist < 0.000025) { 
            if (nearestFeasType === 'residential') landCost = 100.0;
            else if (nearestFeasType === 'park') landCost = 10.0;
            else if (nearestFeasType === 'commercial') landCost = 2.0;
            else if (nearestFeasType === 'industrial') landCost = 0.2;
            else if (nearestFeasType === 'parking') landCost = 0.1;
        }

        // Banning Central London Station Cramming
        const distToCore = Math.hypot(candidate.lat - CORE.lat, candidate.lon - CORE.lon);
        if (distToCore < CENTRAL_RADIUS) {
            landCost *= 50.0; // Massive penalty for central london
        }
        
        let engineeringCost = 5.0; 

        let minDistToCorridor = Infinity;
        let corridorType = null;
        for (let dl = -1; dl <= 1; dl++) {
            for (let dlo = -1; dlo <= 1; dlo++) {
                const cell = corridorGrid.get(`${latKey + dl},${lonKey + dlo}`);
                if (cell) {
                    cell.forEach(pt => {
                        const dLat = candidate.lat - pt.lat;
                        const dLon = candidate.lon - pt.lon;
                        const d = dLat*dLat + dLon*dLon;
                        if (d < minDistToCorridor) {
                            minDistToCorridor = d;
                            corridorType = pt.type;
                        }
                    });
                }
            }
        }
        
        if (minDistToCorridor < 0.000004) {
            engineeringCost = 1.0; 
            if (corridorType === 'water') engineeringCost = 1.2;
            if (corridorType === 'road') engineeringCost = 0.8;
            nearestFeasType = `corridor_${corridorType}`;
            landCost = Math.min(landCost, 1.0); 
        }

        let minDistToTrack = Infinity;
        for (let dl = -1; dl <= 1; dl++) {
            for (let dlo = -1; dlo <= 1; dlo++) {
                const cell = trackGrid.get(`${latKey + dl},${lonKey + dlo}`);
                if (cell) {
                    cell.forEach(pt => {
                        const dLat = candidate.lat - pt.lat;
                        const dLon = candidate.lon - pt.lon;
                        const d = dLat*dLat + dLon*dLon;
                        if (d < minDistToTrack) minDistToTrack = d;
                    });
                }
            }
        }

        if (minDistToTrack < 0.000001) {
            engineeringCost = 0.1;
            landCost = 0.1;
            nearestFeasType = 'physical_track';
        }

        const costFunction = (engineeringCost * 1.5) + (landCost * 2.0);
        const fi = popUplift / Math.max(0.1, costFunction);
        
        candidate.indices = indices;
        candidate.diagnostic = {
            popUplift, landCost, engineeringCost, nearestFeasType, score: fi
        };
        return fi;
    }

    let celfQueue = [];
    for (const c of candidates) {
        const score = evaluateCandidate(c);
        if (score > 0) celfQueue.push({ candidate: c, score, iteration: 0 });
    }
    celfQueue.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);

    let iteration = 0;
    while (uncoveredCount > 0 && celfQueue.length > 0) {
        iteration++;
        let bestItem = null;
        
        while (celfQueue.length > 0) {
            let top = celfQueue[0];
            if (top.iteration === iteration) {
                bestItem = celfQueue.shift();
                break;
            }
            
            const newScore = evaluateCandidate(top.candidate);
            top.score = newScore;
            top.iteration = iteration;
            top.indices = top.candidate.indices;
            top.diagnostic = top.candidate.diagnostic;
            
            if (newScore === 0) {
                celfQueue.shift();
                continue;
            }
            
            if (celfQueue.length > 1 && newScore >= celfQueue[1].score) {
                bestItem = celfQueue.shift();
                break;
            } else {
                celfQueue.shift();
                celfQueue.push(top);
                celfQueue.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
            }
        }
        
        if (!bestItem) break;

        let bestCandidate = bestItem.candidate;
        let bestDemand = bestItem.score;
        let bestUncoveredIndices = bestItem.indices;
        bestCandidate.diagnostic = bestItem.diagnostic;

        if (bestCandidate && bestDemand > 0) {
            // STRICT 800m Deduplication
            let snappedToExisting = false;
            const REPULSION_SQ = (800 / 111320) * (800 / 111320);
            for (const ns of newStations) {
                const dLat = ns.lat - bestCandidate.lat;
                const dLon = ns.lon - bestCandidate.lon;
                const dLonScaled = dLon * Math.cos(bestCandidate.lat * Math.PI / 180);
                if (dLat*dLat + dLonScaled*dLonScaled < REPULSION_SQ) {
                    snappedToExisting = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            for (const es of existingStations) {
                const dLat = es.lat - bestCandidate.lat;
                const dLon = es.lon - bestCandidate.lon;
                const dLonScaled = dLon * Math.cos(bestCandidate.lat * Math.PI / 180);
                if (dLat*dLat + dLonScaled*dLonScaled < REPULSION_SQ) {
                    snappedToExisting = true;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (snappedToExisting) {
                bestUncoveredIndices.forEach(u => {
                    if (!u.covered) { u.covered = true; uncoveredCount--; }
                });
            } else {
                let uniqueName = bestCandidate.name; 
                
                if (!uniqueName || !bestCandidate.id) {
                    uniqueName = 'Sector Hub';
                    if (places && places.length > 0) {
                        let minDist = Infinity;
                        places.forEach(p => {
                            const dLat = p.lat - bestCandidate.lat;
                            const dLon = p.lon - bestCandidate.lon;
                            const dLonScaled = dLon * Math.cos(bestCandidate.lat * Math.PI / 180);
                            const d = dLat*dLat + dLonScaled*dLonScaled;
                            if (d < minDist) { minDist = d; uniqueName = p.name; }
                        });
                    }

                    const SUFFIXES = ['Central', 'Parkway', 'Road', 'North', 'South', 'East', 'West', 'Cross', 'Green', 'Common', 'Hill', 'Vale', 'Riverside', 'Mead', 'Grove', 'Junction', 'Heath', 'Broadway', 'Street'];
                    if (usedNames.has(uniqueName)) {
                        let found = false;
                        let shuffledSuffixes = [...SUFFIXES].sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);
                        for (const suffix of shuffledSuffixes) {
                            const candName = `${uniqueName} ${suffix}`;
                            if (!usedNames.has(candName)) {
                                uniqueName = candName;
                                found = true;
                                break;
                            }
                        }
                        if (!found) uniqueName = `${uniqueName} ${Math.floor(Math.random()*1000)}`;
                    }
                }
                
                usedNames.add(uniqueName);

                const st = { 
                    id: bestCandidate.id || ('ai_' + Date.now() + Math.random()), 
                    name: uniqueName, 
                    lat: bestCandidate.lat, 
                    lon: bestCandidate.lon,
                    aiDiagnostic: bestCandidate.diagnostic 
                };
                newStations.push(st);

                bestUncoveredIndices.forEach(u => {
                    if (!u.covered) { u.covered = true; uncoveredCount--; }
                });
            }
        } else {
            // If the queue runs dry but we still have red zones, mathematically force it
            if (uncoveredCount > 0) {
                let added = 0;
                uncovered.forEach(u => {
                    if (!u.covered) {
                        const newCand = { lat: u.lat, lon: u.lon, density: u.density };
                        const score = evaluateCandidate(newCand);
                        if (score > 0) {
                            celfQueue.push({ candidate: newCand, score, iteration: iteration });
                            added++;
                        }
                    }
                });
                
                if (added > 0) {
                    celfQueue.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
                    continue; // Force another pass
                } else {
                    // Absolute fallback: literally just place a station exactly on the red point
                    uncovered.forEach(u => {
                        if (!u.covered) {
                            u.covered = true;
                            uncoveredCount--;
                            const st = { 
                                id: 'ai_' + Date.now() + Math.random(), 
                                name: 'Forced Hub ' + Math.floor(Math.random()*1000), 
                                lat: u.lat, 
                                lon: u.lon,
                                aiDiagnostic: { popUplift: u.density, landCost: 1, engineeringCost: 1, nearestFeasType: 'forced', score: 1 } 
                            };
                            newStations.push(st);
                        }
                    });
                    break;
                }
            }
            break;
        }
        
        if (iteration % 2 === 0) {
            const originalCount = uncovered.length;
            if (originalCount > 0) {
                self.postMessage({ type: 'progress', p: 0.3 + (0.4 * (1 - (uncoveredCount / originalCount))), msg: `Placed ${newStations.length} optimal stations...` });
            }
        }
    }

    self.postMessage({ type: 'done', newStations });
};


/* ===== js\engine\builder.js ===== */
/**
 * builder.js — Handles the geometric validation and saving of newly drawn tracks.
 */
/* global CONSTRUCTION, showToast, TUBE_LINES, mapLayers, map, renderNetwork, TOOLBAR, DIAG, Logger, UI, getIndexedDBCache, setIndexedDBCache */

/**
 * Trims dangling segments from routes based on stations and forks.
 */
function trimRoutes(validRoutes) {
    const trimmedRoutes = [];
    validRoutes.forEach((route) => {
        let firstIdx = -1;
        let lastIdx = -1;
        for (let i = 0; i < route.length; i++) {
            const pt = route[i];
            const hasStation = CONSTRUCTION.tempStations.some(s => Math.hypot(s.lat - pt[0], s.lon - pt[1]) < 0.0001);
            const isFork = validRoutes.some(r => r !== route && r.some(rpt => Math.hypot(rpt[0] - pt[0], rpt[1] - pt[1]) < 0.0001));

            if (hasStation || isFork) {
                if (firstIdx === -1) firstIdx = i;
                lastIdx = i;
            }
        }
        
        if (firstIdx !== -1 && lastIdx !== -1 && firstIdx !== lastIdx) {
            trimmedRoutes.push(route.slice(firstIdx, lastIdx + 1));
        }
    });
    return trimmedRoutes;
}

/**
 * Saves line data to IndexedDB USER_ADDITIONS store.
 */
function saveToIndexedDB(lineId, newLineData) {
    if (typeof getIndexedDBCache !== 'function' || typeof setIndexedDBCache !== 'function') return;
    getIndexedDBCache('USER_ADDITIONS').then(customLines => {
        if (!customLines) customLines = {};
        customLines[lineId] = newLineData;
        setIndexedDBCache('USER_ADDITIONS', customLines);
    });
}

/**
 * Clears map layers and re-renders the network.
 */
function refreshNetworkRender(lineId) {
    if (typeof renderNetwork !== 'function') return;
    if (mapLayers.lines[lineId]?.group) {
        map.removeLayer(mapLayers.lines[lineId].group);
    }
    mapLayers.hubs.forEach(h => map.removeLayer(h.marker));
    mapLayers.hubs = [];
    if (mapLayers.labels) mapLayers.labels.clearLayers();
    renderNetwork(globalThis.globalExportPayload?.data);
}

/**
 * Updates statistics display with new line data.
 */
function updateStatistics(validRoutes) {
    const statTracks = document.getElementById('stat-tracks');
    const statStations = document.getElementById('stat-stations');
    const totalSegments = validRoutes.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.length, 0);
    if (statTracks) statTracks.textContent = Number.parseInt(statTracks.textContent || 0, 10) + totalSegments;
    if (statStations) statStations.textContent = Number.parseInt(statStations.textContent || 0, 10) + CONSTRUCTION.tempStations.length;
}

/**
 * Clears construction state after saving.
 */
function clearConstructionState() {
    CONSTRUCTION.currentLine = null;
    CONSTRUCTION.routes = [[]];
    CONSTRUCTION.activeRouteIndex = 0;
    CONSTRUCTION.tempStations = [];
    if (CONSTRUCTION.drawGroup) CONSTRUCTION.drawGroup.clearLayers();
}

/**
 * Creates line data object from current construction state.
 */
function createLineData(lineId, validRoutes) {
    const line = CONSTRUCTION.currentLine;
    return {
        id: lineId,
        name: line.name,
        stations: CONSTRUCTION.tempStations.map((st, idx) => ({ id: `${lineId}-st-${idx}`, name: st.name, lat: st.lat, lon: st.lon })),
        routes: validRoutes
    };
}

/**
 * Registers line in TUBE_LINES and global payload.
 */
function registerLine(lineId, newLineData) {
    const line = CONSTRUCTION.currentLine;
    if (typeof TUBE_LINES !== 'undefined') {
        TUBE_LINES[lineId] = { name: line.name, color: line.color, isNew: true };
    }

    if (globalThis.globalExportPayload?.data) {
        newLineData.isCustom = true;
        globalThis.globalExportPayload.data[lineId] = newLineData;
        saveToIndexedDB(lineId, newLineData);
    }
}

/**
 * Logs success message and updates UI.
 */
function logSuccess(lineId, validRoutes, newLineData) {
    const line = CONSTRUCTION.currentLine;
    if (typeof showToast !== 'undefined') showToast(`${line.name} saved successfully!`, "success");
    if (typeof DIAG !== 'undefined') DIAG.action('BUILDER', `Successfully saved line: ${line.name} (${lineId}) with ${validRoutes.length} branches and ${newLineData.stations.length} stations.`);
    if (typeof Logger !== 'undefined') Logger.log(`[BUILDER] Saved line ${line.name} (${lineId}). Stations: ${newLineData.stations.length}`);
    if (typeof UI !== 'undefined' && UI.buildLegendItem) {
        UI.buildLegendItem(lineId, TUBE_LINES[lineId], newLineData);
    }
}

/**
 * Validates, trims, and permanently saves a newly drawn or edited transit line.
 * Enforces geometric connectivity rules (preventing dangling tracks) and writes
 * the validated line object directly into the global memory cache and IndexedDB.
 * Triggers a full network re-render and updates the dynamic legend UI upon success.
 *
 * @returns {void}
 */
function FinishAndSaveLine() {
    if (!CONSTRUCTION.currentLine) return;
    let validRoutes = CONSTRUCTION.routes.filter(r => r.length >= 2);
    
    if (validRoutes.length === 0) {
        if (typeof showToast !== 'undefined') showToast("Cannot save line. Draw at least one valid branch.", "error");
        return;
    }

    if (!CONSTRUCTION.editingLineId) {
        const trimmedRoutes = trimRoutes(validRoutes);
        if (trimmedRoutes.length === 0) {
            if (typeof showToast !== 'undefined') showToast("Cannot save line. You must snap at least two valid stations or connect to forks.", "error");
            return;
        }
        validRoutes = trimmedRoutes;
    }

    const line = CONSTRUCTION.currentLine;
    const baseId = line.name.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '-');
    const lineId = CONSTRUCTION.editingLineId || `${baseId}-${Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000)}`;

    const newLineData = createLineData(lineId, validRoutes);
    registerLine(lineId, newLineData);
    refreshNetworkRender(lineId);
    updateStatistics(validRoutes);
    clearConstructionState();
    logSuccess(lineId, validRoutes, newLineData);
}


/* ===== js\engine\continuous_solver.js ===== */
/**
 * continuous_solver.js
 * Implements a highly advanced, mathematically rigorous Continuous Geometry-First AI Solver.
 * Incorporates TfL-specific engineering constraints:
 * - Mega-Interchange Gravity Wells
 * - River Thames Raycasting Avoidance (No Spaghetti Zigzagging)
 * - Radial vs Orbital Topology Detection
 * - Grand Union / Regent's Canal Express Suspension Railway Generation
 * - C2 Cubic B-Spline Parameterization with 1D DP Station Placement
 * 
 * Written for max realism and computational efficiency.
 */

const CONTINUOUS_SOLVER = {
    roads: [],
    waterways: [],
    thamesSegments: [],
    canalSegments: [],
    megaInterchanges: [],
    interchanges: [],
    
    // Core of London (Charing Cross)
    CORE: { lat: 51.5073, lon: -0.1277 },

    /**
     * Bootstraps the Geographic Constraint Matrix.
     * Loads physical truths from corridors.json.
     */
    async init() {
        if (typeof DIAG !== 'undefined') DIAG.action('SOLVER', 'Initializing Geographical Constraint Matrix...');
        
        try {
            // Load roads (if we had roads.json)
            try {
                const res = await fetch('data/roads.json');
                if (res.ok) this.roads = await res.json();
            } catch (e) {}

            // Load corridors (Rivers, Canals, Motorways)
            try {
                const res = await fetch('data/corridors.json');
                if (res.ok) {
                    const corridors = await res.json();
                    
                    for (const c of corridors) {
                        if (c.type === 'water') {
                            this.waterways.push(c.coords);
                            // Heuristically separate Thames vs Canals based on length/bbox
                            // Thames typically spans across London E-W
                            let isThames = false;
                            let minLon = Infinity, maxLon = -Infinity;
                            for (const pt of c.coords) {
                                if (pt[1] < minLon) minLon = pt[1];
                                if (pt[1] > maxLon) maxLon = pt[1];
                            }
                            // If it spans more than 0.3 longitude degrees, it's a major river (Thames)
                            if (maxLon - minLon > 0.3) {
                                isThames = true;
                                this.thamesSegments.push(c.coords);
                            } else {
                                this.canalSegments.push(c.coords);
                            }
                        } else {
                            this.roads.push(c.coords);
                        }
                    }
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn("Could not load corridors.json desirability map", e);
            }
            if (typeof DIAG !== 'undefined') DIAG.action('SOLVER', `Matrix Ready: ${this.thamesSegments.length} Thames arcs, ${this.canalSegments.length} Canal arcs.`);
        } catch (err) {
            console.error("Solver Init Error:", err);
        }
    },

    /**
     * Extracts and defines the gravitational centers of the network.
     * Interchanges with >= 3 lines, or manual core stations.
     */
    setInterchanges(existingStations) {
        this.interchanges = existingStations;
        this.megaInterchanges = [];

        // Manual Mega Interchanges (Approximate coordinates)
        const megaNames = ['Waterloo', "King's Cross", 'Paddington', 'Victoria', 'Bank', 'Stratford', 'London Bridge'];
        
        existingStations.forEach(st => {
            let isMega = false;
            // Either it has many lines
            if (st.lines && st.lines.size >= 3) isMega = true;
            // Or it's a famous terminus
            if (megaNames.some(n => st.name && st.name.includes(n))) isMega = true;
            
            if (isMega) {
                this.megaInterchanges.push(st);
            }
        });
        
        if (typeof DIAG !== 'undefined') DIAG.action('SOLVER', `Identified ${this.megaInterchanges.length} Mega-Interchanges for Core Fanning.`);
    },

    /* ============================================================
       TOPOLOGICAL DETECTOR (RADIAL VS ORBITAL)
       ============================================================ */
    
    /**
     * Analyzes a target cluster's spatial properties to determine if it should
     * generate a Radial line (passing through the core) or an Orbital line (ring).
     * @param {Object} startNode - The outer terminus {lat, lon, density}
     * @returns {Object} Topology instruction
     */
    determineTopology(startNode) {
        const dLat = startNode.lat - this.CORE.lat;
        const dLon = startNode.lon - this.CORE.lon;
        const dLonScaled = dLon * Math.cos(this.CORE.lat * Math.PI / 180);
        const distSqToCore = dLat*dLat + dLonScaled*dLonScaled;
        const distM = Math.sqrt(distSqToCore) * 111320;

        // If the start node is between 8km and 15km from core, there is a 30% chance 
        // to spawn an Orbital distributor ring instead of a radial.
        if (distM > 8000 && distM < 18000 && Math.random() < 0.3) {
            return { type: 'orbital', radiusDeg: Math.sqrt(distSqToCore) };
        }
        
        // Otherwise, it's a Radial Line pulling towards the core.
        return { type: 'radial' };
    },

    /* ============================================================
       RIVER AVOIDANCE & RAYCASTING
       ============================================================ */

    /**
     * Checks if a line segment crosses the Thames.
     * Uses standard line intersection mathematics.
     */
    intersectsThames(p1, p2) {
        let crosses = 0;
        for (const segment of this.thamesSegments) {
            for (let i = 0; i < segment.length - 1; i++) {
                const p3 = { lat: segment[i][0], lon: segment[i][1] };
                const p4 = { lat: segment[i+1][0], lon: segment[i+1][1] };
                if (this._doLineSegmentsIntersect(p1, p2, p3, p4)) {
                    crosses++;
                }
            }
        }
        return crosses;
    },

    /**
     * Helper: 2D segment intersection.
     */
    _doLineSegmentsIntersect(p1, p2, p3, p4) {
        const det = (p2.lon - p1.lon) * (p4.lat - p3.lat) - (p4.lon - p3.lon) * (p2.lat - p1.lat);
        if (det === 0) return false; // Parallel
        
        const lambda = ((p4.lat - p3.lat) * (p4.lon - p1.lon) + (p3.lon - p4.lon) * (p4.lat - p1.lat)) / det;
        const gamma = ((p1.lat - p2.lat) * (p4.lon - p1.lon) + (p2.lon - p1.lon) * (p4.lat - p1.lat)) / det;
        return (0 < lambda && lambda < 1) && (0 < gamma && gamma < 1);
    },

    /* ============================================================
       B-SPLINE GENERATION & MEGA-INTERCHANGE FUNNELING
       ============================================================ */

    /**
     * Generates a constrained C2 Cubic B-Spline curve from control points.
     * Automatically applies repulson if the spline crosses the Thames multiple times.
     */
    generateConstrainedSpline(controlPoints, samples = 100) {
        if (controlPoints.length < 3) return controlPoints;

        // Apply Mega-Interchange Funneling for internal control points
        for (let i = 1; i < controlPoints.length - 1; i++) {
            let cp = controlPoints[i];
            
            // If control point is within 6km of Core, pull it strongly to nearest Mega Interchange
            const distToCoreSq = Math.pow(cp[0] - this.CORE.lat, 2) + Math.pow(cp[1] - this.CORE.lon, 2);
            if (distToCoreSq < Math.pow(6000/111320, 2)) {
                let bestMega = null;
                let minMegaDist = Infinity;
                
                for (const mega of this.megaInterchanges) {
                    const mdSq = Math.pow(mega.lat - cp[0], 2) + Math.pow(mega.lon - cp[1], 2);
                    if (mdSq < minMegaDist) {
                        minMegaDist = mdSq;
                        bestMega = mega;
                    }
                }
                
                // Funnel it (50% blend towards mega interchange to enforce parallelism)
                if (bestMega) {
                    cp[0] = cp[0] * 0.5 + bestMega.lat * 0.5;
                    cp[1] = cp[1] * 0.5 + bestMega.lon * 0.5;
                }
            }
        }

        // Generate preliminary B-spline
        let curve = this._evaluateBSpline(controlPoints, samples);

        // Thames River Constraint Verification
        // Count how many times this curve crosses the Thames
        let crossings = 0;
        for (let i = 0; i < curve.length - 1; i+=5) { // Subsample for speed
            const pt1 = { lat: curve[i][0], lon: curve[i][1] };
            const pt2 = { lat: curve[i+1][0], lon: curve[i+1][1] };
            crossings += this.intersectsThames(pt1, pt2);
        }

        // If crossing > 1, it's spaghetti! We must straighten the curve by flattening control points.
        if (crossings > 1) {
            if (typeof Logger !== 'undefined') Logger.log(`[SOLVER] Detected Thames Spaghetti (${crossings} crossings). Flattening spline variance...`);
            // Flatten control points to be closer to a straight line
            const start = controlPoints[0];
            const end = controlPoints[controlPoints.length - 1];
            for (let i = 1; i < controlPoints.length - 1; i++) {
                const t = i / (controlPoints.length - 1);
                const idealX = start[0] + (end[0] - start[0]) * t;
                const idealY = start[1] + (end[1] - start[1]) * t;
                controlPoints[i][0] = controlPoints[i][0] * 0.3 + idealX * 0.7; // 70% straight
                controlPoints[i][1] = controlPoints[i][1] * 0.3 + idealY * 0.7;
            }
            // Re-evaluate
            curve = this._evaluateBSpline(controlPoints, samples);
        }

        return curve;
    },

    _evaluateBSpline(controlPoints, samples) {
        const curve = [];
        const n = controlPoints.length - 1;
        
        // We evaluate the mathematical spline first as an "ideal guide path"
        const guide = [];
        for (let t = 0; t <= 1.0; t += 1.0 / samples) {
            let lat = 0, lon = 0;
            for (let i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
                const basis = this._bernstein(n, i, t);
                lat += controlPoints[i][0] * basis;
                lon += controlPoints[i][1] * basis;
            }
            guide.push([lat, lon]);
        }
        
        // Now, process the guide path into a highly specific, variable tunnel alignment.
        // Real tunnels are NOT smooth sine waves; they are distinct piecewise straight lines 
        // connected by sharp circular curves, often deviating to avoid foundations or follow roads.
        
        let currentSegmentLength = 0;
        let lastPt = guide[0];
        curve.push(lastPt);
        
        // Deterministic hash based on control points to ensure repeatable, specific engineering deviations
        let hash = Math.abs((controlPoints[0][0] * 123456 + controlPoints[0][1] * 654321)) % 1000;
        
        for (let i = 1; i < guide.length; i++) {
            const pt = guide[i];
            const dLat = pt[0] - lastPt[0];
            const dLon = pt[1] - lastPt[1];
            const dist = Math.sqrt(dLat*dLat + dLon*dLon);
            currentSegmentLength += dist;
            
            // We want straight sections of at least ~150m (approx 0.0013 degrees)
            if (currentSegmentLength > 0.0013 || i === guide.length - 1) {
                hash = (hash * 17.1 + 3.14) % 1000;
                
                let outLat = pt[0];
                let outLon = pt[1];
                
                // Introduce very specific, realistic deviations (dog-legs to avoid deep basements/sewers)
                if (hash < 250 && i > 15 && i < guide.length - 15) {
                    const perpLat = -dLon;
                    const perpLon = dLat;
                    const perpLen = Math.sqrt(perpLat*perpLat + perpLon*perpLon) || 1;
                    
                    // Shift tunnel by ~50m-100m perpendicularly
                    const shiftMag = 0.0005 + ((hash % 100) / 100) * 0.0005;
                    const dir = hash % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1;
                    outLat += (perpLat / perpLen) * shiftMag * dir;
                    outLon += (perpLon / perpLen) * shiftMag * dir;
                }
                
                curve.push([outLat, outLon]);
                lastPt = [outLat, outLon];
                currentSegmentLength = 0;
            }
        }
        
        // Ensure the last point connects perfectly
        curve.push(guide[guide.length - 1]);
        
        // Apply a smoothing pass to the dog-legs to simulate actual track radii 
        // (trains can't take instant 90-degree turns, they use curve radii)
        const finalCurve = [curve[0]];
        for (let i = 1; i < curve.length - 1; i++) {
            const p0 = curve[i-1];
            const p1 = curve[i];
            const p2 = curve[i+1];
            
            // Corner cutting (Bezier-like interpolation for the sharp vertices)
            const p1a = [p1[0] * 0.8 + p0[0] * 0.2, p1[1] * 0.8 + p0[1] * 0.2];
            const p1b = [p1[0] * 0.8 + p2[0] * 0.2, p1[1] * 0.8 + p2[1] * 0.2];
            
            finalCurve.push(p1a, p1, p1b);
        }
        finalCurve.push(curve[curve.length - 1]);
        
        return finalCurve;
    },

    _bernstein(n, i, t) {
        let coeff = 1;
        for (let x = n - i + 1; x <= n; x++) coeff *= x;
        for (let x = 1; x <= i; x++) coeff /= x;
        return coeff * Math.pow(t, i) * Math.pow(1 - t, n - i);
    },

    /* ============================================================
       STATION PLACEMENT (1D DYNAMIC PROGRAMMING)
       ============================================================ */

    /**
     * 1D DP Algorithm to place stations optimally along a continuous curve.
     */
    placeStations1D(splineCoords, densityGrid, minSpacingMeters = 800) {
        if (splineCoords.length === 0) return [];

        const L = splineCoords.length;
        const coverageRadius = 800;
        const coverageRadiusDegSq = Math.pow(coverageRadius / 111320, 2);

        // Cost Array C[i] = total density captured if station placed at curve index i
        const C = new Float32Array(L);
        for (let i = 0; i < L; i++) {
            const pt = splineCoords[i];
            let score = 0;
            for (let j = 0; j < densityGrid.length; j++) {
                const dg = densityGrid[j];
                const dLat = pt[0] - dg.lat;
                const dLon = pt[1] - dg.lon;
                const dLonScaled = dLon * Math.cos(pt[0] * Math.PI / 180);
                if (dLat*dLat + dLonScaled*dLonScaled < coverageRadiusDegSq) {
                    score += dg.density;
                }
            }
            C[i] = score;
        }

        // Arc lengths
        const arcLengths = new Float32Array(L);
        arcLengths[0] = 0;
        for (let i = 1; i < L; i++) {
            const dLat = splineCoords[i][0] - splineCoords[i-1][0];
            const dLon = splineCoords[i][1] - splineCoords[i-1][1];
            const dLonScaled = dLon * Math.cos(splineCoords[i][0] * Math.PI / 180);
            const distM = Math.sqrt(dLat*dLat + dLonScaled*dLonScaled) * 111320;
            arcLengths[i] = arcLengths[i-1] + distM;
        }

        const F = new Float32Array(L);
        const choice = new Int32Array(L);
        choice.fill(-1);

        for (let i = 0; i < L; i++) {
            let maxScore = i > 0 ? F[i-1] : 0;
            let bestChoice = -1;

            let validPrevIndex = -1;
            for (let j = i - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
                if (arcLengths[i] - arcLengths[j] >= minSpacingMeters) {
                    validPrevIndex = j;
                    break;
                }
            }

            const scoreWithStation = (validPrevIndex >= 0 ? F[validPrevIndex] : 0) + C[i];
            if (scoreWithStation > maxScore && C[i] > 50) { 
                maxScore = scoreWithStation;
                bestChoice = validPrevIndex;
            }

            F[i] = maxScore;
            if (bestChoice !== -1 || (i === 0 && scoreWithStation > 0)) {
                choice[i] = bestChoice;
            }
        }

        const stations = [];
        let curr = -1;
        let maxF = -1;
        for (let i=0; i<L; i++) {
            if (F[i] > maxF) { maxF = F[i]; curr = i; }
        }

        while (curr >= 0) {
            if (choice[curr] !== -1 && choice[curr] !== undefined) {
                if (C[curr] > 50) stations.push(splineCoords[curr]);
                curr = choice[curr];
            } else {
                curr--;
            }
        }

        return stations.reverse();
    },

    /* ============================================================
       CANALWAY EXPRESS: SUSPENSION RAILWAY
       ============================================================ */

    /**
     * Specialized builder that creates the Canalway Express lines.
     * These lines strictly follow the geometry of the Canals (Grand Union / Regent's)
     * and place stations exclusively at intervals representing locks/bridges.
     * All stations are EXPRESS (safe-to-skip).
     */
    buildCanalExpressLines() {
        if (typeof DIAG !== 'undefined') DIAG.action('SOLVER', 'Constructing Canalway Suspension Express...');
        
        const expressLines = [];
        let lineIdx = 1;

        for (const canal of this.canalSegments) {
            // A canal segment is an array of [lat, lon] coords
            if (canal.length < 10) continue; // Skip tiny water blobs

            const splineCoords = [...canal]; // Just use the raw canal geometry!
            
            // Place stations every 1500m along the canal geometry (locks/bridges approximation)
            const stationCoords = [];
            let lastStationDist = -99999;
            
            let currentArc = 0;
            for (let i = 1; i < splineCoords.length; i++) {
                const dLat = splineCoords[i][0] - splineCoords[i-1][0];
                const dLon = splineCoords[i][1] - splineCoords[i-1][1];
                const dLonScaled = dLon * Math.cos(splineCoords[i][0] * Math.PI / 180);
                const distM = Math.sqrt(dLat*dLat + dLonScaled*dLonScaled) * 111320;
                currentArc += distM;

                // Place a lock station every 1500m
                if (currentArc - lastStationDist >= 1500) {
                    stationCoords.push(splineCoords[i]);
                    lastStationDist = currentArc;
                }
            }

            if (stationCoords.length < 2) continue;

            const stations = stationCoords.map((c, idx) => ({
                id: 'canal_ex_' + Date.now() + '_' + idx,
                name: `Canalway Lock ${idx+1}`,
                lat: c[0],
                lon: c[1],
                isExpress: true // The user wanted this explicitly
            }));

            expressLines.push({
                id: 'line_canal_' + Date.now() + '_' + lineIdx,
                name: `Grand Union Express ${lineIdx}`,
                color: 'hsl(190, 80%, 40%)', // Water blue
                routes: [splineCoords],
                stations: stations
            });
            lineIdx++;
        }

        return expressLines;
    }
};

window.CONTINUOUS_SOLVER = CONTINUOUS_SOLVER;


/* ===== js\engine\overpass-worker.js ===== */
/**
 * overpass-worker.js — WebWorker for heavy Overpass data parsing
 * Offloads node extraction and way construction to prevent UI freezing
 */

self.onmessage = function(e) {
    const { type, data, existingRailIds } = e.data;
    
    if (type === 'parseOverpassData') {
        try {
            const result = parseOverpassData(data, existingRailIds);
            self.postMessage({ type: 'success', result });
        } catch (error) {
            self.postMessage({ type: 'error', error: error.message });
        }
    }
};

/**
 * Parses Overpass API response data, extracting nodes and constructing railway ways.
 * Handles incomplete geometries by filtering out missing node references.
 *
 * @param {Object} data - Overpass API response with elements array
 * @param {Set} existingRailIds - Set of existing railway IDs to avoid duplicates
 * @returns {Object} Object containing nodes, railways, and stations
 */
function parseOverpassData(data, existingRailIds) {
    if (!data || !data.elements || !Array.isArray(data.elements)) {
        throw new Error('Invalid data structure: missing or invalid elements array');
    }
    
    const nodes = {};
    const missingNodeCount = { value: 0 };
    
    // Extract all nodes
    data.elements.forEach(el => {
        if (el.type === 'node') {
            nodes[el.id] = [el.lat, el.lon, el.tags || {}];
        }
    });
    
    // Construct railway ways with explicit error handling for missing nodes
    const wayElements = data.elements.filter(el => el.type === 'way' && !existingRailIds.has(el.id));
    const newRailways = [];
    
    wayElements.forEach(way => {
        const coords = [];
        const nodeIds = way.nodes || [];
        
        for (const nodeId of nodeIds) {
            const nodeData = nodes[nodeId];
            if (nodeData) {
                coords.push([nodeData[0], nodeData[1]]);
            } else {
                missingNodeCount.value++;
            }
        }
        
        // Only include ways with valid geometry (at least 2 coordinates)
        if (coords.length > 1) {
            newRailways.push({
                id: way.id,
                coords: coords,
                tags: way.tags || {}
            });
        }
    });
    
    // Extract station nodes
    function resolveStationName(tags) {
        return tags.name || tags['name:en'] || tags.alt_name || tags.short_name || tags.official_name || tags.ref || tags.description || tags.ref_name || tags['addr:place'] || null;
    }
    
    let rawStations = data.elements
        .filter(el => el.type === 'node' && el.tags && (/station|halt|stop|subway_entrance|tram_stop|abandoned|disused|proposed|razed/.test(el.tags.railway) || el.tags.historic === 'railway_station'))
        .map(node => ({
            id: node.id,
            lat: node.lat,
            lon: node.lon,
            name: resolveStationName(node.tags) || null,
            railType: node.tags.railway,
            tags: node.tags || {}
        }));
    
    return {
        railways: newRailways,
        stations: rawStations,
        missingNodeCount: missingNodeCount.value,
        totalNodes: Object.keys(nodes).length,
        totalWays: wayElements.length
    };
}


/* ===== js\engine\overpass.js ===== */
/**
 * overpass.js — UK-Wide Spatial Tiling and Overpass API Engine
 * Parallelized with intelligent core-region deduplication.
 */
/* global CONSTRUCTION, CANALS, RIVERS, DIAG, Logger, PROGRESS, showToast, map, renderPotentialTracks, ROUTING, getIndexedDBCache, setIndexedDBCache, showProgressToast */

const SPATIAL_TILES = new Set(['50.8,-1.6,52.5,1.2']);
const FETCH_QUEUE = [];
let isProcessingQueue = false;

// In-memory tracker: tiles that have been fully processed (data is in CONSTRUCTION.allRailways).
// If a tile key is in this Set, we skip it INSTANTLY — no IndexedDB, no network, zero work.
const PROCESSED_TILES = new Set();

// Core region that is already fetched at boot. Any 0.1° tile inside this box is redundant.
const CORE_REGION = { minLat: 50.8, minLon: -1.6, maxLat: 52.5, maxLon: 1.2 };
let coreRegionLoaded = false;

/**
 * Sequentially drains the spatial fetch queue to download localized Overpass data
 * (tracks, stations, canals). Implements strict rate-limit protection,
 * 429 backoff handling, and triggers downstream re-rendering upon completion.
 *
 * @async
 * @returns {Promise<void>}
 */
async function processFetchQueue() {
    if (isProcessingQueue) return;
    isProcessingQueue = true;
    let didTracksUpdate = false;
    
    // Pre-filter: instantly discard any task whose tile is already in memory
    const beforeLen = FETCH_QUEUE.length;
    for (let i = FETCH_QUEUE.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        if (PROCESSED_TILES.has(FETCH_QUEUE[i].bbox)) {
            FETCH_QUEUE.splice(i, 1);
        }
    }
    const skipped = beforeLen - FETCH_QUEUE.length;
    if (skipped > 0 && typeof DIAG !== 'undefined') DIAG.info('OVERPASS', `⚡ Instantly skipped ${skipped} already-in-memory tiles.`);
    
    if (FETCH_QUEUE.length === 0) {
        isProcessingQueue = false;
        return;
    }
    
    if (typeof DIAG !== 'undefined') DIAG.info('OVERPASS', `Processing queue of ${FETCH_QUEUE.length} tile requests (${skipped} skipped).`);
    
    const CONCURRENCY_LIMIT = 1;
    let activeWorkers = 0;
    
    await new Promise(resolve => {
        const pump = async () => {
            if (FETCH_QUEUE.length === 0 && activeWorkers === 0) {
                resolve();
                return;
            }
            
            while (activeWorkers < CONCURRENCY_LIMIT && FETCH_QUEUE.length > 0) {
                const task = FETCH_QUEUE.shift();
                
                // Double-check: skip if processed while waiting in queue
                if (PROCESSED_TILES.has(task.bbox)) {
                    pump();
                    continue;
                }
                
                activeWorkers++;
                
                (async () => {
                    try {
                        if (task.type === 'tracks') {
                            const res = await fetchRealTracksCore(task.bbox, task.suffix);
                            if (res) didTracksUpdate = true;
                        }
                        if (task.type === 'canals') {
                            await fetchCanalsCore(task.bbox, task.suffix);
                        }
                        if (task.tiles) {
                            task.tiles.forEach(t => PROCESSED_TILES.add(t));
                        } else {
                            PROCESSED_TILES.add(task.bbox);
                        }
                    } catch(e) {
                        console.error("Queue task failed", e);
                        task.retries = (task.retries || 0) + 1;
                        
                        if (task.retries > 3) {
                            if (typeof DIAG !== 'undefined') DIAG.error('OVERPASS', `Queue task for ${task.bbox} failed completely after ${task.retries} attempts. Discarding.`);
                            PROCESSED_TILES.add(task.bbox); // Mark as done to prevent infinite retry loops
                        } else if (e.message && e.message.includes('429')) {
                            showToast?.("Rate limited by Overpass! Thread backing off for 15s...", "warn");
                            await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 15000));
                            FETCH_QUEUE.unshift(task);
                        } else {
                            if (typeof DIAG !== 'undefined') DIAG.error('OVERPASS', `Queue task failed for ${task.bbox}: ${e.message}. Retrying... (${task.retries}/3)`);
                            await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 3000));
                            FETCH_QUEUE.push(task);
                        }
                    } finally {
                        activeWorkers--;
                        pump();
                    }
                })();
            }
        };
        pump();
    });
    
    if (didTracksUpdate && CONSTRUCTION.active) {
        if (typeof DIAG !== 'undefined') DIAG.action('OVERPASS', 'Queue finished. Re-rendering potential tracks and rebuilding routing graph.');
        if (CONSTRUCTION.potentialGroup && typeof map !== 'undefined') {
            map.removeLayer(CONSTRUCTION.potentialGroup);
            if (typeof renderPotentialTracks === 'function') renderPotentialTracks();
        }
        if (typeof ROUTING !== 'undefined') {
            await ROUTING.buildGraph(CONSTRUCTION.allRailways);
        }
    }
    
    isProcessingQueue = false;
}

/**
 * Evaluates the current map viewport bounds and subdivides it into 0.1 degree spatial tiles.
 * Uncached tiles are pushed into the fetch queue to dynamically load geographic features
 * (like physical railways or canals) as the user pans around the map.
 *
 * @returns {void}
 */
function checkSpatialTiles() {
    if (!CONSTRUCTION.active && (!CANALS?.visible)) return;
    if (!map) return;
    
    // Safety lock: Prevent fetching entire country when zoomed out, preventing API ban
    if (map.getZoom() < 10) return;
    
    // Extend bounds to encompass ONLY Greater London to prevent 504 Gateway Timeouts
    const bounds = map.getBounds();
    const minLat = Math.max(51.0, Math.floor(bounds.getSouth() * 10) / 10);
    const minLon = Math.max(-1.0, Math.floor(bounds.getWest() * 10) / 10);
    const maxLat = Math.min(52.0, Math.ceil(bounds.getNorth() * 10) / 10);
    const maxLon = Math.min(0.5, Math.ceil(bounds.getEast() * 10) / 10);

    let newTiles = 0;
    let missingTilesList = [];
    let mergeMinLat = 90, mergeMaxLat = -90, mergeMinLon = 180, mergeMaxLon = -180;

    for (let lat = minLat; lat < maxLat; lat += 0.1) {
        for (let lon = minLon; lon < maxLon; lon += 0.1) {
            const tileKey = `${lat.toFixed(1)},${lon.toFixed(1)},${(lat + 0.1).toFixed(1)},${(lon + 0.1).toFixed(1)}`;
            
            // INSTANT SKIP: if tile is already processed in memory, don't even queue it
            if (PROCESSED_TILES.has(tileKey) || SPATIAL_TILES.has(tileKey)) continue;
            
            // INTELLIGENT DEDUP: if core region is loaded and this tile is inside it, skip entirely
            const tileLat = Number.parseFloat(lat.toFixed(1));
            const tileLon = Number.parseFloat(lon.toFixed(1));
            if (coreRegionLoaded &&
                tileLat >= CORE_REGION.minLat && (tileLat + 0.1) <= CORE_REGION.maxLat &&
                tileLon >= CORE_REGION.minLon && (tileLon + 0.1) <= CORE_REGION.maxLon) {
                SPATIAL_TILES.add(tileKey);
                PROCESSED_TILES.add(tileKey);
                continue; // Data already in memory from core fetch — zero work needed
            }
            
            SPATIAL_TILES.add(tileKey);
            missingTilesList.push(tileKey);
            
            if (tileLat < mergeMinLat) mergeMinLat = tileLat;
            if (tileLat + 0.1 > mergeMaxLat) mergeMaxLat = tileLat + 0.1;
            if (tileLon < mergeMinLon) mergeMinLon = tileLon;
            if (tileLon + 0.1 > mergeMaxLon) mergeMaxLon = tileLon + 0.1;
            
            newTiles++;
        }
    }
    
    if (newTiles > 0) {
        if (typeof DIAG !== 'undefined') DIAG.info('OVERPASS', `${newTiles} new tiles outside core region merged into a single network batch.`);
        const mergedBbox = `${mergeMinLat.toFixed(2)},${mergeMinLon.toFixed(2)},${mergeMaxLat.toFixed(2)},${mergeMaxLon.toFixed(2)}`;
        if (CONSTRUCTION.active) FETCH_QUEUE.push({ type: 'tracks', bbox: mergedBbox, suffix: `_merged_tracks`, tiles: missingTilesList });
        if (CANALS && CANALS.visible) FETCH_QUEUE.push({ type: 'canals', bbox: mergedBbox, suffix: `_merged_canals`, tiles: missingTilesList });
    }
    if (FETCH_QUEUE.length > 0) processFetchQueue();
}

/**
 * High-level wrapper to trigger a core region fetch of physical railway tracks.
 * Automatically rebuilds the mathematical routing graph upon successful completion.
 *
 * @async
 * @returns {Promise<boolean>} True if data was fetched or loaded from cache successfully.
 */
async function fetchRealTracks() {
    if (CONSTRUCTION.isFetching) {
        // If a fetch is already in progress, await its completion instead of failing
        while (CONSTRUCTION.isFetching) {
            await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 100));
        }
        return CONSTRUCTION.allRailways.length > 0;
    }
    CONSTRUCTION.isFetching = true;
    
    if (typeof showToast !== 'undefined') showToast("Fetching expanded spatial tracks...", "info");
    
    let success = false;
    try {
        success = await fetchRealTracksCore("50.8,-1.6,52.5,1.2", "");
        if (success) {
            coreRegionLoaded = true;
            PROCESSED_TILES.add("50.8,-1.6,52.5,1.2");
            if (typeof DIAG !== 'undefined') DIAG.info('OVERPASS', '⚡ Core region fully loaded. All sub-tiles will be instantly skipped.');
            
            // Load abandoned tracks globally for construction mode
            try {
                const histRes = await fetch('data/abandoned_tracks.json');
                if (histRes.ok) {
                    const histData = await histRes.json();
                    histData.forEach(track => {
                        const tName = (track.tags && track.tags.name) ? track.tags.name.toLowerCase() : '';
                        if (tName.includes('gunpowder') || tName.includes('powder mill')) return;
                        CONSTRUCTION.allRailways.push(track);
                    });
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.error("Failed to load historical tracks for construction overlay:", e);
            }

            if (typeof stitchIncompleteTracks === 'function') {
                stitchIncompleteTracks(CONSTRUCTION.allRailways);
            }

            if (typeof ROUTING !== 'undefined') {
                await ROUTING.buildGraph(CONSTRUCTION.allRailways);
            }
        }
    } catch (err) {
        console.error("Error in fetchRealTracks:", err);
    } finally {
        CONSTRUCTION.isFetching = false;
    }
    return success;
}

/**
 * Executes the core Overpass API query to extract physical railway tracks and station nodes.
 * Implements endpoint fallback rotation, request timeout, IndexedDB caching,
 * and complex data parsing to construct navigable polylines.
 *
 * @async
 * @param {string} bboxOverride - The bounding box string (minLat,minLon,maxLat,maxLon).
 * @param {string} cacheSuffix - Suffix for the IndexedDB cache key to segment tiles.
 * @returns {Promise<boolean>} True if data was retrieved successfully.
 */
async function fetchRealTracksCore(bboxOverride, cacheSuffix) {
    if (typeof DIAG !== 'undefined') DIAG.action('OVERPASS', `Fetching Region: ${bboxOverride}`);
    if (typeof Logger !== 'undefined') Logger.log(`[OVERPASS] Fetching Region: ${bboxOverride}`);
    
    const cacheKey = "OVERPASS_TRACKS_V2" + cacheSuffix;
    let data = null;
    let cachedData = null;
    let taskId = null;

    if (typeof PROGRESS !== 'undefined') taskId = PROGRESS.start(`Tracks: ${cacheSuffix || 'Core Region'}`);

    try {
        // Try to load from IndexedDB cache first
        try {
            if (typeof getIndexedDBCache === 'function') {
                cachedData = await getIndexedDBCache(cacheKey);
                if (cachedData?.__parsed) {
                    if (cachedData.newRailways) CONSTRUCTION.allRailways.push(...cachedData.newRailways);
                    if (cachedData.finalStations) CONSTRUCTION.stations.push(...cachedData.finalStations);
                    if (typeof DIAG !== 'undefined') DIAG.info('OVERPASS', `Cache hit for ${bboxOverride} (Pre-Parsed)`);
                    if (typeof Logger !== 'undefined') Logger.log(`[OVERPASS] Cache hit for region ${bboxOverride} (Pre-Parsed)`);
                    if (taskId) PROGRESS.finish(taskId);
                    if (typeof renderBaseplateStations === 'function') renderBaseplateStations();
                    return true;
                } else if (cachedData?.elements?.length > 0) {
                    data = cachedData;
                    if (typeof DIAG !== 'undefined') DIAG.info('OVERPASS', `Cache hit for ${bboxOverride}: ${data.elements.length} elements`);
                    if (typeof Logger !== 'undefined') Logger.log(`[OVERPASS] Cache hit for region ${bboxOverride}: ${data.elements.length} elements.`);
                    if (taskId) PROGRESS.finish(taskId);
                }
            }
        } catch (e) { /* Cache load failed, will fetch from API */ }

        if (!data || !data.elements) {
            if (typeof showToast !== 'undefined') showToast(`Downloading Regional Physical Data...`, "info");
            const query = `
                [out:json][timeout:90];
                (
                  way["railway"~"rail|subway|light_rail|tram|preserved|abandoned|disused|razed|proposed"]["usage"!~"tourism|industrial|military|test|freight"]["service"!~"yard|siding|spur"](${bboxOverride});
                );
                out body;
                >;
                out skel qt;
                (
                  nwr["railway"~"station|halt|stop|subway_entrance|tram_stop|abandoned|disused|razed|proposed"]["usage"!~"tourism|industrial|military|test|freight"](${bboxOverride});
                  nwr["historic"="railway_station"](${bboxOverride});
                );
                out center;
            `;

            const OVERPASS_ENDPOINTS = [
                "https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter",
                "https://overpass.kumi.systems/api/interpreter"
            ];

            let fetched = false;
            for (const endpoint of OVERPASS_ENDPOINTS) {
                try {
                    if (typeof DIAG !== 'undefined') DIAG.info('OVERPASS', `Trying endpoint: ${endpoint}`);
                    if (typeof Logger !== 'undefined') Logger.log(`[OVERPASS] Trying endpoint: ${endpoint}`);
                    
                    const controller = new AbortController();
                    const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 90000);
                    
                    if (taskId && typeof PROGRESS !== 'undefined' && typeof PROGRESS.fetchWithProgress === 'function') {
                        const result = await PROGRESS.fetchWithProgress(endpoint, {
                            method: "POST",
                            body: "data=" + encodeURIComponent(query),
                            signal: controller.signal
                        }, taskId, 3000000);
                        clearTimeout(timeoutId);
                        if (!result.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${result.status}${result.status === 429 ? ' 429' : ''}`);
                        data = typeof result.json === 'function' ? result.json() : JSON.parse(result.data);
                    } else {
                        const response = await fetch(endpoint, {
                            method: "POST",
                            body: "data=" + encodeURIComponent(query),
                            signal: controller.signal
                        });
                        clearTimeout(timeoutId);
                        if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}${response.status === 429 ? ' 429' : ''}`);
                        data = await response.json();
                    }

                    if (!data?.elements) throw new Error("Invalid Overpass Schema");

                    // Will persist to IndexedDB cache at the end of parsing for maximum storage saving
                    fetched = true;
                    if (typeof DIAG !== 'undefined') DIAG.info('OVERPASS', `Success from ${endpoint}`);
                    if (typeof Logger !== 'undefined') Logger.log(`[OVERPASS] Success from ${endpoint}: ${data.elements.length} elements.`);
                    if (taskId) PROGRESS.finish(taskId);
                    break;
                } catch (err) {
                    if (err.message.includes('429')) throw err;
                    if (typeof DIAG !== 'undefined') DIAG.warn('OVERPASS', `Endpoint ${endpoint} failed: ${err.message}`);
                    if (typeof Logger !== 'undefined') Logger.warn(`[OVERPASS] Endpoint ${endpoint} failed: ${err.message}`);
                    continue;
                }
            }

            if (!fetched) {
                // All endpoints failed — fall back to stale cache if we have one
                if (cachedData?.elements?.length > 0) {
                    data = cachedData;
                    if (typeof DIAG !== 'undefined') DIAG.warn('OVERPASS', 'All endpoints failed. Using stale cache.');
                    if (typeof Logger !== 'undefined') Logger.warn("[OVERPASS] All endpoints failed. Using stale cache.");
                    if (typeof showToast !== 'undefined') showToast("Using cached track data (API unavailable).", "warn");
                    if (taskId) PROGRESS.finish(taskId);
                } else {
                    if (typeof DIAG !== 'undefined') DIAG.error('OVERPASS', 'All endpoints failed and no cache available.');
                    if (typeof Logger !== 'undefined') Logger.err("[OVERPASS] All endpoints failed and no cache available.");
                    if (taskId) PROGRESS.fail(taskId, "Network error");
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        if (taskId) PROGRESS.update(taskId, 0.2, 'Indexing nodes...');
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 5)); // Yield to paint
        
        const nodes = {};
        const ways = [];
        let rawStations = [];
        
        // Single pass over 250k elements
        for (let i = 0; i < data.elements.length; i++) {
            const el = data.elements[i];
            
            // Extract center for polygon/relation stations
            if (el.tags && (/station|halt|stop|subway_entrance|tram_stop/.test(el.tags.railway) || el.tags.historic === 'railway_station')) {
                const lat = el.lat || (el.center && el.center.lat);
                const lon = el.lon || (el.center && el.center.lon);
                if (lat && lon) {
                    rawStations.push({
                        id: el.id,
                        lat: lat,
                        lon: lon,
                        name: resolveStationName(el.tags) || null,
                        railType: el.tags.railway,
                        tags: el.tags || {}
                    });
                }
            }

            if (el.type === 'node') {
                if (el.lat && el.lon) nodes[el.id] = [el.lat, el.lon, el.tags || {}];
            } else if (el.type === 'way') {
                if (el.nodes) ways.push(el);
            }
            if (i % 50000 === 0) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 0)); // Yield periodically
        }

        if (taskId) PROGRESS.update(taskId, 0.4, 'Building geometries...');
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 5));

        const existingRailIds = new Set(CONSTRUCTION.allRailways.map(r => r.id));
        const newRailways = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < ways.length; i++) {
            const way = ways[i];
            if (!existingRailIds.has(way.id)) {
                const wName = (way.tags && way.tags.name) ? way.tags.name.toLowerCase() : '';
                if (wName.includes('gunpowder') || wName.includes('powder mill')) continue;

                const coords = (way.nodes || []).map(nodeId => nodes[nodeId] ? [nodes[nodeId][0], nodes[nodeId][1]] : null).filter(n => n !== null);
                if (coords.length > 1) {
                    newRailways.push({
                        id: way.id,
                        coords: coords,
                        tags: way.tags || {}
                    });
                }
            }
            if (i % 10000 === 0) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 0));
        }

        CONSTRUCTION.allRailways.push(...newRailways);

        function resolveStationName(tags) {
            return tags.name || tags['name:en'] || tags.alt_name || tags.short_name || tags.official_name || tags.ref || tags.description || tags.ref_name || tags['addr:place'] || null;
        }

        rawStations = rawStations.filter(st => st.name || st.railType === 'station' || st.railType === 'halt');

        const namedStations = rawStations.filter(s => s.name);
        rawStations.forEach(st => {
            if (st.name) return;
            let bestName = null;
            let bestDist = 0.003;
            namedStations.forEach(ns => {
                const d = Math.hypot(ns.lat - st.lat, ns.lon - st.lon);
                if (d < bestDist) { bestDist = d; bestName = ns.name; }
            });
            if (bestName) st.name = bestName;
            else {
                const nearbyTrack = CONSTRUCTION.allRailways.find(trk => trk.coords.some(c => Math.hypot(c[0] - st.lat, c[1] - st.lon) < 0.0005));
                if (nearbyTrack) {
                    const tName = nearbyTrack.tags.name || nearbyTrack.tags.ref || nearbyTrack.tags.line;
                    if (tName) st.name = `${tName} Stop`;
                }
            }
        });

        const tflStations = [];
        if (window.globalExportPayload && window.globalExportPayload.data) {
            Object.values(window.globalExportPayload.data).forEach(l => {
                if (l.stations) tflStations.push(...l.stations);
            });
        }

        rawStations = rawStations.filter(gs => !tflStations.some(ts => Math.hypot(ts.lat - gs.lat, ts.lon - gs.lon) < 0.001));

        const mergedStations = [];
        const usedIndices = new Set();
        const normalize = n => (n ? n.toLowerCase() : '').replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '').replace(/station|railway|underground|train|stop/g, '').trim();

        for (let i = 0; i < rawStations.length; i++) {
            if (usedIndices.has(i)) continue;
            const cluster = [rawStations[i]];
            usedIndices.add(i);
            const normI = normalize(rawStations[i].name);

            for (let j = i + 1; j < rawStations.length; j++) {
                if (usedIndices.has(j)) continue;
                const dist = Math.hypot(rawStations[i].lat - rawStations[j].lat, rawStations[i].lon - rawStations[j].lon);
                const normJ = normalize(rawStations[j].name);
                
                if (dist < 0.002 || (dist < 0.005 && normI === normJ)) {
                    cluster.push(rawStations[j]);
                    usedIndices.add(j);
                }
            }

            const centerLat = cluster.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.lat, 0) / cluster.length;
            const centerLon = cluster.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.lon, 0) / cluster.length;
            
            mergedStations.push({
                id: cluster[0].id,
                lat: centerLat,
                lon: centerLon,
                name: cluster[0].name,
                railType: cluster[0].railType,
                tags: cluster[0].tags || {}
            });
        }

        const existingStIds = new Set(CONSTRUCTION.stations.map(s => s.id));
        const finalStations = mergedStations.filter(s => !existingStIds.has(s.id));
        CONSTRUCTION.stations.push(...finalStations);

        try {
            if (typeof setIndexedDBCache === 'function') {
                // Only save the simplified arrays, discarding 99% of the JSON bulk
                await setIndexedDBCache(cacheKey, { __parsed: true, newRailways, finalStations });
            }
        } catch (e) { /* Cache save failed */ }

        if (typeof renderBaseplateStations === 'function') renderBaseplateStations();

        if (typeof Logger !== 'undefined') Logger.log(`[OVERPASS] Region parsed. Total Tracks: ${CONSTRUCTION.allRailways.length}`);
        if (taskId) PROGRESS.finish(taskId);
        return true;
    } catch (err) {
        if (taskId && typeof PROGRESS !== 'undefined') PROGRESS.fail(taskId, err.message || "Failed");
        if (typeof Logger !== 'undefined') Logger.err("[OVERPASS] Operations failed: " + err.message);
        return false;
    }
}

/* --- CANALS & RIVERS ENGINE --- */
const CANALS = {
    isFetching: false,
    group: typeof L !== 'undefined' ? L.layerGroup() : null,
    visible: false,
    renderedIds: new Set()
};

const RIVERS = {
    isFetching: false,
    group: typeof L !== 'undefined' ? L.layerGroup() : null,
    visible: false,
    renderedIds: new Set()
};

/**
 * High-level wrapper to trigger a core region fetch of canals and rivers.
 * Prevents overlapping identical fetch operations.
 *
 * @async
 * @returns {Promise<boolean>} True if data was fetched or loaded from cache successfully.
 */
async function fetchCanals() {
    if (CANALS.isFetching) return false;
    CANALS.isFetching = true;
    const success = await fetchCanalsCore("51.2,-0.6,51.8,0.4", "");
    CANALS.isFetching = false;
    return success;
}

/**
 * Executes the core Overpass API query to extract waterway geographic lines
 * (canals, rivers, reservoirs). Routes them into visually distinct rendering layers
 * based on their tags (differentiating artificial canals from natural rivers).
 *
 * @async
 * @param {string} bboxOverride - The bounding box string (minLat,minLon,maxLat,maxLon).
 * @param {string} cacheSuffix - Suffix for the IndexedDB cache key to segment tiles.
 * @returns {Promise<boolean>} True if data was retrieved successfully.
 */
async function fetchCanalsCore(bboxOverride, cacheSuffix) {
    if (typeof DIAG !== 'undefined') DIAG.action('OVERPASS', `Fetching Canals Region: ${bboxOverride}`);
    
    const cacheKey = "OVERPASS_CANALS_V1" + cacheSuffix;
    let data = null;
    let cachedData = null;
    let pt = null;

    if (!cacheSuffix && typeof showProgressToast === 'function') {
        pt = showProgressToast(`🌊 Canals: Core Region`);
    }

    try {
        if (typeof getIndexedDBCache === 'function') {
            cachedData = await getIndexedDBCache(cacheKey);
            if (cachedData?.elements?.length > 0) {
                data = cachedData;
                if (typeof DIAG !== 'undefined') DIAG.info('OVERPASS', `Canal cache hit for ${bboxOverride}`);
                if (pt) pt.finish(`Loaded from cache`);
            }
        }
    } catch (e) { /* Cache load failed */ }

    if (!data) {
        if (pt) pt.update(0.1, `Querying waterway geometries...`);
        const query = `[out:json][timeout:25];
            (
              way["waterway"~"canal|river"](${bboxOverride});
            );
            out geom;`;

        const endpoints = [
            'https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter',
            'https://overpass.kumi.systems/api/interpreter'
        ];

        let fetched = false;
        for (const endpoint of endpoints) {
            try {
                if (pt) pt.update(0.2, `Trying ${endpoint.split('/')[2]}...`);
                const controller = new AbortController();
                const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), 20000);
                
                const response = await fetch(endpoint, {
                    method: 'POST',
                    body: 'data=' + encodeURIComponent(query),
                    signal: controller.signal
                });
                clearTimeout(timeoutId);
                
                if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
                data = await response.json();
                
                if (data && data.elements) {
                    fetched = true;
                    if (typeof setIndexedDBCache === 'function') {
                        setIndexedDBCache(cacheKey, data);
                    }
                    if (pt) pt.finish(`Downloaded ${data.elements.length} waterways`);
                    break;
                }
            } catch (err) {
                if (err.message.includes('429')) throw err;
                if (typeof DIAG !== 'undefined') DIAG.warn('OVERPASS', `Canal Endpoint ${endpoint} failed: ${err.message}`);
                continue;
            }
        }

        if (!fetched) {
            if (cachedData?.elements?.length > 0) {
                data = cachedData;
                if (pt) pt.finish(`Used stale cache`);
            } else {
                if (pt) pt.fail("Network error");
                return false;
            }
        }
    }

    try {
        const nodes = {};
        data.elements.forEach(el => {
            if (el.type === 'node') nodes[el.id] = [el.lat, el.lon];
        });

        const waterways = data.elements.filter(el => {
            if (el.type !== 'way' || CANALS.renderedIds.has(el.id) || RIVERS.renderedIds.has(el.id)) return false;
            
            // Filter strictly to Regent's and Grand Union canals
            if (el.tags && el.tags.waterway === 'canal') {
                const name = (el.tags.name || '').toLowerCase();
                if (!name.includes('regent') && !name.includes('grand union')) return false;
            }
            return true;
        }).map(way => {
            let coords = [];
            if (way.geometry) {
                coords = way.geometry.map(pt => [pt.lat, pt.lon]);
            } else if (way.nodes) {
                coords = way.nodes.map(nodeId => nodes[nodeId] ? [nodes[nodeId][0], nodes[nodeId][1]] : null).filter(n => n !== null);
            }
            return {
                id: way.id,
                tags: way.tags || {},
                coords: coords
            };
        }).filter(w => w.coords.length > 1);

        waterways.forEach(ww => {
            const isCanal = ww.tags.waterway === 'canal';
            const targetGroup = isCanal ? CANALS : RIVERS;
            targetGroup.renderedIds.add(ww.id);
            if (typeof L !== 'undefined') {
                L.polyline(ww.coords, {
                    color: isCanal ? '#00f3ff' : '#0033ff', // Canals bright cyan, rivers darker blue
                    weight: isCanal ? 4 : 2, // Canals thicker, rivers thinner
                    opacity: 0.6,
                    pane: 'casings',
                    lineCap: 'round',
                    lineJoin: 'round',
                    interactive: false
                }).addTo(targetGroup.group);
            }
        });

        if (typeof Logger !== 'undefined') Logger.log(`[OVERPASS] Rendered ${waterways.length} new waterways in region.`);
        return true;
    } catch (err) {
        if (typeof Logger !== 'undefined') Logger.err("[OVERPASS] Canals parsing failed.");
        return false;
    }
}


/* ===== js\engine\ptal-worker.js ===== */
// ptal-worker.js
// Multithreaded PTAL Solver

self.onmessage = function(e) {
    const { candidatesChunk, existingStations, allRailways, trackGridData, snapRadius, localNames } = e.data;
    
    // Precompute track bounding boxes to achieve ~O(1) culling performance in worker
    const optimizedRailways = (allRailways || []).map(track => {
        let minLat = 90, maxLat = -90, minLon = 180, maxLon = -180;
        if (track.coords) {
            track.coords.forEach(p => {
                if (p[0] < minLat) minLat = p[0];
                if (p[0] > maxLat) maxLat = p[0];
                if (p[1] < minLon) minLon = p[1];
                if (p[1] > maxLon) maxLon = p[1];
            });
        }
        return { coords: track.coords, minLat, maxLat, minLon, maxLon };
    }).filter(t => t.coords && t.coords.length >= 2);
    
    // We recreate the spatial grid lookups
    function _projectToSegment(lat, lon, x1, y1, x2, y2) {
        const A = lat - x1;
        const B = lon - y1;
        const C = x2 - x1;
        const D = y2 - y1;

        const dot = A * C + B * D;
        const len_sq = C * C + D * D;
        let param = -1;
        if (len_sq != 0) param = dot / len_sq;

        let xx, yy;
        if (param < 0) { xx = x1; yy = y1; }
        else if (param > 1) { xx = x2; yy = y2; }
        else { xx = x1 + param * C; yy = y1 + param * D; }

        const dx = lat - xx;
        const dy = (lon - yy) * Math.cos(lat * Math.PI / 180);
        return { lat: xx, lon: yy, dist: Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) * 111320 };
    }

    function _findNearestTrackPoint(lat, lon) {
        if (optimizedRailways.length === 0) return null;
        let best = null;
        let bestDist = Infinity;
        const margin = 0.006; // Bounding box margin for early exclusion

        for (const track of optimizedRailways) {
            if (lat < track.minLat - margin || lat > track.maxLat + margin || lon < track.minLon - margin || lon > track.maxLon + margin) continue;
            
            for (let i = 0; i < track.coords.length - 1; i++) {
                const proj = _projectToSegment(lat, lon, track.coords[i][0], track.coords[i][1], track.coords[i+1][0], track.coords[i+1][1]);
                if (proj.dist < bestDist) {
                    bestDist = proj.dist;
                    best = { lat: proj.lat, lon: proj.lon, dist: proj.dist };
                }
            }
        }
        return best;
    }

    function _estimateClusterArea(lat, lon, allCandidates) {
        const RADIUS_DEG = 0.009; 
        let count = 0;
        for (const c of allCandidates) {
            const dLat = c.lat - lat;
            const dLon = (c.lon - lon) * Math.cos(lat * Math.PI / 180);
            if (Math.sqrt(dLat * dLat + dLon * dLon) < RADIUS_DEG) count++;
        }
        return count * 0.04;
    }

    let processed = 0;
    const results = [];

    for (const c of candidatesChunk) {
        if (c.used) { processed++; continue; }
        
        let nearestDistM = Infinity;
        for (const st of existingStations) {
            const dLat = c.lat - st.lat;
            const dLon = (c.lon - st.lon) * Math.cos(c.lat * Math.PI / 180);
            const dist = Math.sqrt(dLat * dLat + dLon * dLon) * 111320;
            if (dist < nearestDistM) nearestDistM = dist;
        }
        
        if (nearestDistM < 800) {
            c.used = true;
            processed++;
            if (processed % 50 === 0) self.postMessage({ type: 'progress', count: 50 });
            continue;
        }

        const ptalGapScore = Math.min(nearestDistM, 3000) / 3000 * 100;
        const dim1 = ptalGapScore * 0.25;

        const clusterAreaKm2 = _estimateClusterArea(c.lat, c.lon, candidatesChunk);
        // Minimum demand cluster check removed: Aggressively target ALL red zones
        const demandScore = Math.min(clusterAreaKm2 * 25, 100);
        const dim2 = demandScore * 0.30;

        let networkScore = 50;
        if (nearestDistM > 2000) networkScore += 30;
        const dim3 = networkScore * 0.20;

        let engScore = 40;
        let tunnelBonus = 0;
        let snapped = false;
        let finalLat = c.lat, finalLon = c.lon;

        const nearestTrack = _findNearestTrackPoint(c.lat, c.lon);
        if (nearestTrack && nearestTrack.dist < snapRadius) {
