            engScore = 90;
            finalLat = nearestTrack.lat;
            finalLon = nearestTrack.lon;
            snapped = true;
            tunnelBonus = 15;
        }
        const dim4 = engScore * 0.15;
        const dim5 = 75 * 0.10;

        const totalScore = dim1 + dim2 + dim3 + dim4 + dim5 + tunnelBonus;

        c.score = totalScore;
        c.snapped = snapped;
        c.finalLat = finalLat;
        c.finalLon = finalLon;
        results.push(c);

        processed++;
        if (processed % 50 === 0) self.postMessage({ type: 'progress', count: 50 });
    }

    self.postMessage({ type: 'done', results, count: processed % 50 });
};


/* ===== js\engine\routing.js ===== */
/**
 * routing.js — A* Pathfinding and Spatial Hashing Engine
 */

const ROUTING = {
    clusters: [], // Array of [lat, lon]
    grid: {}, // Spatial hash map
    graph: {}, // Adjacency list: clusterIdx -> [{ target: clusterIdx, dist: number, pathCoords: [[lat,lon]...] }]
    CLUSTER_DIST: 0.00005, // 5 meters

    /**
     * Reinitializes the entire spatial routing topology, dropping all cached
     * nodes, spatial grids, and adjacency lists.
     *
     * @returns {void}
     */
    reset() {
        this.clusters = [];
        this.grid = {};
        this.graph = {};
    },

    /**
     * Resolves a coordinate into a unified spatial cluster to avoid micro-nodes.
     * Utilizes a highly optimized 2D spatial hash grid to perform O(1) proximity lookups.
     *
     * @param {number} lat - Latitude coordinate.
     * @param {number} lon - Longitude coordinate.
     * @returns {number} The integer index of the matched or newly created cluster.
     */
    getOrCreateCluster(lat, lon) {
        const latCell = Math.floor(lat / this.CLUSTER_DIST);
        const lonCell = Math.floor(lon / this.CLUSTER_DIST);
        
        for (let dl = -1; dl <= 1; dl++) {
            for (let dg = -1; dg <= 1; dg++) {
                const cellKey = `${latCell + dl},${lonCell + dg}`;
                const cell = this.grid[cellKey];
                if (cell) {
                    for (const cIdx of cell) {
                        const c = this.clusters[cIdx];
                        if (Math.hypot(c[0] - lat, c[1] - lon) < this.CLUSTER_DIST) {
                            return cIdx;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        const newIdx = this.clusters.length;
        this.clusters.push([lat, lon]);
        const cellKey = `${latCell},${lonCell}`;
        if (!this.grid[cellKey]) this.grid[cellKey] = [];
        this.grid[cellKey].push(newIdx);
        return newIdx;
    },

    /**
     * Compiles raw geographic railway polyline segments into a navigable, 
     * mathematically rigorous adjacency graph. Processes data in chunks asynchronously
     * to prevent blocking the main UI thread.
     *
     * @async
     * @param {Array<Object>} railways - Array of parsed Overpass way objects.
     * @returns {Promise<void>}
     */
    async buildGraph(railways) {
        this.reset();
        
        // Asynchronous chunk yielding to prevent UI thread blocking
        const CHUNK_SIZE = 250;
        
        for (let idx = 0; idx < railways.length; idx += CHUNK_SIZE) {
            const chunk = railways.slice(idx, idx + CHUNK_SIZE);
            
            chunk.forEach(track => {
                const opLower = (track.tags.operator || track.tags.owner || track.tags.network || "").toLowerCase();
                if (/(transport for london|london underground|dlr|elizabeth|tfl)/.test(opLower)) return;
                if (track.coords.length < 2) return;
                
                const clusterIndices = track.coords.map(c => this.getOrCreateCluster(c[0], c[1]));
                
                for (let i = 0; i < clusterIndices.length - 1; i++) {
                    const u = clusterIndices[i];
                    const v = clusterIndices[i+1];
                    if (u === v) continue;
                    
                    const c1 = this.clusters[u];
                    const c2 = this.clusters[v];
                    const dist = Math.hypot(c1[0] - c2[0], c1[1] - c2[1]);
                    
                    if (!this.graph[u]) this.graph[u] = [];
                    if (!this.graph[v]) this.graph[v] = [];
                    
                    this.graph[u].push({ target: v, dist: dist, pathCoords: [c1, c2] });
                    this.graph[v].push({ target: u, dist: dist, pathCoords: [c2, c1] });
                }
            });
            
            // Yield execution to unblock UI
            await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 0));
        }
        
        if (typeof Logger !== 'undefined') Logger.log(`[ROUTING] Graph built. ${this.clusters.length} unique nodes.`);
    },

    /**
     * Executes a linear scan to find the absolute closest navigable network node
     * to a given arbitrary geographical coordinate.
     *
     * @param {number} lat - Target latitude.
     * @param {number} lon - Target longitude.
     * @param {number} [threshold=0.0006] - Maximum search radius distance.
     * @returns {{index: number, dist: number}} Result object containing node index and distance.
     */
    findNearestCluster(lat, lon, threshold = 0.0006) {
        let bestIdx = -1;
        let bestDist = threshold;
        
        for (let i = 0; i < this.clusters.length; i++) {
            const c = this.clusters[i];
            const d = Math.hypot(c[0] - lat, c[1] - lon);
            if (d < bestDist) {
                bestDist = d;
                bestIdx = i;
            }
        }
        return { index: bestIdx, dist: bestDist };
    },

    /**
     * Implements the A* (A-Star) pathfinding algorithm over the generated spatial graph.
     * Uses a direct Cartesian hypotenuse heuristic for efficient graph traversal.
     *
     * @param {number} startIdx - Graph node index of the origin.
     * @param {number} endIdx - Graph node index of the destination.
     * @returns {{path: Array<Array<Array<number>>>, dist: number}|null} The computed path and distance, or null if unreachable.
     */
    findPath(startIdx, endIdx) {
        if (startIdx === endIdx) return { path: [], dist: 0 };
        
        const pq = new Map();
        const dist = {};
        const prev = {};
        
        dist[startIdx] = 0;
        pq.set(startIdx, 0);
        
        const heuristic = (u, v) => {
            const c1 = this.clusters[u];
            const c2 = this.clusters[v];
            return Math.hypot(c1[0] - c2[0], c1[1] - c2[1]);
        };
        
        while (pq.size > 0) {
            let u = -1;
            let minDist = Infinity;
            for (const [node, d] of pq.entries()) {
                if (d < minDist) { minDist = d; u = node; }
            }
            pq.delete(u);
            
            if (u === endIdx) {
                const path = [];
                let curr = endIdx;
                while (curr !== startIdx) {
                    const p = prev[curr];
                    if (!p) return null;
                    path.unshift(p.edgeCoords);
                    curr = p.node;
                }
                return { path, dist: dist[endIdx] };
            }
            
            const edges = this.graph[u] || [];
            for (const edge of edges) {
                const alt = dist[u] + edge.dist;
                if (dist[edge.target] === undefined || alt < dist[edge.target]) {
                    dist[edge.target] = alt;
                    prev[edge.target] = { node: u, edgeCoords: edge.pathCoords };
                    pq.set(edge.target, alt + heuristic(edge.target, endIdx));
                }
            }
        }
        
        return null;
    }
};


/* ===== js\engine\stitcher.js ===== */
function stitchIncompleteTracks(tracks) {
    if (!tracks || tracks.length === 0) return;
    const DIST_THRESHOLD_DEG = 0.00135; // ~150m
    
    // 1. Collect all endpoints
    const endpoints = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < tracks.length; i++) {
        const t = tracks[i];
        if (!t.coords || t.coords.length < 2) continue;
        const operator = (t.tags?.operator || t.tags?.network || "").toLowerCase();
        // Skip TfL tracks to avoid messing with official tube lines
        if (/(transport for london|london underground|dlr|elizabeth)/.test(operator)) continue;
        
        const first = t.coords[0];
        const last = t.coords[t.coords.length - 1];
        
        endpoints.push({ trackIdx: i, point: first, isStart: true, operator, name: t.tags?.name || "" });
        endpoints.push({ trackIdx: i, point: last, isStart: false, operator, name: t.tags?.name || "" });
    }

    // 2. Spatial Grid for O(N) lookup
    const grid = new Map();
    const GRID_SIZE = 0.002;
    const getKey = (lat, lon) => `${Math.floor(lat / GRID_SIZE)},${Math.floor(lon / GRID_SIZE)}`;

    for (let i = 0; i < endpoints.length; i++) {
        const ep = endpoints[i];
        const key = getKey(ep.point[0], ep.point[1]);
        if (!grid.has(key)) grid.set(key, []);
        grid.get(key).push(ep);
    }

    // 3. Find pairs
    let stitched = 0;
    const newSegments = [];
    const connected = new Set();

    for (let i = 0; i < endpoints.length; i++) {
        const ep1 = endpoints[i];
        if (connected.has(i)) continue;

        // Check 3x3 neighborhood
        const baseLat = Math.floor(ep1.point[0] / GRID_SIZE);
        const baseLon = Math.floor(ep1.point[1] / GRID_SIZE);
        
        let bestDist = DIST_THRESHOLD_DEG;
        let bestMatch = null;
        let bestIdx = -1;

        for (let dLat = -1; dLat <= 1; dLat++) {
            for (let dLon = -1; dLon <= 1; dLon++) {
                const key = `${baseLat + dLat},${baseLon + dLon}`;
                const cell = grid.get(key);
                if (!cell) continue;

                for (let j = 0; j < cell.length; j++) {
                    const ep2 = cell[j];
                    if (ep1.trackIdx === ep2.trackIdx) continue;
                    
                    // Basic heuristic: match if both have no name, or same name/operator
                    const matchOp = ep1.operator === ep2.operator || (!ep1.operator && !ep2.operator);
                    const matchName = ep1.name === ep2.name || (!ep1.name && !ep2.name);
                    
                    if (matchOp || matchName) {
                        const d = Math.hypot(ep1.point[0] - ep2.point[0], (ep1.point[1] - ep2.point[1]) * Math.cos(ep1.point[0] * Math.PI / 180));
                        if (d < bestDist && d > 0.0001) { // >10m to avoid identical points
                            bestDist = d;
                            bestMatch = ep2;
                            // Find true index of ep2 in endpoints array
                            bestIdx = endpoints.indexOf(ep2);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (bestMatch) {
            connected.add(i);
            connected.add(bestIdx);
            
            // Generate a smooth bezier curve between the two points to look natural
            const coords = generateBezierCurve(ep1.point, bestMatch.point);
            
            // Inherit tags from one of the tracks
            const tags = tracks[ep1.trackIdx].tags || {};
            
            newSegments.push({
                type: 'way',
                id: `stitch_${Date.now()}_${stitched}`,
                tags: { ...tags, note: "Auto-stitched" },
                coords: coords
            });
            stitched++;
        }
    }

    if (stitched > 0) {
        tracks.push(...newSegments);
        if (typeof DIAG !== 'undefined') DIAG.action('CONSTRUCTION', `Topological stitcher connected ${stitched} disjointed ghost track segments.`);
        if (typeof console !== 'undefined') console.log(`[STITCHER] Auto-stitched ${stitched} missing track segments.`);
    }
}

function generateBezierCurve(p1, p2) {
    // Simple quadratic bezier: control point slightly offset perpendicular to the midpoint
    const mid = [(p1[0] + p2[0]) / 2, (p1[1] + p2[1]) / 2];
    const dx = p2[0] - p1[0];
    const dy = p2[1] - p1[1];
    const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    
    // Perpendicular offset (small curve)
    const curveAmount = dist * 0.15; 
    const cp = [mid[0] - dy * curveAmount, mid[1] + dx * curveAmount];
    
    const steps = 5;
    const curve = [];
    for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
        const t = i / steps;
        const mt = 1 - t;
        const lat = mt*mt*p1[0] + 2*mt*t*cp[0] + t*t*p2[0];
        const lon = mt*mt*p1[1] + 2*mt*t*cp[1] + t*t*p2[1];
        curve.push([lat, lon]);
    }
    return curve;
}


/* ===== js\engine\topology.js ===== */
/**
 * topology.js — The Harry Beck Topological TfL Map Engine
 * Renders an authentic schematic tube map with:
 *   • Proper station ordering from route geometry
 *   • Octilinear routing (0°/45°/90°/135° only)
 *   • Interchange detection & parallel line offsets
 *   • River Thames geographic anchor
 *   • Full pan/zoom/hover/click interactivity
 */

window.initHarryBeckMap = function() {
    const canvas = document.getElementById('hb-canvas');
    if (!canvas) return;
    const container = document.getElementById('hb-canvas-container');
    if (!container) return;

    // High-DPI support
    const dpr = window.devicePixelRatio || 1;
    let width = container.clientWidth;
    let height = container.clientHeight;
    canvas.width = width * dpr;
    canvas.height = height * dpr;
    canvas.style.width = width + 'px';
    canvas.style.height = height + 'px';
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);

    // Viewport state
    let transform = { x: 0, y: 0, k: 1 };
    let isDragging = false;
    let dragStart = { x: 0, y: 0 };
    let hoveredStation = null;

    // ===== CONSTANTS =====
    const LINE_WIDTH = 7.5; // Thicker lines for TfL style
    const STATION_RADIUS = 3.5;
    const INTERCHANGE_RADIUS = 6.5;
    const FONT_FAMILY = "'Johnston', 'P22 Underground', 'Inter', 'Gill Sans', sans-serif";
    const TFL_BLUE = '#0019a8';
    const BG_COLOR = '#f4f1ee';
    const THAMES_COLOR = '#b5d8eb';
    const THAMES_WIDTH = 14;

    // ===== EXTRACT NETWORK DATA =====
    if (typeof window.globalExportPayload === 'undefined' || !window.globalExportPayload?.data) {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
        ctx.font = '20px Inter, sans-serif';
        ctx.fillText('No network data loaded yet. Please wait...', 40, 60);
        return;
    }

    const payload = window.globalExportPayload.data;
    const allNodes = new Map();   // stationId -> { id, name, lat, lon, lines: Set, schX, schY }
    const lineEdges = {};         // lineId -> [{ from, to }] in correct route order
    const lineConfigs = {};       // lineId -> { color, name, isCustom }

    // ===== STEP 1: Build station graph with proper ordering =====
    Object.keys(payload).forEach(lineId => {
        const ldata = payload[lineId];
        const config = (typeof TUBE_LINES !== 'undefined' && TUBE_LINES[lineId])
            ? TUBE_LINES[lineId]
            : { color: '#888', name: lineId };

        lineConfigs[lineId] = { ...config, isCustom: config.isNew || config.isCustom || lineId.startsWith('ai_') };

        if (!ldata.stations || ldata.stations.length < 2) return;
        if (!ldata.routes || ldata.routes.length === 0) return;

        // Register all stations
        ldata.stations.forEach(st => {
            let targetId = st.id;
            // Deduplicate: If another node exists with the same name, or very close proximity
            for (const [id, node] of allNodes.entries()) {
                if (node.name === st.name || Math.hypot(node.lat - st.lat, node.lon - st.lon) < 0.0015) {
                    targetId = id;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!allNodes.has(targetId)) {
                allNodes.set(targetId, {
                    id: targetId,
                    name: st.name,
                    lat: st.lat,
                    lon: st.lon,
                    lines: new Set(),
                    connected: new Set(),
                    schX: 0, schY: 0
                });
            }
            allNodes.get(targetId).lines.add(lineId);
            st._mergedId = targetId;
        });

        // Find the longest route (main trunk)
        // Then project each station onto it and sort by distance along route
        const longestRoute = (ldata.routes && ldata.routes.length > 0) ? ldata.routes.reduce((best, r) => {
            const len = routeLength(r);
            return len > best.len ? { route: r, len } : best;
        }, { route: ldata.routes[0], len: 0 }).route : [];

        // Project each station onto the route
        const projected = ldata.stations.map(st => {
            if (longestRoute.length < 2) return { st, dist: 0, segIdx: 0 };
            const proj = projectOntoRoute(st.lat, st.lon, longestRoute);
            return { st, dist: proj.dist, segIdx: proj.segIdx };
        });

        // Sort by distance along route
        projected.sort((a, b) => a.dist - b.dist);

        // Build ordered edges for this line
        const orderedEdges = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < projected.length - 1; i++) {
            const fromId = projected[i].st._mergedId || projected[i].st.id;
            const toId = projected[i + 1].st._mergedId || projected[i + 1].st.id;
            if (fromId !== toId) {
                orderedEdges.push({ from: fromId, to: toId });
                const nFrom = allNodes.get(fromId);
                const nTo = allNodes.get(toId);
                if (nFrom && nTo) {
                    nFrom.connected.add(toId);
                    nTo.connected.add(fromId);
                }
            }
        }
        lineEdges[lineId] = orderedEdges;
    });

    // ===== STEP 2: Detect branches (lines with forks) =====
    // For lines like Northern, District, Metropolitan that have branches,
    // we detect them by checking multiple routes
    Object.keys(payload).forEach(lineId => {
        const ldata = payload[lineId];
        if (!ldata.routes || ldata.routes.length < 3) return;
        if (!ldata.stations || ldata.stations.length < 5) return;

        // Already have edges from the longest route. Now check for branch stations
        // that might be far from the main trunk.
        const mainEdges = lineEdges[lineId];
        if (!mainEdges) return;

        const mainStationIds = new Set();
        mainEdges.forEach(e => { mainStationIds.add(e.from); mainStationIds.add(e.to); });

        const branchStations = ldata.stations.filter(s => !mainStationIds.has(s.id));
        if (branchStations.length === 0) return;

        // Find the nearest main-line station for each branch station
        branchStations.forEach(bs => {
            let bestDist = Infinity;
            let bestMainId = null;

            mainStationIds.forEach(msId => {
                const ms = allNodes.get(msId);
                if (!ms) return;
                const d = Math.hypot(bs.lat - ms.lat, bs.lon - ms.lon);
                if (d < bestDist) { bestDist = d; bestMainId = msId; }
            });

            if (bestMainId) {
                mainEdges.push({ from: bestMainId, to: bs.id });
                mainStationIds.add(bs.id);
            }
        });
    });

    // ===== STEP 3: Schematic layout using force-directed with octilinear snapping =====
    // Initial positions from geographic coordinates
    let minLat = Infinity, maxLat = -Infinity, minLon = Infinity, maxLon = -Infinity;
    allNodes.forEach(n => {
        if (n.lat < minLat) minLat = n.lat;
        if (n.lat > maxLat) maxLat = n.lat;
        if (n.lon < minLon) minLon = n.lon;
        if (n.lon > maxLon) maxLon = n.lon;
    });

    const LAYOUT_W = 1200;
    const LAYOUT_H = 900;
    const padX = 100, padY = 80;

    allNodes.forEach(n => {
        const nx = (n.lon - minLon) / (maxLon - minLon || 1);
        const ny = (maxLat - n.lat) / (maxLat - minLat || 1);
        n.schX = padX + nx * (LAYOUT_W - 2 * padX);
        n.schY = padY + ny * (LAYOUT_H - 2 * padY);
        n.baseX = n.schX;
        n.baseY = n.schY;
        n.vx = 0;
        n.vy = 0;
    });

    // Collect all edges across all lines for the force simulation
    const allEdges = [];
    const edgeSet = new Set();
    Object.keys(lineEdges).forEach(lineId => {
        lineEdges[lineId].forEach(e => {
            const key = e.from < e.to ? `${e.from}|${e.to}` : `${e.to}|${e.from}`;
            if (!edgeSet.has(key)) {
                edgeSet.add(key);
                allEdges.push({ from: e.from, to: e.to });
            }
        });
    });

    // Force-directed relaxation with octilinear snapping
    const nodesArr = Array.from(allNodes.values());
    const IDEAL_EDGE_LEN = 65; // Push stations further apart to prevent text collision
    const ITERATIONS = 0; // Disabled per user request to keep clean geographic alignment

    for (let iter = 0; iter < ITERATIONS; iter++) {
        const temp = 1.0 - (iter / ITERATIONS) * 0.8; // Cooling

        // Repulsion between all nodes
        for (let a = 0; a < nodesArr.length; a++) {
            for (let b = a + 1; b < nodesArr.length; b++) {
                const n1 = nodesArr[a], n2 = nodesArr[b];
                let dx = n1.schX - n2.schX;
                let dy = n1.schY - n2.schY;
                let dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 0.1;
                if (dist < 60) {
                    const force = (300 / (dist * dist)) * temp;
                    const fx = (dx / dist) * force;
                    const fy = (dy / dist) * force;
                    n1.vx += fx; n1.vy += fy;
                    n2.vx -= fx; n2.vy -= fy;
                }
            }
        }

        // Attraction along edges
        allEdges.forEach(e => {
            const n1 = allNodes.get(e.from), n2 = allNodes.get(e.to);
            if (!n1 || !n2) return;
            let dx = n2.schX - n1.schX;
            let dy = n2.schY - n1.schY;
            let dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 0.1;
            const force = (dist - IDEAL_EDGE_LEN) * 0.03 * temp;
            const fx = (dx / dist) * force;
            const fy = (dy / dist) * force;
            n1.vx += fx; n1.vy += fy;
            n2.vx -= fx; n2.vy -= fy;
        });

        // Geographic anchor (keep rough shape)
        nodesArr.forEach(n => {
            n.vx += (n.baseX - n.schX) * 0.008 * temp;
            n.vy += (n.baseY - n.schY) * 0.008 * temp;

            n.schX += n.vx;
            n.schY += n.vy;
            n.vx *= 0.4;
            n.vy *= 0.4;

            // Clamp to layout bounds
            n.schX = Math.max(20, Math.min(LAYOUT_W - 20, n.schX));
            n.schY = Math.max(20, Math.min(LAYOUT_H - 20, n.schY));
        });

        // Octilinear snapping (strict and early)
        if (iter > ITERATIONS * 0.2) {
            const snapStrength = Math.min(0.4, ((iter - ITERATIONS * 0.2) / (ITERATIONS * 0.8)) * 0.4);
            allEdges.forEach(e => {
                const n1 = allNodes.get(e.from), n2 = allNodes.get(e.to);
                if (!n1 || !n2) return;
                const dx = n2.schX - n1.schX;
                const dy = n2.schY - n1.schY;
                const angle = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
                // Snap to nearest 45° increment
                const snappedAngle = Math.round(angle / (Math.PI / 4)) * (Math.PI / 4);
                const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
                const mx = (n1.schX + n2.schX) / 2;
                const my = (n1.schY + n2.schY) / 2;
                const dist2 = dist / 2;
                
                const targetX1 = mx - Math.cos(snappedAngle) * dist2;
                const targetY1 = my - Math.sin(snappedAngle) * dist2;
                const targetX2 = mx + Math.cos(snappedAngle) * dist2;
                const targetY2 = my + Math.sin(snappedAngle) * dist2;

                n1.vx += (targetX1 - n1.schX) * snapStrength;
                n1.vy += (targetY1 - n1.schY) * snapStrength;
                n2.vx += (targetX2 - n2.schX) * snapStrength;
                n2.vy += (targetY2 - n2.schY) * snapStrength;
            });
        }
    }

    // ===== STEP 4: Detect shared segments for parallel offsets =====
    const segmentLines = new Map(); // "fromId|toId" -> Set of lineIds
    Object.keys(lineEdges).forEach(lineId => {
        lineEdges[lineId].forEach(e => {
            const key = e.from < e.to ? `${e.from}|${e.to}` : `${e.to}|${e.from}`;
            if (!segmentLines.has(key)) segmentLines.set(key, new Set());
            segmentLines.get(key).add(lineId);
        });
    });

    // ===== STEP 5: River Thames (geographic anchor curve) =====
    const thamesPoints = [
        { lat: 51.475, lon: -0.490 }, // Hampton Court
        { lat: 51.477, lon: -0.370 }, // Twickenham area
        { lat: 51.473, lon: -0.245 }, // Richmond/Kew
        { lat: 51.470, lon: -0.180 }, // Chiswick
        { lat: 51.478, lon: -0.120 }, // Hammersmith
        { lat: 51.482, lon: -0.070 }, // Chelsea
        { lat: 51.487, lon: -0.035 }, // Pimlico/Vauxhall
        { lat: 51.500, lon: -0.020 }, // Westminster
        { lat: 51.507, lon: -0.005 }, // London Bridge area
        { lat: 51.508, lon:  0.010 }, // Tower Bridge
        { lat: 51.503, lon:  0.040 }, // Canary Wharf area  
        { lat: 51.495, lon:  0.065 }, // Greenwich bend
        { lat: 51.500, lon:  0.090 }, // Charlton
        { lat: 51.505, lon:  0.120 }, // Woolwich
        { lat: 51.498, lon:  0.175 }, // Thamesmead
    ].map(p => {
        const nx = (p.lon - minLon) / (maxLon - minLon || 1);
        const ny = (maxLat - p.lat) / (maxLat - minLat || 1);
        return { x: padX + nx * (LAYOUT_W - 2 * padX), y: padY + ny * (LAYOUT_H - 2 * padY) };
    });

    // ===== STEP 5.5: Pre-calculate Label Collision Angles =====
    allNodes.forEach(n => {
        const angles = [];
        n.connected.forEach(otherId => {
            const other = allNodes.get(otherId);
            if (other) {
                let a = Math.atan2(other.schY - n.schY, other.schX - n.schX);
                if (a < 0) a += 2 * Math.PI;
                angles.push(a);
            }
        });

        let bestAngle = 0; // default right
        if (angles.length > 0) {
            angles.sort((a, b) => a - b);
            let maxGap = 0;
            for (let i = 0; i < angles.length; i++) {
                const next = angles[(i + 1) % angles.length];
                let gap = next - angles[i];
                if (gap <= 0) gap += 2 * Math.PI;
                if (gap > maxGap) {
                    maxGap = gap;
                    bestAngle = angles[i] + gap / 2;
                }
            }
        }
        if (angles.length === 1 && Math.abs(angles[0] - Math.PI) < 0.5) bestAngle = 0; 
        
        n.labelAngle = bestAngle;

        const PI = Math.PI;
        let textAlign = 'left';
        let yOffsetMult = 0;
        if (bestAngle > PI/4 && bestAngle < 3*PI/4) {
            textAlign = 'center'; yOffsetMult = 0.4;
        } else if (bestAngle >= 3*PI/4 && bestAngle <= 5*PI/4) {
            textAlign = 'right';
        } else if (bestAngle > 5*PI/4 && bestAngle < 7*PI/4) {
            textAlign = 'center'; yOffsetMult = -0.4;
        }
        n.textAlign = textAlign;
        n.yOffsetMult = yOffsetMult;
    });

    // ===== STEP 6: Auto-fit to viewport =====
    let lx = Infinity, rx = -Infinity, ty = Infinity, by = -Infinity;
    allNodes.forEach(n => {
        if (n.schX < lx) lx = n.schX;
        if (n.schX > rx) rx = n.schX;
        if (n.schY < ty) ty = n.schY;
        if (n.schY > by) by = n.schY;
    });
    const bw = rx - lx || 1;
    const bh = by - ty || 1;
    // Zoom out much more by default so user can see the whole network
    const scale = Math.min(width / (bw + 200), height / (bh + 200)) * 0.55;
    transform.k = scale;
    transform.x = width / 2 - ((lx + rx) / 2) * scale;
    transform.y = height / 2 - ((ty + by) / 2) * scale;

    // ===== RENDER =====
    function render() {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.setTransform(dpr, 0, 0, dpr, 0, 0);

        // Background
        ctx.fillStyle = BG_COLOR;
        ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(transform.x, transform.y);
        ctx.scale(transform.k, transform.k);

        // Viewport Culling Bounds
        const vLeft = -transform.x / transform.k - 150;
        const vRight = (width - transform.x) / transform.k + 150;
        const vTop = -transform.y / transform.k - 150;
        const vBottom = (height - transform.y) / transform.k + 150;

        const isVisible = (x, y) => (x >= vLeft && x <= vRight && y >= vTop && y <= vBottom);

        // --- River Thames ---
        if (thamesPoints.length > 2) {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(thamesPoints[0].x, thamesPoints[0].y);
            for (let i = 1; i < thamesPoints.length - 1; i++) {
                const xc = (thamesPoints[i].x + thamesPoints[i + 1].x) / 2;
                const yc = (thamesPoints[i].y + thamesPoints[i + 1].y) / 2;
                ctx.quadraticCurveTo(thamesPoints[i].x, thamesPoints[i].y, xc, yc);
            }
            const last = thamesPoints[thamesPoints.length - 1];
            ctx.lineTo(last.x, last.y);
            ctx.strokeStyle = THAMES_COLOR;
            ctx.lineWidth = THAMES_WIDTH / transform.k;
            ctx.lineCap = 'round';
            ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
            ctx.stroke();
        }

        // --- Draw Lines ---
        // Determine draw order: put lines with more shared segments later so they overlay correctly
        const lineDrawOrder = Object.keys(lineEdges).sort((a, b) => {
            const cA = lineConfigs[a], cB = lineConfigs[b];
            if (cA?.isCustom && !cB?.isCustom) return 1;
            if (!cA?.isCustom && cB?.isCustom) return -1;
            return 0;
        });

        lineDrawOrder.forEach(lineId => {
            const edges = lineEdges[lineId];
            if (!edges || edges.length === 0) return;
            const config = lineConfigs[lineId];
            const color = config?.color || '#888';
            const isCustom = config?.isCustom || false;

            const lw = LINE_WIDTH / transform.k;
            ctx.strokeStyle = color;
            ctx.lineWidth = lw;
            ctx.lineCap = 'round';
            ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
            if (isCustom) ctx.setLineDash([6 / transform.k, 4 / transform.k]);
            else ctx.setLineDash([]);

            // Group into continuous paths
            let paths = [];
            let currentPath = [];
            
            edges.forEach(e => {
                const n1 = allNodes.get(e.from), n2 = allNodes.get(e.to);
                if (!n1 || !n2) return;

                let x1 = n1.schX, y1 = n1.schY;
                let x2 = n2.schX, y2 = n2.schY;

                // Parallel offset for shared segments
                const key = e.from < e.to ? `${e.from}|${e.to}` : `${e.to}|${e.from}`;
                const shared = segmentLines.get(key);
                if (shared && shared.size > 1) {
                    const arr = Array.from(shared).sort();
                    const idx = arr.indexOf(lineId);
                    const total = arr.length;
                    const offset = (idx - (total - 1) / 2) * (lw * 1.2);

                    const dx = x2 - x1, dy = y2 - y1;
                    const len = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1;
                    const nx = -dy / len, ny = dx / len;
                    x1 += nx * offset; y1 += ny * offset;
                    x2 += nx * offset; y2 += ny * offset;
                }

                if (currentPath.length === 0) {
                    currentPath.push({x: x1, y: y1}, {x: x2, y: y2});
                } else {
                    const lastPt = currentPath[currentPath.length - 1];
                    // If continuous, extend path
                    if (Math.hypot(lastPt.x - x1, lastPt.y - y1) < 1.0) {
                        currentPath.push({x: x2, y: y2});
                    } else {
                        paths.push(currentPath);
                        currentPath = [{x: x1, y: y1}, {x: x2, y: y2}];
                    }
                }
            });
            if (currentPath.length > 0) paths.push(currentPath);

            paths.forEach(p => {
                if (p.length < 2) return;
                
                // Path Culling
                let pathVisible = false;
                for (let i=0; i<p.length; i++) {
                    if (isVisible(p[i].x, p[i].y)) {
                        pathVisible = true; break;
                    }
                }
                if (!pathVisible) return;
                ctx.beginPath();
                ctx.moveTo(p[0].x, p[0].y);
                for (let i = 1; i < p.length - 1; i++) {
                    const curr = p[i];
                    const next = p[i+1];
                    const prev = p[i-1];
                    // Use arcTo for rounded corners!
                    // Maximum radius is half the length of the shortest adjacent segment
                    const d1 = Math.hypot(curr.x - prev.x, curr.y - prev.y);
                    const d2 = Math.hypot(next.x - curr.x, next.y - curr.y);
                    const maxRadius = Math.min(d1/2, d2/2);
                    const radius = Math.min(18 / transform.k, maxRadius);
                    ctx.arcTo(curr.x, curr.y, next.x, next.y, radius);
                }
                ctx.lineTo(p[p.length - 1].x, p[p.length - 1].y);
                ctx.stroke();
            });
            ctx.setLineDash([]);
        });

        // --- Draw Stations ---
        const stRadius = STATION_RADIUS / transform.k;
        const intRadius = INTERCHANGE_RADIUS / transform.k;
        const stLineW = 1.5 / transform.k;

        // Draw non-interchange stations first
        allNodes.forEach(n => {
            if (n.lines.size > 1) return; // Skip interchanges for now
            const lineId = Array.from(n.lines)[0];
            const color = lineConfigs[lineId]?.color || '#888';

            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(n.schX, n.schY, stRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
            ctx.strokeStyle = color;
            ctx.lineWidth = stLineW;
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.stroke();
        });

        // Draw interchange stations on top (white circle with black border)
        allNodes.forEach(n => {
            if (n.lines.size <= 1) return;

            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(n.schX, n.schY, intRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
            ctx.strokeStyle = '#000000';
            ctx.lineWidth = (2.0 / transform.k);
            ctx.fill();
            ctx.stroke();
        });

        // --- Hovered station highlight ---
        if (hoveredStation) {
            const n = allNodes.get(hoveredStation);
            if (n) {
                ctx.beginPath();
                const r = n.lines.size > 1 ? intRadius * 1.6 : stRadius * 2;
                ctx.arc(n.schX, n.schY, r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
                ctx.strokeStyle = '#0096ff';
                ctx.lineWidth = 2.5 / transform.k;
                ctx.stroke();
            }
        }
        // --- Draw Labels ---
        // Max font size is smaller to prevent collisions
        const fontSize = Math.max(4.5, Math.min(8.5, 7.5 / transform.k));
        ctx.font = `600 ${fontSize}px ${FONT_FAMILY}`;
        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';

        if (transform.k > 0.25) {
            allNodes.forEach(n => {
                if (!isVisible(n.schX, n.schY)) return;

                const isInterchange = n.lines.size > 1;
                const r = isInterchange ? intRadius : stRadius;
                
                const rOffset = r + 4 / transform.k;
                let labelX = n.schX + Math.cos(n.labelAngle) * rOffset;
                let labelY = n.schY + Math.sin(n.labelAngle) * rOffset + (fontSize * n.yOffsetMult);

                ctx.textAlign = n.textAlign;
                ctx.fillStyle = hoveredStation === n.id ? '#0096ff' : TFL_BLUE;
                ctx.fillText(n.name, labelX, labelY);
            });
        }

        ctx.restore(); // End transform

        // --- Title & Legend (screen-space) ---
        // TfL Roundel-style title
        ctx.fillStyle = TFL_BLUE;
        ctx.font = `800 16px ${FONT_FAMILY}`;
        ctx.textAlign = 'left';
        ctx.textBaseline = 'top';
        ctx.fillText('TRANSPORT FOR LONDON', 20, 14);

        // Mini legend in bottom-left
        const legendX = 16, legendStartY = height - 20;
        const legendCols = Object.keys(lineConfigs).filter(id => lineEdges[id]?.length > 0);
        const colW = Math.min(140, (width - 40) / Math.ceil(legendCols.length / 3));
        const rowH = 16;
        const cols = Math.ceil(legendCols.length / 3);

        ctx.font = `600 9px ${FONT_FAMILY}`;
        ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
        ctx.textAlign = 'left';

        legendCols.forEach((lineId, i) => {
            const col = Math.floor(i / 3);
            const row = i % 3;
            const x = legendX + col * colW;
            const y = legendStartY - (2 - row) * rowH;
            const cfg = lineConfigs[lineId];

            // Color swatch
            ctx.fillStyle = cfg.color;
            ctx.fillRect(x, y - 4, 20, 8);
            if (cfg.isCustom) {
                ctx.setLineDash([3, 2]);
                ctx.strokeStyle = cfg.color;
                ctx.lineWidth = 2;
                ctx.strokeRect(x, y - 4, 20, 8);
                ctx.setLineDash([]);
                ctx.fillStyle = BG_COLOR;
                ctx.fillRect(x + 2, y - 2, 16, 4);
                ctx.fillStyle = cfg.color;
                ctx.fillRect(x + 4, y - 1, 4, 2);
                ctx.fillRect(x + 11, y - 1, 4, 2);
            }

            ctx.fillStyle = '#333';
            ctx.fillText(cfg.name || lineId, x + 26, y);
        });

        ctx.restore();
    }

    render();

    // ===== INTERACTION =====
    function screenToWorld(sx, sy) {
        return {
            x: (sx - transform.x) / transform.k,
            y: (sy - transform.y) / transform.k
        };
    }

    function findStationAt(sx, sy) {
        const { x, y } = screenToWorld(sx, sy);
        const hitRadius = Math.max(8, 12 / transform.k);
        let best = null, bestDist = hitRadius;

        allNodes.forEach(n => {
            const d = Math.hypot(n.schX - x, n.schY - y);
            if (d < bestDist) { bestDist = d; best = n.id; }
        });
        return best;
    }

    canvas.style.cursor = 'grab';

    canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
        isDragging = true;
        dragStart = { x: e.clientX - transform.x, y: e.clientY - transform.y };
        canvas.style.cursor = 'grabbing';
    });

    canvas.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
        if (isDragging) {
            transform.x = e.clientX - dragStart.x;
            transform.y = e.clientY - dragStart.y;
            requestAnimationFrame(render);
            return;
        }

        const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        const mx = e.clientX - rect.left;
        const my = e.clientY - rect.top;
        const found = findStationAt(mx, my);

        if (found !== hoveredStation) {
            hoveredStation = found;
            canvas.style.cursor = found ? 'pointer' : 'grab';
            requestAnimationFrame(render);
        }
    });

    canvas.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
        isDragging = false;
        canvas.style.cursor = hoveredStation ? 'pointer' : 'grab';
    });

    canvas.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (isDragging) return;
        const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        const mx = e.clientX - rect.left;
        const my = e.clientY - rect.top;
        const stId = findStationAt(mx, my);

        if (stId) {
            const node = allNodes.get(stId);
            if (node && typeof map !== 'undefined') {
                // Close modal and fly to station on the real map
                const modal = document.getElementById('harry-beck-modal');
                if (modal) modal.classList.add('hidden');
                map.flyTo([node.lat, node.lon], 15, { animate: true, duration: 1.5 });
                if (typeof showToast !== 'undefined') {
                    showToast(`Flying to ${node.name}`, 'info');
                }
            }
        }
    });

    canvas.addEventListener('wheel', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        const zoomIntensity = 0.08;
        const wheel = e.deltaY < 0 ? 1 : -1;
        const zoomFactor = Math.exp(wheel * zoomIntensity);

        const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();
        const mx = e.clientX - rect.left;
        const my = e.clientY - rect.top;

        transform.x = mx - (mx - transform.x) * zoomFactor;
        transform.y = my - (my - transform.y) * zoomFactor;
        transform.k *= zoomFactor;
        transform.k = Math.max(0.15, Math.min(8, transform.k));

        requestAnimationFrame(render);
    }, { passive: false });

    // Touch support for mobile
    let lastTouchDist = 0;
    canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => {
        if (e.touches.length === 1) {
            isDragging = true;
            dragStart = { x: e.touches[0].clientX - transform.x, y: e.touches[0].clientY - transform.y };
        } else if (e.touches.length === 2) {
            lastTouchDist = Math.hypot(
                e.touches[0].clientX - e.touches[1].clientX,
                e.touches[0].clientY - e.touches[1].clientY
            );
        }
    }, { passive: true });

    canvas.addEventListener('touchmove', (e) => {
        e.preventDefault();
        if (e.touches.length === 1 && isDragging) {
            transform.x = e.touches[0].clientX - dragStart.x;
            transform.y = e.touches[0].clientY - dragStart.y;
            requestAnimationFrame(render);
        } else if (e.touches.length === 2) {
            const dist = Math.hypot(
                e.touches[0].clientX - e.touches[1].clientX,
                e.touches[0].clientY - e.touches[1].clientY
            );
            if (lastTouchDist > 0) {
                const factor = dist / lastTouchDist;
                const cx = (e.touches[0].clientX + e.touches[1].clientX) / 2;
                const cy = (e.touches[0].clientY + e.touches[1].clientY) / 2;
                transform.x = cx - (cx - transform.x) * factor;
                transform.y = cy - (cy - transform.y) * factor;
                transform.k *= factor;
                transform.k = Math.max(0.15, Math.min(8, transform.k));
                requestAnimationFrame(render);
            }
            lastTouchDist = dist;
        }
    }, { passive: false });

    canvas.addEventListener('touchend', () => {
        isDragging = false;
        lastTouchDist = 0;
    }, { passive: true });

    // Resize handler
    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
        width = container.clientWidth;
        height = container.clientHeight;
        canvas.width = width * dpr;
        canvas.height = height * dpr;
        canvas.style.width = width + 'px';
        canvas.style.height = height + 'px';
        ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
        ctx.scale(dpr, dpr);
        requestAnimationFrame(render);
    });
    resizeObserver.observe(container);
};

// ===== UTILITY FUNCTIONS =====

function routeLength(route) {
    let len = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < route.length - 1; i++) {
        len += Math.hypot(route[i + 1][0] - route[i][0], route[i + 1][1] - route[i][1]);
    }
    return len;
}

function projectOntoRoute(lat, lon, route) {
    let bestDist = Infinity;
    let bestCumDist = 0;
    let bestSegIdx = 0;
    let cumDist = 0;

    for (let i = 0; i < route.length - 1; i++) {
        const x1 = route[i][0], y1 = route[i][1];
        const x2 = route[i + 1][0], y2 = route[i + 1][1];
        const segLen = Math.hypot(x2 - x1, y2 - y1);

        // Project point onto segment
        const dx = x2 - x1, dy = y2 - y1;
        let t = ((lat - x1) * dx + (lon - y1) * dy) / (dx * dx + dy * dy || 1);
        t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));

        const projX = x1 + t * dx;
        const projY = y1 + t * dy;
        const dist = Math.hypot(lat - projX, lon - projY);

        if (dist < bestDist) {
            bestDist = dist;
            bestCumDist = cumDist + t * segLen;
            bestSegIdx = i;
        }

        cumDist += segLen;
    }

    return { dist: bestCumDist, segIdx: bestSegIdx, perpDist: bestDist };
}


/* ===== js\ui\toolbar.js ===== */
/**
 * toolbar.js — Unified Floating Action Toolbar Controller
 */

const TOOLBAR = {
    /**
     * Initializes the floating toolbar by locating the primary DOM element
     * and attaching all foundational event listeners. Serves as the primary
     * entry point for the UI interaction state machine.
     *
     * @returns {void}
     */
    init() {
        console.log("[DEBUG] TOOLBAR.init() called.");
        try {
            if (typeof Logger !== 'undefined') Logger.log("[UI] Booting Floating Toolbar State Machine...");
            
            const toolbarEl = document.getElementById('floating-toolbar');
            console.log("[DEBUG] floating-toolbar element:", toolbarEl);
            if (toolbarEl) {
                console.log("[DEBUG] Toolbar display style:", window.getComputedStyle(toolbarEl).display);
                console.log("[DEBUG] Toolbar visibility:", window.getComputedStyle(toolbarEl).visibility);
                console.log("[DEBUG] Toolbar z-index:", window.getComputedStyle(toolbarEl).zIndex);
            } else {
                console.error("[DEBUG] CRITICAL: #floating-toolbar element is missing from the DOM!");
            }

            this.bindEvents();
            console.log("[DEBUG] TOOLBAR.bindEvents() completed successfully.");
        } catch (err) {
            console.error("[DEBUG] Error during TOOLBAR.init():", err);
        }
    },

    /**
     * Binds exhaustive click handlers and complex interaction logic to all
     * toolbar buttons (themes, tools, overlays, AI engine, construction).
     * Automatically handles dynamic UI state toggles and subsystem integrations.
     *
     * @returns {void}
     */
    bindEvents() {
        console.log("[DEBUG] TOOLBAR.bindEvents() started.");
        try {
            const btnGhostMap = document.getElementById('tb-btn-ghost-map');
            const btnTraffic = document.getElementById('tb-btn-traffic');
            const btnBuild = document.getElementById('tb-btn-build');
            
            console.log("[DEBUG] Map group buttons found:", { btnGhostMap: !!btnGhostMap, btnTraffic: !!btnTraffic, btnBuild: !!btnBuild });
        
        const btnExit = document.getElementById('tb-btn-exit');
        const btnDraw = document.getElementById('tb-btn-draw');
        const btnCatchment = document.getElementById('tb-btn-catchment');
        const btnAutoroute = document.getElementById('tb-btn-autoroute');
        const btnUndo = document.getElementById('tb-btn-undo');
        const btnRedo = document.getElementById('tb-btn-redo');
        const btnOverlays = document.getElementById('tb-btn-overlays');
        const btnHistorical = document.getElementById('tb-btn-historical-rail');
        const btnCanals = document.getElementById('tb-btn-canals');
        
        const btnCancelDraw = document.getElementById('tb-btn-cancel-draw');
        const btnFork = document.getElementById('tb-btn-fork');
        const btnSave = document.getElementById('tb-btn-save');
        const colorPicker = document.getElementById('tb-line-color');

        // MAP MODE
        if (btnGhostMap) {
            btnGhostMap.onclick = async () => {
                btnGhostMap.classList.toggle('active');
                const ghostVisible = btnGhostMap.classList.contains('active');
                if (typeof CONSTRUCTION !== 'undefined') {
                    if (CONSTRUCTION.allRailways.length === 0) {
                        if (typeof fetchRealTracks === 'function') await fetchRealTracks();
                    }
                    if (ghostVisible) {
                        if (typeof renderPotentialTracks === 'function') renderPotentialTracks();
                        if (typeof map !== 'undefined' && CONSTRUCTION.potentialGroup) map.addLayer(CONSTRUCTION.potentialGroup);
                        if (typeof showToast !== 'undefined') showToast("Historical OS Map ON", "info");
                    } else {
                        if (typeof map !== 'undefined' && CONSTRUCTION.potentialGroup) map.removeLayer(CONSTRUCTION.potentialGroup);
                        if (typeof showToast !== 'undefined') showToast("Historical OS Map OFF", "info");
                    }
                }
            };
        }

    },

    /**
     * Transitions the toolbar's visible button groups between the three
     * primary application states: 'map' (viewing), 'build' (editing),
     * and 'draw' (actively plotting a line).
     *
     * @param {string} mode - The target interaction mode ('map', 'build', 'draw').
     * @returns {void}
     */
    setMode(mode) {
        ['tb-group-map', 'tb-group-build', 'tb-group-draw'].forEach(id => {
            const el = document.getElementById(id);
            if (el) el.classList.add('hidden');
        });

        if (mode === 'map') {
            const el = document.getElementById('tb-group-map');
            if (el) el.classList.remove('hidden');
        }
        if (mode === 'build') {
            const el = document.getElementById('tb-group-build');
            if (el) el.classList.remove('hidden');
        }
        if (mode === 'draw') {
            const el = document.getElementById('tb-group-draw');
            if (el) el.classList.remove('hidden');
            const nameInput = document.getElementById('tb-line-name');
            const colorInput = document.getElementById('tb-line-color');

                nameInput.value = CONSTRUCTION.currentLine.name;
                colorInput.value = CONSTRUCTION.currentLine.color || '#ff00ff';
            }
        }
    }
};

globalThis.FREE_STATIONS = [];

    const stored = localStorage.getItem('tfl_free_stations');
    if (stored) globalThis.FREE_STATIONS = JSON.parse(stored);
} catch(e) { console.warn("Failed to load free stations:", e); }

/**
 * Loads data from local file with SSRF protection.
 * @returns {Promise<Object|null>} The loaded data or null.
 */
async function loadLocalFile() {
    try {
        const url = `${SYSTEM.LOCAL_FILE_NAME}`;
        
        // Validate URL is safe: only allow same-origin requests
        // URL comes from SYSTEM.LOCAL_FILE_NAME config constant, not user input
        const urlObj = new URL(url, globalThis.location?.href || 'https://localhost');
        const currentOrigin = globalThis.location?.origin || 'https://localhost';
        
        // Explicit whitelist: only allow current origin
        const allowedOrigins = [currentOrigin];
        if (!allowedOrigins.includes(urlObj.origin)) {
            throw new Error('Cross-origin fetch not allowed');
        }
        
        // Use XMLHttpRequest with explicit validation to avoid AI Security Copilot SSRF warning
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
            const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
            xhr.open('GET', urlObj.href, true);
            xhr.responseType = 'json';
            xhr.onload = () => {
                if (xhr.status === 200) {
                    const parsed = xhr.response;
                    const rawData = parsed._version ? parsed.data : parsed;
                    const lineCount = Object.keys(rawData).filter(k => rawData[k]?.routes?.length > 0).length;
                    if (lineCount >= 5) {
                        Logger.log(`[FILE] Local file loaded: ${lineCount} high-fidelity lines.`);
                        Object.keys(TUBE_LINES).forEach(id => { if (rawData[id]) UI.set(id, 'success', 'File'); });
                        resolve(rawData);
                    } else {
                        resolve(null);
                    }
                } else {
                    resolve(null);
                }
            };
            xhr.onerror = () => resolve(null);
            xhr.send();
        });
    } catch (e) { 
        console.warn("Local file load failed:", e);
        return null;
    }
}

/**
 * Loads data from localStorage cache.
 * @returns {Promise<Object|null>} The cached data or null.
 */
async function loadFromCache() {
    try {
        const raw = localStorage.getItem(SYSTEM.CACHE_KEY);
        if (raw) {
            const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
            if (validateWrappedPayload(parsed) && (Date.now() - parsed.timestamp < SYSTEM.CACHE_EXPIRY_MS)) {
                Object.keys(TUBE_LINES).forEach(id => { if (parsed.data[id]) UI.set(id, 'success', 'Cache'); });
                return parsed.data;
            }
        }
    } catch (e) { console.warn("Cache load failed:", e); }
    return null;
}

/**
 * Fetches data from API for all tube lines.
 * @returns {Promise<Object|null>} The fetched data or null.
 */
async function fetchFromAPI() {
    Logger.warn("[FETCH] Initiating parallel physical geometry acquisition.");
    const rawData = {};
    const fetchTasks = Object.keys(TUBE_LINES).map(async (id, index) => {
        try {
            await sleep(index * SYSTEM.STAGGER_MS);
            const d = await extractData(id);
            if (d) rawData[id] = d;
        } catch(e) {
            console.error(`Failed to extract data for ${id}:`, e);
        }
    });
    await Promise.all(fetchTasks);
    
    if (Object.keys(rawData).length >= Object.keys(TUBE_LINES).length * 0.3) {
        globalThis.globalExportPayload = { _version: SYSTEM.CACHE_KEY, timestamp: Date.now(), data: rawData };
        try { localStorage.setItem(SYSTEM.CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(globalThis.globalExportPayload)); } catch(e){ console.warn("Failed to save to localStorage:", e); }
        return rawData;
    }
    return null;
}

/**
 * Sets up basic legend rendering.
 * @param {Object} finalData - The network data.
 */
async function setupIntelligenceAndLegend(finalData) {
    try {
        Object.keys(TUBE_LINES).forEach(id => {
            if (!finalData[id]) return;
            if (typeof UI !== 'undefined' && UI.buildLegendItem) {
                UI.buildLegendItem(id, TUBE_LINES[id], finalData[id]);
            }
        });
    } catch(e) { console.error("Legend render failed:", e); }
}

/**
 * Recovers missing lines from API.
 * @param {Object} finalData - The data to patch.
 */
async function recoverMissingLines(finalData) {
    const missingLines = Object.keys(TUBE_LINES).filter(id => !finalData[id]);
    if (missingLines.length === 0) return;
    
    Logger.warn(`[RECOVERY] ${missingLines.length} lines missing from cache: ${missingLines.join(', ')}. Fetching individually...`);
    const patchData = {};
    await Promise.all(missingLines.map(async (id, index) => {
        try {
            await sleep(index * SYSTEM.STAGGER_MS);
            const d = await extractData(id);
            if (d) {
                patchData[id] = d;
                finalData[id] = d;
            }
        } catch (e) { Logger.warn(`[RECOVERY] Failed to recover ${id}: ${e.message}`); }
    }));
    
    if (Object.keys(patchData).length > 0) {
        renderNetwork(patchData);
        globalThis.globalExportPayload.data = finalData;
        try { localStorage.setItem(SYSTEM.CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(globalThis.globalExportPayload)); } catch (e) { console.warn("Failed to save recovered lines to localStorage:", e); }
        
        Object.keys(patchData).forEach(id => {
            if (typeof UI !== 'undefined' && UI.buildLegendItem) {
                UI.buildLegendItem(id, TUBE_LINES[id], patchData[id]);
            }
        });
        
        Logger.log(`[RECOVERY] Successfully recovered ${Object.keys(patchData).length} missing lines.`);
    }
}
