}

/**
 * Merges custom lines from IndexedDB.
 * @param {Object} finalData - The data to merge into.
 */
async function mergeCustomLines(finalData) {
    try {
        if (typeof getIndexedDBCache === 'function') {
            const customLines = await getIndexedDBCache('USER_ADDITIONS');
            if (customLines) {
                Logger.log(`[IDB] Merged ${Object.keys(customLines).length} custom user lines.`);
                Object.keys(customLines).forEach(k => {
                    finalData[k] = customLines[k];
                    if (typeof TUBE_LINES !== 'undefined') {
                        TUBE_LINES[k] = { name: customLines[k].name, color: customLines[k].color, isNew: true, isCustom: true };
                    }
                });
            }
        }
    } catch(e) { Logger.warn("Failed to merge custom lines:", e.message); }
}

/**
 * Processes final network data after acquisition.
 * @param {Object} finalData - The network data to process.
 * @param {number} startTime - The boot start time.
 */
async function processNetworkData(finalData, startTime) {
    await mergeCustomLines(finalData);
    
    // Geometrically filter out unwanted default branches per user request
    if (finalData.tram && finalData.tram.routes) {
        // Remove Sutton tram extension (approx < 51.37 lat, < -0.18 lon)
        finalData.tram.routes = finalData.tram.routes.filter(r => !r.some(pt => pt[0] < 51.37 && pt[1] < -0.18));
        
        // Remove specific unwanted station roundels
        if (finalData.tram.stations) {
            finalData.tram.stations = finalData.tram.stations.filter(s => !['St Helier', 'Rose Hill'].includes(s.name));
        }
    }
    if (finalData.windrush && finalData.windrush.routes) {
        // Remove Battersea Park spur (approx 51.476, -0.149)
        finalData.windrush.routes = finalData.windrush.routes.filter(r => !r.some(pt => Math.abs(pt[0] - 51.476) < 0.005 && Math.abs(pt[1] - (-0.149)) < 0.005));
    }

    globalThis.globalExportPayload = { _version: SYSTEM.CACHE_KEY, timestamp: Date.now(), data: finalData };
    
    await Promise.allSettled([
        Promise.resolve(renderNetwork(finalData)),
        Promise.resolve(setupIntelligenceAndLegend(finalData))
    ]);
    
    try {
        await recoverMissingLines(finalData);
    } catch(e) { console.error("Recovery phase failed:", e); }
    
    const bootTime = (performance.now() - startTime).toFixed(0);
    Logger.log(`[BOOT] System online in ${bootTime}ms. Physical Truth Matrix Ready.`);
    showToast(`Matrix Synchronized (${bootTime}ms)`, "success");
}

/**
 * Acquires network data from local file, cache, or API.
 * @returns {Promise<Object|null>} The network data or null.
 */
async function acquireNetworkData() {
    try { localStorage.removeItem('tfl_diabolical_network_data_v18_windrush'); } catch(e) { console.warn("Failed to remove old cache:", e); }

    let data = await loadLocalFile();
    if (!data) {
        data = await loadFromCache();
    }
    if (!data) {
        data = await fetchFromAPI();
    }

    // Thameslink load removed per user request: "Thameslink is being shown by default for no reason which is stupid"
    return data;
}

/**
 * Initializes diagnostic and progress systems.
 */
function initializeDiagnostics() {
    if (typeof PROGRESS !== 'undefined') PROGRESS.init();
    if (typeof DIAG !== 'undefined') DIAG.init();
}

/**
 * Initializes the entire application pipeline, orchestrating data fetching, map rendering,
 * UI component setup, and system event bindings in a highly concurrent manner.
 * Prioritizes local high-fidelity files over cached and live API data.
 *
 * @async
 * @returns {Promise<void>} Resolves when the core boot sequence finishes.
 */
async function BOOT() {
    try {
        initializeDiagnostics();
        
        const startTime = performance.now();
        Logger.log("=== GOD MODE INITIALIZED ===");
        if (typeof DIAG !== 'undefined') DIAG.action('BOOT', 'God Mode Initialized. Starting subsystem spin-up.');
        
        // 1. Start UI and Map initialization in parallel with data discovery
        const initTask = Promise.allSettled([
            Promise.resolve(initMap()),
            Promise.resolve(UI.init())
        ]);

        // 2. Data Acquisition Pipeline (Multitasked)
        const dataTask = acquireNetworkData();

        // 3. Orchestrate completion
        const [, finalData] = await Promise.all([initTask, dataTask]);

        if (finalData) {
            await processNetworkData(finalData, startTime);
        }

        // 6. High-speed transition
        hideLoadingOverlay();

        // 7. Initialize post-boot systems
        initializePostBootSystems();

    } catch (fatalError) {
        console.error("FATAL BOOT FAILURE:", fatalError);
        const errDiv = document.createElement('div');
        errDiv.style.cssText = "color:red;font-family:monospace;padding:20px;background:#000;height:100vh;";
        const h1 = document.createElement('h1');
        h1.textContent = "CRITICAL SYSTEM FAILURE";
        const p = document.createElement('p');
        p.textContent = fatalError.message;
        const pre = document.createElement('pre');
        pre.textContent = fatalError.stack;
        errDiv.appendChild(h1);
        errDiv.appendChild(p);
        errDiv.appendChild(pre);
        document.body.innerHTML = '';
        document.body.appendChild(errDiv);
    }
}

/* ===== DIABOLICAL AUTO-SAVE ENGINE ===== */
const AUTOSAVE = {
    _lastHash: '',
    _interval: null,
    _saveCount: 0,

    /**
     * Initializes the autosave interval and attaches window-level event listeners
     * to capture user navigation or tab switching for immediate state persistence.
     * 
     * @returns {void}
     */
    init() {
        // DISABLED: Autosave temporarily disabled per user request
        console.log("[AUTOSAVE] Autosave is DISABLED.");
    },

    /**
     * Computes a SHA-1 hash for the given object payload to determine if
     * state has mutated since the last successful auto-save tick.
     * Fallbacks to a pseudo-hash if crypto functions are unavailable.
     *
     * @async
     * @param {Object} obj - The JSON-serializable state object to hash.
     * @returns {Promise<string>} The computed hash string.
     */
    async _computeHash(obj) {
        const str = JSON.stringify(obj);
        if (!globalThis.crypto?.subtle) {
            return str.length.toString() + "-" + str.codePointAt(Math.floor(str.length/2));
        }
        const data = new TextEncoder().encode(str);
        const hashBuffer = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', data);
        const hashArray = Array.from(new Uint8Array(hashBuffer));
        return hashArray.map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
    },

    /**
     * Executes a single auto-save iteration. Extracts relevant global state,
     * computes its hash, compares against the last saved hash, and writes to
     * localStorage or IndexedDB if changes are detected.
     *
     * @async
     * @returns {Promise<void>}
     */
    async _tick() {
        try {
            if (!globalThis.globalExportPayload?.data) return;
            
            // Build a snapshot of all saveable state
            const snapshot = {
                network: globalThis.globalExportPayload.data,
                freeStations: globalThis.FREE_STATIONS || [],
                customTubeLines: {}
            };
            
            // Extract custom lines
            if (typeof TUBE_LINES !== 'undefined') {
                Object.keys(TUBE_LINES).forEach(k => {
                    if (TUBE_LINES[k].isCustom || TUBE_LINES[k].isNew) {
                        snapshot.customTubeLines[k] = TUBE_LINES[k];
                    }
                });
            }
            
            const hash = await this._computeHash(snapshot);
            if (hash === this._lastHash) return; // No changes
            this._lastHash = hash;
            this._saveCount++;
            
            // Persist to localStorage (main network cache)
            try {
                if (typeof SYSTEM !== 'undefined') {
                    globalThis.globalExportPayload.timestamp = Date.now();
                    localStorage.setItem(SYSTEM.CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(globalThis.globalExportPayload));
                }
            } catch (e) { console.warn("localStorage save failed (quota exceeded?):", e); }

            // Persist free stations
            try {
                localStorage.setItem('tfl_free_stations', JSON.stringify(globalThis.FREE_STATIONS || []));
            } catch (e) { console.warn(e); }

            // Persist custom lines to IndexedDB
            if (Object.keys(snapshot.customTubeLines).length > 0 && typeof setIndexedDBCache === 'function') {
                const customData = {};
                Object.keys(snapshot.customTubeLines).forEach(k => {
                    if (globalThis.globalExportPayload.data[k]) {
                        customData[k] = {
                            ...globalThis.globalExportPayload.data[k],
                            name: snapshot.customTubeLines[k].name,
                            color: snapshot.customTubeLines[k].color
                        };
                    }
                });
                if (Object.keys(customData).length > 0) {
                    setIndexedDBCache('USER_ADDITIONS', customData);
                }
            }

            console.log(`[AUTOSAVE] Save #${this._saveCount} committed silently.`);
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn("[AUTOSAVE] Tick failed:", e);
        }
    },

    /**
     * Synchronously invalidates the current hash and forces an immediate
     * execution of the autosave tick to ensure zero data loss during page unloads.
     *
     * @returns {void}
     */
    _forceSave() {
        this._lastHash = ''; // Force a save by invalidating hash
        this._tick();
    }
};

window.addEventListener('load', async () => {
    try { await BOOT(); } catch(e) { console.error("Window Load Event Failed:", e); }
    // Arm auto-save after boot
    // Disable autosave temporarily per user request
    // setTimeout(() => AUTOSAVE.init(), 5000);
});


/* ===== js\catchment.js ===== */
/**
 * catchment.js — Catchment Area Station Solver & Route Linker
 * 
 * Provides two key algorithms:
 *   1. solveStations() — Greedy farthest-point sampling to place stations
 *      where residential areas are >800m from any existing station.
 *   2. linkRoutes() — Minimum spanning tree to connect newly-placed stations
 *      into efficient routes, avoiding unnecessary detours.
 */

const CATCHMENT = {
    RADIUS_M: 800,         // Walking catchment radius in metres
    MIN_CLUSTER_AREA: 0.5, // Minimum cluster area in km² to warrant a station
    SNAP_RADIUS: 0.005,    // ~500m in degrees for snapping to ghost tracks
    solvedStations: [],     // Stations placed by the solver
    proposedRoutes: [],     // Routes created by the linker
    routeGroup: null,       // Leaflet layer group for proposed routes

    /**
     * Multithreaded PTAL Solver utilizing Web Workers and Overpass Local Names.
     */
    async solveStations() {
        const pt = typeof showProgressToast === 'function' ? showProgressToast('🎯 Background PTAL Cluster') : null;
        if (pt) pt.update(0.01, 'Fetching Hyper-Local Names...');

        // 1. Fetch Overpass Local Names Dictionary
        let b = map.getBounds();
        let s = b.getSouth(), w = b.getWest(), n = b.getNorth(), e = b.getEast();
        
        // Clamp BBOX to prevent Overpass 429 Too Many Requests crashes on massive zooms
        if (e - w > 2.0 || n - s > 1.5) {
            const cLat = (n + s) / 2;
            const cLon = (e + w) / 2;
            s = Math.max(49.0, cLat - 0.75);
            n = Math.min(60.0, cLat + 0.75);
            w = cLon - 1.0; e = cLon + 1.0;
            if (typeof DIAG !== 'undefined') DIAG.warn('PTAL', 'BBOX too large! Clamped localNames query to prevent 429 crash.');
        }
        const bboxStr = `${s},${w},${n},${e}`;
        const query = `[out:json];node["place"~"suburb|neighbourhood|village|town"](${bboxStr});out;`;
        
        let localNames = [];
        try {
            const r = await fetch('https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter', {
                method: 'POST',
                body: "data=" + encodeURIComponent(query)
            });
            const data = await r.json();
            if (data && data.elements) {
                localNames = data.elements.map(e => ({ name: e.tags.name, lat: e.lat, lon: e.lon }));
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.warn("Failed to fetch local names:", e);
        }

        if (pt) pt.update(0.05, 'Generating Candidates...');

        if (typeof COVERAGE === 'undefined' || !COVERAGE.residentialAreas || COVERAGE.residentialAreas.length === 0) {
            if (pt) pt.finish("No residential areas found.");
            return;
        }
        
        const existingStations = COVERAGE.getAllStations() || [];
        const candidates = await this._generateCandidateGrid(COVERAGE.residentialAreas);
        if (candidates.length === 0) {
            if (pt) pt.finish("No candidates generated.");
            return;
        }

        // Clean track properties for worker serialization
        const cleanRailways = (typeof CONSTRUCTION !== 'undefined' ? CONSTRUCTION.allRailways : []).map(r => ({ coords: r.coords }));

        const numWorkers = navigator.hardwareConcurrency || 4;
        const chunkSize = Math.ceil(candidates.length / numWorkers);
        let completedWorkers = 0;
        let totalProcessed = 0;
        let allResults = [];

        if (pt) pt.update(0.1, `Spinning up ${numWorkers} PTAL Workers...`);

        // Spawn Workers
        await new Promise((resolve) => {
            for (let i = 0; i < numWorkers; i++) {
                const chunk = candidates.slice(i * chunkSize, (i + 1) * chunkSize);
                if (chunk.length === 0) {
                    completedWorkers++;
                    continue;
                }

                const worker = new Worker('js/engine/ptal-worker.js');
                worker.postMessage({
                    candidatesChunk: chunk,
                    existingStations: existingStations.map(s => ({ lat: s.lat, lon: s.lon })),
                    allRailways: cleanRailways,
                    snapRadius: this.SNAP_RADIUS,
                    localNames: localNames
                });

                worker.onmessage = (e) => {
                    const msg = e.data;
                    if (msg.type === 'progress') {
                        totalProcessed += msg.count;
                        if (pt) pt.update(0.1 + (0.8 * (totalProcessed / candidates.length)), `PTAL Matrix: ${totalProcessed}/${candidates.length}`);
                    } else if (msg.type === 'done') {
                        totalProcessed += msg.count;
                        allResults.push(...msg.results);
                        completedWorkers++;
                        worker.terminate();
                        if (completedWorkers === numWorkers) resolve();
                    }
                };

                worker.onerror = (err) => {
                    console.error("[PTAL] Worker Error:", err);
                    completedWorkers++;
                    worker.terminate();
                    if (completedWorkers === numWorkers) resolve();
                };
            }
        });

        if (pt) pt.update(0.9, 'Finalizing Placements...');

        // Sort by score and greedily place top non-overlapping stations
        allResults.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);

        let placed = 0;
        const placedLocs = [];
        const usedNames = new Set();
        
        if (!globalThis.FREE_STATIONS) globalThis.FREE_STATIONS = [];

        for (let i = 0; i < allResults.length; i++) {
            const res = allResults[i];
            
            // Drop threshold aggressively to literally exterminate the red catchment zones
            if (res.score < 1) break; // Exterminate all the way down to a score of 1
            
            // Ensure optimal spacing to minimize total stations while allowing slight catchment overlap (0.85x) for 100% gap coverage
            let overlap = false;
            for (const p of placedLocs) {
                const dLat = res.finalLat - p.lat;
                const dLon = (res.finalLon - p.lon) * Math.cos(res.finalLat * Math.PI / 180);
                if (Math.sqrt(dLat * dLat + dLon * dLon) * 111320 < (this.RADIUS_M * 0.85)) { overlap = true; break; }
            }
            if (overlap) continue;

            // Determine Hyper-Local Name
            let baseName = `Station N${res.finalLat.toFixed(2)} ${res.finalLon > 0 ? 'E' : 'W'}${Math.abs(res.finalLon).toFixed(2)}`;
            let bestNameDist = Infinity;
            for (const ln of localNames) {
                const dLat = res.finalLat - ln.lat;
                const dLon = (res.finalLon - ln.lon) * Math.cos(res.finalLat * Math.PI / 180);
                const dist = Math.sqrt(dLat * dLat + dLon * dLon) * 111320;
                if (dist < bestNameDist && dist < 1500) {
                    bestNameDist = dist;
                    baseName = ln.name;
                }
            }

            let finalName = baseName + ' (New)';
            let idx = 2;
            while (usedNames.has(finalName)) {
                finalName = baseName + ` East (New) ${idx++}`;
            }
            usedNames.add(finalName);

            const st = {
                id: 'new_' + Date.now() + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 5),
                name: finalName,
                lat: res.finalLat,
                lon: res.finalLon,
                isFree: true,
                score: res.score,
                snapped: res.snapped
            };
            
            globalThis.FREE_STATIONS.push(st);
            this.solvedStations.push(st);
            placedLocs.push(st);
            placed++;
            
            // Actually render the station on the map
            if (typeof renderFreeStation === 'function') {
                renderFreeStation(st);
            }
            
            // Yield based on loop index to guarantee zero UI freezing during massive iterations
            if (i % 250 === 0) {
                if (pt) pt.update(0.9, `Finalizing Placements: processed ${i}/${allResults.length}, added ${placed}...`);
                await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 0));
            }
        }
        
        // Save the generated network of stations
        if (typeof saveFreeStations === 'function') {
            saveFreeStations();
        }
        
        if (typeof COVERAGE !== 'undefined' && COVERAGE.active) COVERAGE.redraw();
        return placed;
    },

    /**
     * "Victoria Line" Sequence Engine:
     * 1. Cluster newly placed stations into distinct "Lines" (max 12-15 stations).
     * 2. Draft 2 nearest existing National Rail/TfL stations as anchors.
     * 3. Construct a strictly linear sequence (no branching).
     * 4. Draw continuous routing, using smooth bezier splines for deep-level tunneling.
     */
    async linkRoutes() {
        if (this.solvedStations.length < 2) {
            if (typeof showToast !== 'undefined') showToast('Need at least 2 solved stations to link.', 'warn');
            return;
        }

        const pt = typeof showProgressToast === 'function' ? showProgressToast('🚇 Line Sequencer') : null;
        if (pt) pt.update(0.1, 'Drafting linear tube lines...');

        try {
            const newStations = this.solvedStations;
            const existingInterchanges = (typeof CONSTRUCTION !== 'undefined') ? CONSTRUCTION.stations : [];

            // 1. Simple Spatial Clustering (group into lines of max ~15 stations)
            const MAX_PER_LINE = 15;
            let unassigned = [...newStations];
            const lines = [];

            while (unassigned.length > 0) {
                const seed = unassigned.shift();
                const currentLine = [seed];
                
                // Greedily grow cluster up to MAX_PER_LINE
                while (currentLine.length < MAX_PER_LINE && unassigned.length > 0) {
                    const last = currentLine[currentLine.length - 1];
                    let bestIdx = -1;
                    let bestDist = Infinity;
                    
                    for (let i = 0; i < unassigned.length; i++) {
                        const cand = unassigned[i];
                        const dLat = cand.lat - last.lat;
                        const dLon = (cand.lon - last.lon) * Math.cos(cand.lat * Math.PI / 180);
                        const dist = Math.sqrt(dLat * dLat + dLon * dLon) * 111320;
                        // Only add if relatively close (e.g. < 4km)
                        if (dist < bestDist && dist < 4000) {
                            bestDist = dist;
                            bestIdx = i;
                        }
                    }
                    
                    if (bestIdx !== -1) {
                        currentLine.push(unassigned[bestIdx]);
                        unassigned.splice(bestIdx, 1);
                    } else {
                        break; // No more close stations
                    }
                }
                lines.push(currentLine);
            }

            // 2. Process each line: Add Anchors and Sequence
            this.proposedRoutes = [];
            if (this.routeGroup && typeof map !== 'undefined') map.removeLayer(this.routeGroup);
            this.routeGroup = L.layerGroup();
            
            // Standard generic tube colors
            const lineColors = ['#b36305', '#00782a', '#003688', '#e32017', '#f3a9bb', '#000000', '#00a4a7'];

            for (let l = 0; l < lines.length; l++) {
                if (pt) pt.update(0.2 + (l / lines.length) * 0.7, `Routing Line ${l + 1}/${lines.length}...`);
                const currentLine = lines[l];
                const color = lineColors[l % lineColors.length];

                // Find 2 distinct existing anchors (terminals)
                let anchor1 = null, anchor2 = null;
                if (existingInterchanges.length > 0) {
                    const findAnchor = (refStation, excludeId) => {
                        let best = null;
                        let bestDist = Infinity;
                        for (const ex of existingInterchanges) {
                            if (ex.id === excludeId) continue;
                            const dLat = ex.lat - refStation.lat;
                            const dLon = (ex.lon - refStation.lon) * Math.cos(ex.lat * Math.PI / 180);
                            const dist = Math.sqrt(dLat * dLat + dLon * dLon) * 111320;
                            if (dist < bestDist) { bestDist = dist; best = ex; }
                        }
                        return best;
                    };
                    
                    anchor1 = findAnchor(currentLine[0], null);
                    anchor2 = findAnchor(currentLine[currentLine.length - 1], anchor1 ? anchor1.id : null);
                    
                    if (anchor1) currentLine.unshift({ ...anchor1, isAnchor: true });
                    if (anchor2 && anchor2.id !== anchor1?.id) currentLine.push({ ...anchor2, isAnchor: true });
                }

                // 3. Draw the sequential continuous spine
                for (let i = 0; i < currentLine.length - 1; i++) {
                    const from = currentLine[i];
                    const to = currentLine[i + 1];

                    // Try snapping to physical infrastructure
                    let routeCoords = this._routeAlongGhostTracks(from, to);
                    
                    // If no physical track exists, mathematically tunnel a deep-level smooth spline
                    if (!routeCoords || routeCoords.length < 2) {
                        const p1 = [from.lat, from.lon];
                        const p2 = [to.lat, to.lon];
                        // Quadratic bezier to simulate organic tunneling slightly bowing outwards
                        const mid = [(p1[0] + p2[0]) / 2, (p1[1] + p2[1]) / 2];
                        const dLat = p2[0] - p1[0];
                        const dLon = p2[1] - p1[1];
                        
                        // Perpendicular offset based on index to alternate bowing
                        const bowFactor = (i % 2 === 0 ? 1 : -1) * 0.15;
                        const control = [
                            mid[0] - dLon * bowFactor,
                            mid[1] + dLat * bowFactor
                        ];

                        routeCoords = [];
                        for (let t = 0; t <= 1; t += 0.1) {
                            const lat = (1-t)*(1-t)*p1[0] + 2*(1-t)*t*control[0] + t*t*p2[0];
                            const lon = (1-t)*(1-t)*p1[1] + 2*(1-t)*t*control[1] + t*t*p2[1];
                            routeCoords.push([lat, lon]);
                        }
                        routeCoords.push(p2); // ensure perfect connection
                    }

                    this.proposedRoutes.push({ from: from.name, to: to.name, coords: routeCoords });

                    // Render: glow
                    L.polyline(routeCoords, {
                        color: color, weight: 8, opacity: 0.2,
                        interactive: false, pane: 'casings', lineCap: 'round', lineJoin: 'round'
                    }).addTo(this.routeGroup);

                    // Render: casing
                    L.polyline(routeCoords, {
                        color: '#0a0a0a', weight: 5, opacity: 0.7,
                        interactive: false, pane: 'casings', lineCap: 'round', lineJoin: 'round'
                    }).addTo(this.routeGroup);

                    // Render: core spine
                    const lineStr = L.polyline(routeCoords, {
                        color: color, weight: 3, opacity: 0.9,
                        dashArray: '8, 4', interactive: true, pane: 'casings', lineCap: 'round', lineJoin: 'round'
                    });
                    lineStr.bindTooltip(`<b>${from.name}</b> → <b>${to.name}</b>`, { className: 'ghost-track-tooltip', direction: 'top' });
                    lineStr.addTo(this.routeGroup);
                }
                
                // Render custom anchor markers to visually confirm network attachment
                [anchor1, anchor2].forEach(a => {
                    if (a) {
                        const mk = L.circleMarker([a.lat, a.lon], { radius: 8, fillColor: '#fff', color: color, weight: 3, fillOpacity: 1, pane: 'hubs' });
                        mk.bindTooltip(`<b>Interchange Anchor</b><br>${a.name}`, { className: 'ghost-track-tooltip', direction: 'top' });
                        mk.addTo(this.routeGroup);
                    }
                });
            }

            this.routeGroup.addTo(map);

            if (pt) pt.finish(`✅ Constructed ${lines.length} high-efficiency continuous tube lines.`);
            if (typeof showToast !== 'undefined') showToast(`Successfully architected ${lines.length} new lines bridging ${existingInterchanges.length} existing interchanges.`, 'success');

        } catch (err) {
            console.error('Line Sequencer error:', err);
            if (pt) pt.fail('Engine failed: ' + err.message);
        }
    },

    /* ============================================================
       HELPER METHODS
       ============================================================ */

    /**
     * Generates a grid of candidate points within residential polygons.
     * Uses ~200m spacing. Async to prevent UI freezing on massive grids.
     */
    async _generateCandidateGrid(residentialAreas) {
        const candidates = [];
        const STEP_DEG = 0.002; // ~200m grid spacing
        const seen = new Set();
        let iters = 0;

        for (const area of residentialAreas) {
            if (!area.polygon || area.polygon.length < 3) continue;

            // Compute bounding box of polygon
            let minLat = Infinity, maxLat = -Infinity, minLon = Infinity, maxLon = -Infinity;
            for (const pt of area.polygon) {
                if (pt[0] < minLat) minLat = pt[0];
                if (pt[0] > maxLat) maxLat = pt[0];
                if (pt[1] < minLon) minLon = pt[1];
                if (pt[1] > maxLon) maxLon = pt[1];
            }

            // Generate grid points within bbox
            for (let lat = minLat; lat <= maxLat; lat += STEP_DEG) {
                for (let lon = minLon; lon <= maxLon; lon += STEP_DEG) {
                    // Snap to grid to avoid duplicates
                    const key = `${lat.toFixed(4)},${lon.toFixed(4)}`;
                    if (seen.has(key)) continue;
                    
                    // Point-in-polygon test (ray casting)
                    if (this._pointInPolygon(lat, lon, area.polygon)) {
                        seen.add(key);
                        candidates.push({ lat, lon, used: false });
                    }
                    iters++;
                    if (iters % 10000 === 0) await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 0));
                }
            }
        }

        return candidates;
    },

    /**
     * Ray-casting point-in-polygon test.
     */
    _pointInPolygon(lat, lon, polygon) {
        let inside = false;
        for (let i = 0, j = polygon.length - 1; i < polygon.length; j = i++) {
            const xi = polygon[i][0], yi = polygon[i][1];
            const xj = polygon[j][0], yj = polygon[j][1];
            if ((yi > lon) !== (yj > lon) &&
                lat < (xj - xi) * (lon - yi) / (yj - yi) + xi) {
                inside = !inside;
            }
        }
        return inside;
    },

    /**
     * Estimates the area of the residential cluster around a point.
     * Counts nearby candidates within 1km radius and converts to km².
     */
    _estimateClusterArea(lat, lon, candidates) {
        const RADIUS_DEG = 0.009; // ~1km
        let count = 0;
        for (const c of candidates) {
            if (c.used) continue;
            const dLat = c.lat - lat;
            const dLon = (c.lon - lon) * Math.cos(lat * Math.PI / 180);
            if (Math.sqrt(dLat * dLat + dLon * dLon) < RADIUS_DEG) count++;
        }
        // Each grid cell is ~0.002° × 0.002° ≈ 0.04km²
        return count * 0.04;
    },

    /**
     * Builds a spatial grid of all track segments to optimize snapping (O(1) lookups).
     */
    _buildTrackGrid() {
        if (this._trackGrid) return;
        this._trackGrid = new SpatialGridIndex(0.02); // ~2km cell
        for (const track of CONSTRUCTION.allRailways) {
            if (!track.coords || track.coords.length < 2) continue;
            
            // Removed TfL filter: New stations should snap to ANY pre-existing rail, active or ghost.
            
            for (let i = 0; i < track.coords.length - 1; i++) {
                this._trackGrid.insertSegment(track.coords[i], track.coords[i + 1], {
                    p1: track.coords[i], p2: track.coords[i + 1]
                });
            }
        }
    },

    /**
     * Finds the nearest point on any ghost track utilizing O(1) spatial grid cache.
     */
    _findNearestTrackPoint(lat, lon) {
        if (!this._trackGrid) this._buildTrackGrid();
        
        const segments = this._trackGrid.query(lat, lon, this.SNAP_RADIUS);
        if (segments.length === 0) return null;

        let best = null;
        let bestDist = Infinity;

        for (const seg of segments) {
            const proj = this._projectToSegment(lat, lon, seg.p1[0], seg.p1[1], seg.p2[0], seg.p2[1]);
            if (proj.dist < bestDist) {
                bestDist = proj.dist;
                best = { lat: proj.lat, lon: proj.lon, dist: proj.dist };
            }
        }

        return best;
    },

    /**
     * Projects a point onto a line segment, returns closest point and distance.
     */
    _projectToSegment(px, py, x1, y1, x2, y2) {
        const dx = x2 - x1, dy = y2 - y1;
        const lenSq = dx * dx + dy * dy;
        let t = lenSq === 0 ? 0 : ((px - x1) * dx + (py - y1) * dy) / lenSq;
        t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));
        const closestLat = x1 + t * dx;
        const closestLon = y1 + t * dy;
        const dist = Math.sqrt((px - closestLat) ** 2 + ((py - closestLon) * Math.cos(px * Math.PI / 180)) ** 2);
        return { lat: closestLat, lon: closestLon, dist };
    },

    /**
     * Simple route along ghost tracks between two points.
     * Uses greedy nearest-segment approach.
     */
    _routeAlongGhostTracks(from, to) {
        if (typeof CONSTRUCTION === 'undefined' || CONSTRUCTION.allRailways.length === 0) {
            return [[from.lat, from.lon], [to.lat, to.lon]];
        }

        // Find tracks that pass near both from and to
        const PROXIMITY = 0.008; // ~800m search radius
        const relevantTracks = [];

        for (const track of CONSTRUCTION.allRailways) {
            if (!track.coords || track.coords.length < 2) continue;
            const op = (track.tags?.operator || '').toLowerCase();
            if (/(transport for london|london underground|dlr|elizabeth|tfl)/.test(op)) continue;

            let nearFrom = false, nearTo = false;
            for (const c of track.coords) {
                if (Math.hypot(c[0] - from.lat, c[1] - from.lon) < PROXIMITY) nearFrom = true;
                if (Math.hypot(c[0] - to.lat, c[1] - to.lon) < PROXIMITY) nearTo = true;
                if (nearFrom && nearTo) break;
            }
            if (nearFrom && nearTo) relevantTracks.push(track);
        }

        if (relevantTracks.length === 0) {
            return [[from.lat, from.lon], [to.lat, to.lon]];
        }

        // Pick the track with the shortest path between the two points
        let bestRoute = null;
        let bestLen = Infinity;

        for (const track of relevantTracks) {
            // Find closest coord index to from and to
            let fromIdx = 0, toIdx = 0;
            let fromDist = Infinity, toDist = Infinity;
            
            for (let i = 0; i < track.coords.length; i++) {
                const df = Math.hypot(track.coords[i][0] - from.lat, track.coords[i][1] - from.lon);
                const dt = Math.hypot(track.coords[i][0] - to.lat, track.coords[i][1] - to.lon);
                if (df < fromDist) { fromDist = df; fromIdx = i; }
                if (dt < toDist) { toDist = dt; toIdx = i; }
            }

            // Extract the sub-path
            const start = Math.min(fromIdx, toIdx);
            const end = Math.max(fromIdx, toIdx);
            const subPath = track.coords.slice(start, end + 1);
            
            // Calculate total length
            let totalLen = 0;
            for (let i = 0; i < subPath.length - 1; i++) {
                totalLen += Math.hypot(subPath[i + 1][0] - subPath[i][0], subPath[i + 1][1] - subPath[i][1]);
            }

            if (totalLen < bestLen) {
                bestLen = totalLen;
                // Ensure correct direction
                if (fromIdx > toIdx) subPath.reverse();
                bestRoute = [[from.lat, from.lon], ...subPath, [to.lat, to.lon]];
            }
        }

        return bestRoute || [[from.lat, from.lon], [to.lat, to.lon]];
    },

    /**
     * Detects locations where two different lines pass within 200m
     * but have no station/interchange connecting them.
     */
    _detectMissingInterchanges(solvedStations) {
        const interchanges = [];
        if (typeof CONSTRUCTION === 'undefined' || CONSTRUCTION.allRailways.length === 0) return interchanges;

        // Sample points from solved routes
        for (let i = 0; i < this.proposedRoutes.length; i++) {
            for (let j = i + 1; j < this.proposedRoutes.length; j++) {
                const r1 = this.proposedRoutes[i];
                const r2 = this.proposedRoutes[j];
                
                // Check if any coords are within 200m (0.002°)
                for (const c1 of r1.coords) {
                    for (const c2 of r2.coords) {
                        const dist = Math.hypot(c1[0] - c2[0], (c1[1] - c2[1]) * Math.cos(c1[0] * Math.PI / 180));
                        if (dist < 0.002) {
                            // Check no existing station nearby
                            const midLat = (c1[0] + c2[0]) / 2;
                            const midLon = (c1[1] + c2[1]) / 2;
                            
                            let hasStation = false;
                            for (const st of solvedStations) {
                                if (Math.hypot(st.lat - midLat, st.lon - midLon) < 0.003) {
                                    hasStation = true;
                                    break;
                                }
                            }
                            
                            if (!hasStation) {
                                // Avoid duplicate interchanges
                                let isDup = false;
                                for (const ic of interchanges) {
                                    if (Math.hypot(ic.lat - midLat, ic.lon - midLon) < 0.003) {
                                        isDup = true;
                                        break;
                                    }
                                }
                                if (!isDup) {
                                    interchanges.push({
                                        lat: midLat,
                                        lon: midLon,
                                        reason: `${r1.from}↔${r1.to} crosses ${r2.from}↔${r2.to}`
                                    });
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        return interchanges;
    },

    /**
     * Generates a descriptive name for a solved station based on its location.
     */
    _generateStationName(lat, lon, index) {
        // Try to find nearest named place from ghost stations
        if (typeof CONSTRUCTION !== 'undefined' && CONSTRUCTION.stations) {
            let nearest = null;
            let nearestDist = 0.01; // ~1km
            for (const st of CONSTRUCTION.stations) {
                if (!st.tags?.name) continue;
                const d = Math.hypot(st.lat - lat, st.lon - lon);
                if (d < nearestDist) {
                    nearestDist = d;
                    nearest = st;
                }
            }
            if (nearest) {
                return `${nearest.tags.name} (New)`;
            }
        }

        // Fallback: coordinate-based name
        const latDir = lat >= 0 ? 'N' : 'S';
        const lonDir = lon >= 0 ? 'E' : 'W';
        return `Station ${latDir}${Math.abs(lat).toFixed(2)} ${lonDir}${Math.abs(lon).toFixed(2)}`;
    }
};

// Radical Interaction Engine: Map-level click + hover interceptor
let mapClickListener = null;
