                    st.lat = latlng.lat;
                    st.lon = latlng.lng;
                    stMarker.setLatLng(latlng);
                    if (tempCatchment) tempCatchment.setLatLng(latlng);

                    // Persist gracefully
                    if (config.isCustom || config.isNew) {
                        if (typeof getIndexedDBCache === 'function') {
                            getIndexedDBCache('USER_ADDITIONS').then(customLines => {
                                if (!customLines) customLines = {};
                                customLines[lineId] = lData;
                                if (typeof setIndexedDBCache === 'function') setIndexedDBCache('USER_ADDITIONS', customLines);
                            });
                        }
                    } else {
                        try { localStorage.setItem(SYSTEM.CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(window.globalExportPayload)); } catch(err){}
                    }

                    setTimeout(removeDragMarker, 50);
                });

                tempDragMarker.on('click', (e) => {
                    if (typeof CONSTRUCTION !== 'undefined' && CONSTRUCTION.active) {
                        map.fire('click', e);
                    } else if (typeof openStationBottomSheet === 'function') {
                        openStationBottomSheet(st, config);
                    }
                });
                tempDragMarker.on('contextmenu', (e) => {
                    if (typeof CONSTRUCTION !== 'undefined' && CONSTRUCTION.active) {
                        map.fire('contextmenu', e);
                    }
                });
                
                tempDragMarker.bindTooltip(`<b>${st.name}</b><br><span style="color:${config.color}">■ ${config.name}</span>`, { className: 'tfl-tooltip', direction: 'top', offset: [0, -6] }).openTooltip();

                tempDragMarker.on('mouseout', () => {
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        if (tempDragMarker && !tempDragMarker.dragging?.enabled()) {
                            removeDragMarker();
                        }
                    }, 500);
                });
            };

            const removeDragMarker = () => {
                if (!tempDragMarker) return;
                if (tempDragMarker.dragging && tempDragMarker.dragging.moving()) return;
                
                group.removeLayer(tempDragMarker);
                if (tempCatchment) {
                    group.removeLayer(tempCatchment);
                    tempCatchment = null;
                }
                tempDragMarker = null;
                stMarker.setStyle({ opacity: 1, fillOpacity: 1 });
            };

            stMarker.on('mouseover', spawnDragMarker);
            stMarker.on('click', (e) => {
                if (typeof CONSTRUCTION !== 'undefined' && CONSTRUCTION.active) {
                    map.fire('click', e);
                } else if (typeof openStationBottomSheet === 'function') {
                    openStationBottomSheet(st, config);
                }
            });
            stMarker.on('contextmenu', (e) => {
                if (typeof CONSTRUCTION !== 'undefined' && CONSTRUCTION.active) {
                    map.fire('contextmenu', e);
                }
            });
            
            stMarker.bindTooltip(`<b>${st.name}</b><br><span style="color:${config.color}">■ ${config.name}</span>`, { className: 'tfl-tooltip', direction: 'top', offset: [0, -6] });
            mapLayers.hubs.push({ marker: stMarker, lines: [lineId] });
        });

        group.addTo(map);
        mapLayers.lines[lineId] = { group, active: true };
    });

    const activeLabels = [];
    
    Object.values(stationDirectory).forEach(hub => {
        const linesArr = Array.from(hub.lines).filter(l => TUBE_LINES[l]);
        if (linesArr.length === 0) return;

        const markerLabel = L.marker([hub.lat, hub.lon], {
            icon: L.divIcon({
                className: 'smart-label-container',
                html: `<div class="smart-label-text" style="transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease; cursor: pointer; pointer-events: auto;">${hub.name}</div>`,
                iconSize: [0, 0]
            }),
            interactive: true
        });
        
        markerLabel.on('click', () => {
            if (typeof openStationModal === 'function') {
                openStationModal(hub.name, (newName) => {
                    hub.name = newName;
                    if (hub.textElement) hub.textElement.textContent = newName;
                    // Sync deeply to the cache so it persists
                    if (window.globalExportPayload && window.globalExportPayload.data) {
                        Object.values(window.globalExportPayload.data).forEach(line => {
                            line.stations.forEach(st => {
                                if (Math.hypot(st.lat - hub.lat, st.lon - hub.lon) < 0.005) {
                                    st.name = newName;
                                }
                            });
                        });
                        try { localStorage.setItem(SYSTEM.CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(window.globalExportPayload)); } catch(e){}
                    }
                    if (typeof updateSmartLabels === 'function') updateSmartLabels();
                });
            }
        });
        
        hub.markerLabel = markerLabel;
        activeLabels.push(hub);
        mapLayers.labels.addLayer(markerLabel);
    });

    /**
     * Recomputes the visual placement of text labels for all station hubs.
     * Implements a greedy collision-detection algorithm utilizing bounded boxes
     * and 8-point radial placement to prevent overlapping text while maximizing
     * legibility. Also optimizes performance by immediately hiding off-screen labels.
     *
     * @returns {void}
     */
    function updateSmartLabels() {
        if (map.getZoom() < 13) return;
        
        // Sort by importance
        activeLabels.sort((a, b) => b.lines.size - a.lines.size);
        
        const boxes = [];
        const bounds = map.getBounds();
        
        activeLabels.forEach(hub => {
            if (!mapLayers.labels.hasLayer(hub.markerLabel)) return;

            const latlng = L.latLng(hub.lat, hub.lon);
            const inBounds = bounds.contains(latlng);

            // Viewport bounds pre-filtering: If offscreen, hide and bypass all heavy DOM calculation
            if (!inBounds) {
                if (hub.isVisible !== false) {
                    hub.isVisible = false;
                    const el = hub.markerLabel.getElement();
                    if (el) {
                        if (!hub.textElement) hub.textElement = el.querySelector('.smart-label-text');
                        if (hub.textElement) hub.textElement.style.opacity = '0';
                    }
                }
                return;
            }

            const el = hub.markerLabel.getElement();
            if (!el) return;
            if (!hub.textElement) hub.textElement = el.querySelector('.smart-label-text');
            const textEl = hub.textElement;
            if (!textEl) return;

            hub.isVisible = true;

            const pt = map.latLngToContainerPoint(latlng);
            const width = hub.name.length * 6 + 10;
            const height = 14;
            const padding = 2;

            // Placements: [xOffset, yOffset]
            const placements = [
                [10, -7],         // right
                [-width - 10, -7], // left
                [-width/2, -22],  // top
                [-width/2, 8],    // bottom
                [8, -20],         // top-right
                [8, 6],           // bottom-right
                [-width - 8, -20],// top-left
                [-width - 8, 6]   // bottom-left
            ];

            let placed = false;
            for (let pos of placements) {
                const box = {
                    minX: pt.x + pos[0] - padding,
                    maxX: pt.x + pos[0] + width + padding,
                    minY: pt.y + pos[1] - padding,
                    maxY: pt.y + pos[1] + height + padding
                };

                let overlaps = false;
                for (let b of boxes) {
                    if (!(box.maxX < b.minX || box.minX > b.maxX || box.maxY < b.minY || box.minY > b.maxY)) {
                        overlaps = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }

                if (!overlaps) {
                    boxes.push(box);
                    textEl.style.transform = `translate(${pos[0]}px, ${pos[1]}px)`;
                    textEl.style.opacity = '1';
                    placed = true;
                    break;
                }
            }

            if (!placed) {
                textEl.style.opacity = '0'; // Hide if no space
            }
        });
    }

    map.on('moveend', updateSmartLabels);
    map.on('zoomend', updateSmartLabels);
    
    // Trigger initial placement safely
    setTimeout(updateSmartLabels, 100);
}



/* ===== js\progress.js ===== */
/**
 * progress.js — Global Progress Bar System
 * Real-time tracking for all long-running operations.
 * Supports concurrent tasks, streaming byte progress, and smooth animation.
 */

const PROGRESS = {
    _tasks: {},
    _nextId: 0,
    _barEl: null,
    _textEl: null,
    _containerEl: null,
    _shimmerEl: null,

    /**
     * Bootstraps the progress bar sub-system by locating required DOM elements.
     * Must be called during the application boot sequence.
     *
     * @returns {void}
     */
    init() {
        this._containerEl = document.getElementById('progress-container');
        this._barEl = document.getElementById('progress-bar');
        this._textEl = document.getElementById('progress-text');
        this._shimmerEl = document.getElementById('progress-shimmer');
        DIAG.action('PROGRESS', 'Progress bar system initialized.');
    },

    /**
     * Registers and initializes a new tracked asynchronous operation.
     * Allocates a unique task ID and triggers an immediate UI render.
     *
     * @param {string} label - The human-readable name of the task.
     * @returns {number} The uniquely allocated integer ID for the task.
     */
    start(label) {
        const id = ++this._nextId;
        this._tasks[id] = { label, progress: 0, startTime: performance.now(), detail: label };
        this._render();
        DIAG.action('PROGRESS', `Task #${id} started: ${label}`);
        return id;
    },

    /**
     * Pushes a progress increment to a specific running task.
     * Automatically clamps progress bounds between 0.0 and 1.0.
     *
     * @param {number} id - The task ID returned by `start()`.
     * @param {number} progress - A normalized float representing completion (0 to 1).
     * @param {string} [detail] - Optional contextual status string (e.g., "Downloading...").
     * @returns {void}
     */
    update(id, progress, detail) {
        if (!this._tasks[id]) return;
        this._tasks[id].progress = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, progress));
        if (detail) this._tasks[id].detail = detail;
        this._render();
    },

    /**
     * Marks a specific task as successfully completed. Forces progress to 100%,
     * logs the total execution time, and queues the task for visual cleanup after a delay.
     *
     * @param {number} id - The task ID.
     * @returns {void}
     */
    finish(id) {
        if (!this._tasks[id]) return;
        const task = this._tasks[id];
        const elapsed = ((performance.now() - task.startTime) / 1000).toFixed(1);
        task.progress = 1;
        this._render();
        DIAG.perf('PROGRESS', `Task #${id} finished: ${task.label}`, elapsed + 's');

        setTimeout(() => {
            delete this._tasks[id];
            this._render();
        }, 800);
    },

    /**
     * Marks a specific task as failed, triggering an error state in the UI.
     * Automatically purges the task after a delay to clear the progress bar.
     *
     * @param {number} id - The task ID.
     * @param {string} reason - The stringified error message or failure reason.
     * @returns {void}
     */
    fail(id, reason) {
        if (!this._tasks[id]) return;
        const task = this._tasks[id];
        DIAG.error('PROGRESS', `Task #${id} FAILED: ${task.label} — ${reason}`);
        if (this._barEl) this._barEl.classList.add('error');
        setTimeout(() => {
            delete this._tasks[id];
            if (this._barEl) this._barEl.classList.remove('error');
            this._render();
        }, 2000);
    },

    /**
     * Computes the aggregated progress of all active tasks and manipulates
     * the DOM to update the visual bar width and text readouts.
     *
     * @private
     * @returns {void}
     */
    _render() {
        if (!this._containerEl || !this._barEl) return;

        const taskIds = Object.keys(this._tasks);
        if (taskIds.length === 0) {
            this._containerEl.classList.remove('active');
            if (this._textEl) this._textEl.style.opacity = '0';
            return;
        }

        this._containerEl.classList.add('active');

        // Aggregate progress across all active tasks
        const totalProgress = taskIds.reduce((sum, id) => sum + this._tasks[id].progress, 0) / taskIds.length;
        this._barEl.style.width = (totalProgress * 100) + '%';

        // Show latest task detail
        const latest = this._tasks[taskIds[taskIds.length - 1]];
        if (this._textEl) {
            const pct = Math.round(totalProgress * 100);
            this._textEl.textContent = `${latest.detail} — ${pct}%`;
            this._textEl.style.opacity = '1';
        }
    },

    /**
     * Executes an HTTP fetch request augmented with continuous progress streaming.
     * Initiates a fake asymptotic ticker while awaiting server headers, then
     * switches to real byte-chunk accumulation using the `ReadableStream` API if supported.
     *
     * @async
     * @param {string} url - The target endpoint URL.
     * @param {Object} options - Standard `fetch` configuration options.
     * @param {number} taskId - The active task ID bound to this network request.
     * @param {number} [estimatedBytes] - Heuristic fallback size if `Content-Length` is missing.
     * @returns {Promise<{ok: boolean, status: number, data: string|null, json: Function}>} Resolves with the fetched payload object.
     */
    async fetchWithProgress(url, options, taskId, estimatedBytes) {
        let fakeProgress = 0.02;
        this.update(taskId, fakeProgress, 'Connecting...');
        
        // Start a smooth fake ticker while waiting for the server to process
        // (Overpass API can take 10s-30s just to build the response before sending headers)
        const fakeTicker = setInterval(() => {
            if (fakeProgress < 0.85) {
                // Asymptotic easing towards 85%
                const increment = (0.86 - fakeProgress) * 0.08;
                fakeProgress += increment;
                this.update(taskId, fakeProgress, 'Querying remote database...');
            }
        }, 800);

        let response;
        try {
            response = await fetch(url, options);
        } catch (err) {
            clearInterval(fakeTicker);
            throw err;
        } finally {
            clearInterval(fakeTicker);
        }

        if (!response.ok) {
            return { ok: false, status: response.status, data: null, json: () => null };
        }

        const contentLength = response.headers.get('content-length');
        const total = contentLength ? parseInt(contentLength) : (estimatedBytes || 0);

        if (!response.body || typeof response.body.getReader !== 'function') {
            // No streaming support — fallback
            this.update(taskId, 0.9, 'Downloading (no stream)...');
            const text = await response.text();
            this.update(taskId, 0.95, 'Parsing...');
            return { ok: true, status: response.status, data: text, json: () => JSON.parse(text) };
        }

        const reader = response.body.getReader();
        const chunks = [];
        let received = 0;

        // Force progress to 86% once streaming starts, then interpolate up to 98%
        let streamProgress = Math.max(fakeProgress, 0.86);

        while (true) {
            const { done, value } = await reader.read();
            if (done) break;
            chunks.push(value);
            received += value.length;

            if (total > 0) {
                // If we know total, map the remaining 14% to the stream
                const pct = streamProgress + ((received / total) * 0.12);
                const sizeMB = (received / 1048576).toFixed(1);
                const totalMB = (total / 1048576).toFixed(1);
                this.update(taskId, Math.min(0.98, pct), `${sizeMB} / ${totalMB} MB`);
            } else {
                // Indeterminate streaming progress
                streamProgress += (0.98 - streamProgress) * 0.1;
                const sizeKB = (received / 1024).toFixed(0);
                this.update(taskId, streamProgress, `${sizeKB} KB downloaded`);
            }
        }

        this.update(taskId, 0.99, 'Parsing response...');
        const blob = new Blob(chunks);
        const text = await blob.text();

        return {
            ok: true,
            status: response.status,
            data: text,
            json() { return JSON.parse(text); }
        };
    }
};


/* ===== js\traffic.js ===== */
/**
 * traffic.js — Live TfL telemetry and train simulation
 */

const TRAFFIC = {
    active: false,
    trains: [],
    group: L.layerGroup(),
    lastTime: 0,
    animationId: null,
    syncInterval: null
};

async function syncLiveTfL() {
    if (!TRAFFIC.active) return;
    // Use all TfL line IDs we know about, not just visible ones
    const allLineIds = typeof TUBE_LINES !== 'undefined' ? Object.keys(TUBE_LINES) : [];
    if (allLineIds.length === 0) return;

    try {
        // TfL Arrivals API accepts comma-separated line IDs
        const res = await fetch(`https://api.tfl.gov.uk/Line/${allLineIds.join(',')}/Arrivals`);
        if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`API ${res.status}`);
        const arrivals = await res.json();

        if (!Array.isArray(arrivals) || arrivals.length === 0) return;

        const vehicles = {};
        arrivals.forEach(a => {
            const vid = (a.vehicleId && a.vehicleId !== '00000') ? a.vehicleId : `ghost_${a.naptanId}_${Math.floor(a.timeToStation / 60)}`;
            // Include direction and destination in deduplication key to prevent ghost markers from switching tracks
            const direction = a.direction || 'unknown';
            const destination = a.destinationName || 'unknown';
            const dedupeKey = `${vid}_${direction}_${destination}`;
            
            if (!vehicles[dedupeKey]) vehicles[dedupeKey] = [];
            vehicles[dedupeKey].push(a);
        });

        Object.keys(vehicles).forEach(dedupeKey => {
            const predictions = vehicles[dedupeKey].sort((a, b) => a.timeToStation - b.timeToStation);
            const nextArrival = predictions[0];
            const futureArrival = predictions.length > 1 ? predictions[1] : null;

            let existing = TRAFFIC.trains.find(t => t.id === dedupeKey);
            if (!existing) {
                const lineConfig = TUBE_LINES[nextArrival.lineId];
                let strokeColor = lineConfig?.color || '#00bcd4';
                let fillColor = '#fff';
                let weight = 2;
                
                // High contrast logic for Northern Line (or any pure black line)
                if (strokeColor === '#000000' || strokeColor.toLowerCase() === '#000') {
                    strokeColor = '#ffffff'; // White ring
                    fillColor = '#000000';   // Black center
                    weight = 2.5;
                }

                const marker = L.circleMarker([0, 0], {
                    radius: 4.5, fillColor: fillColor, fillOpacity: 1,
                    color: strokeColor,
                    weight: weight, pane: 'markerPane'
                });
                marker.bindTooltip('', { className: 'tfl-tooltip', direction: 'top' });
                marker.addTo(TRAFFIC.group);

                existing = { id: dedupeKey, marker, lineId: nextArrival.lineId };
                existing.interpolationState = {
                    currentSegment: 0,
                    segmentProgress: 0,
                    branchIndex: -1,
                    pointIndex: -1
                };
                TRAFFIC.trains.push(existing);
            }

            existing.nextNaptan = nextArrival.naptanId;
            existing.futureNaptan = futureArrival ? futureArrival.naptanId : null;
            existing.timeToStation = nextArrival.timeToStation;
            existing.destinationName = nextArrival.destinationName;
            existing.lineName = TUBE_LINES[nextArrival.lineId]?.name || nextArrival.lineId;

            const pos = getRealTrainPosition(existing.lineId, existing.nextNaptan, existing.futureNaptan, existing.timeToStation);
            if (pos) existing.marker.setLatLng(pos);
        });

        TRAFFIC.trains = TRAFFIC.trains.filter(t => {
            if (!vehicles[t.id]) { t.marker.remove(); return false; }
            return true;
        });

        const statVehicles = document.getElementById('stat-vehicles');
        const statLoad = document.getElementById('stat-load');
        if (statVehicles) statVehicles.textContent = TRAFFIC.trains.length;
        if (statLoad) {
            const loadRatio = Math.min(100, Math.round((TRAFFIC.trains.length / 550) * 100));
            statLoad.textContent = loadRatio + '%';
            if (loadRatio > 85) statLoad.style.color = '#ff3232';
            else if (loadRatio > 60) statLoad.style.color = '#ffeb3b';
            else statLoad.style.color = '#00ff80';
        }
    } catch (err) {
        if (typeof Logger !== 'undefined') Logger.err("[LIVE] TfL Sync failed: " + err.message);
    }
}

function getRealTrainPosition(lineId, nextNaptan, futureNaptan, timeToStation) {
    if (!window.globalExportPayload) return null;
    const nextSt = window.globalExportPayload.data[lineId]?.stations.find(s => s.id === nextNaptan);
    if (!nextSt) return null;

    let bestDist = Infinity;
    let bIdx = -1, pIdx = -1;
    const branches = PHYSICAL_ROUTES[lineId] || [];

    branches.forEach((branch, b) => {
        branch.forEach((pt, p) => {
            const dist = (pt[0] - nextSt.lat) ** 2 + (pt[1] - nextSt.lon) ** 2;
            if (dist < bestDist) { bestDist = dist; bIdx = b; pIdx = p; }
        });
    });

    if (bIdx === -1) return [nextSt.lat, nextSt.lon];

    const branch = branches[bIdx];
    let backwardsStep = -1;

    if (futureNaptan) {
        const futSt = window.globalExportPayload.data[lineId]?.stations.find(s => s.id === futureNaptan);
        if (futSt) {
            const distPrev = pIdx > 0 ? (branch[pIdx - 1][0] - futSt.lat) ** 2 + (branch[pIdx - 1][1] - futSt.lon) ** 2 : Infinity;
            const distNext = pIdx < branch.length - 1 ? (branch[pIdx + 1][0] - futSt.lat) ** 2 + (branch[pIdx + 1][1] - futSt.lon) ** 2 : Infinity;
            backwardsStep = distNext < distPrev ? -1 : 1;
        }
    } else {
        backwardsStep = pIdx === 0 ? 1 : -1;
    }

    // Calculate total distance from current position to target station
    let totalDistanceToTarget = 0;
    let currIdx = pIdx;
    let targetIdx = pIdx;
    
    // Find the target station index in the branch
    for (let i = 0; i < branch.length; i++) {
        const dist = (branch[i][0] - nextSt.lat) ** 2 + (branch[i][1] - nextSt.lon) ** 2;
        if (dist < bestDist) {
            targetIdx = i;
            break;
        }
    }

    // Calculate distance from current position to target
    let tempIdx = currIdx;
    while (tempIdx !== targetIdx) {
        const nextIdx = tempIdx + (targetIdx > tempIdx ? 1 : -1);
        if (nextIdx < 0 || nextIdx >= branch.length) break;
        totalDistanceToTarget += calculateDistance(branch[tempIdx], branch[nextIdx]);
        tempIdx = nextIdx;
    }

    // Dynamic velocity calculation based on actual distance and API time
    const dynamicVelocity = totalDistanceToTarget > 0 ? (totalDistanceToTarget / timeToStation) : 12; // Fallback to 12 m/s if calculation fails
    let remainingMeters = timeToStation * dynamicVelocity;
    currIdx = pIdx;

    while (remainingMeters > 0) {
        const nextIdx = currIdx + backwardsStep;
        if (nextIdx < 0 || nextIdx >= branch.length) break;

        const dist = calculateDistance(branch[currIdx], branch[nextIdx]);
        if (remainingMeters <= dist && dist > 0) {
            // Linear interpolation (will be upgraded to cubic spline below)
            const ratio = remainingMeters / dist;
            return [
                branch[currIdx][0] + (branch[nextIdx][0] - branch[currIdx][0]) * ratio,
                branch[currIdx][1] + (branch[nextIdx][1] - branch[currIdx][1]) * ratio
            ];
        }
        remainingMeters -= dist;
        currIdx = nextIdx;
    }
    return branch[currIdx];
}

/**
 * Cubic Bezier interpolation for smooth train movement along track segments.
 * Provides diabolically smooth animation compared to linear interpolation.
 *
 * @param {Array<number>} p0 - Start point [lat, lon]
 * @param {Array<number>} p1 - Control point 1 [lat, lon]
 * @param {Array<number>} p2 - Control point 2 [lat, lon]
 * @param {Array<number>} p3 - End point [lat, lon]
 * @param {number} t - Interpolation parameter (0 to 1)
 * @returns {Array<number>} Interpolated point [lat, lon]
 */
function cubicBezierInterpolate(p0, p1, p2, p3, t) {
    const mt = 1 - t;
    const mt2 = mt * mt;
    const mt3 = mt2 * mt;
    const t2 = t * t;
    const t3 = t2 * t;

    return [
        mt3 * p0[0] + 3 * mt2 * t * p1[0] + 3 * mt * t2 * p2[0] + t3 * p3[0],
        mt3 * p0[1] + 3 * mt2 * t * p1[1] + 3 * mt * t2 * p2[1] + t3 * p3[1]
    ];
}

/**
 * Calculates control points for cubic Bezier spline interpolation along a track segment.
 * Uses the Catmull-Rom spline algorithm to generate smooth control points.
 *
 * @param {Array<number>} prev - Previous point [lat, lon]
 * @param {Array<number>} curr - Current point [lat, lon]
 * @param {Array<number>} next - Next point [lat, lon]
 * @param {Array<number>} nextNext - Next-next point [lat, lon]
 * @returns {Array<Array<number>>} Control points [p0, p1, p2, p3]
 */
function calculateBezierControlPoints(prev, curr, next, nextNext) {
    const tension = 0.5;
    
    // If we don't have enough points, use linear interpolation
    if (!prev || !next || !nextNext) {
        return [curr, curr, next, next];
    }

    // Catmull-Rom spline control points
    const p0 = prev;
    const p1 = curr;
    const p2 = next;
    const p3 = nextNext;

    const cp1x = p1[0] + (p2[0] - p0[0]) * tension / 6;
    const cp1y = p1[1] + (p2[1] - p0[1]) * tension / 6;

    const cp2x = p2[0] - (p3[0] - p1[0]) * tension / 6;
    const cp2y = p2[1] - (p3[1] - p1[1]) * tension / 6;

    return [p1, [cp1x, cp1y], [cp2x, cp2y], p2];
}

function animateAllTraffic(time) {
    if (!TRAFFIC.active) return;
    const dt = (time - TRAFFIC.lastTime) / 1000;
    TRAFFIC.lastTime = time;

    if (dt < 0.2 && dt > 0) {
        TRAFFIC.trains.forEach(t => {
            t.timeToStation -= dt;
            if (t.timeToStation < 0) t.timeToStation = 0;

            // Initialize interpolation state if not present
            if (!t.interpolationState) {
                t.interpolationState = {
                    currentSegment: 0,
                    segmentProgress: 0,
                    branchIndex: -1,
                    pointIndex: -1
                };
            }

            const pos = getSmoothTrainPosition(t, dt);
            if (pos) t.marker.setLatLng(pos);

            const tooltip = t.marker.getTooltip();
            if (tooltip) {
                tooltip.setContent(`<b>${t.lineName.toUpperCase()}</b><br>To: ${t.destinationName || 'Unknown'}<br>ETA: ${Math.floor(t.timeToStation / 60)}m ${Math.floor(t.timeToStation % 60)}s`);
            }
        });
    }
    TRAFFIC.animationId = requestAnimationFrame(animateAllTraffic);
}

/**
 * Calculates smooth train position using cubic Bezier interpolation.
 * Provides diabolically smooth animation along track segments.
 *
 * @param {Object} train - Train object with interpolation state
 * @param {number} dt - Delta time in seconds
 * @returns {Array<number>} Smoothed position [lat, lon]
 */
function getSmoothTrainPosition(train, dt) {
    const lineId = train.lineId;
    const nextNaptan = train.nextNaptan;
    const futureNaptan = train.futureNaptan;
    const timeToStation = train.timeToStation;

    if (!window.globalExportPayload) return null;
    const nextSt = window.globalExportPayload.data[lineId]?.stations.find(s => s.id === nextNaptan);
    if (!nextSt) return null;

    let bestDist = Infinity;
    let bIdx = -1, pIdx = -1;
    const branches = PHYSICAL_ROUTES[lineId] || [];

    branches.forEach((branch, b) => {
        branch.forEach((pt, p) => {
            const dist = (pt[0] - nextSt.lat) ** 2 + (pt[1] - nextSt.lon) ** 2;
            if (dist < bestDist) { bestDist = dist; bIdx = b; pIdx = p; }
        });
    });

    if (bIdx === -1) return [nextSt.lat, nextSt.lon];

    const branch = branches[bIdx];
    const interpState = train.interpolationState;

    // Update branch and point indices if they've changed
    if (interpState.branchIndex !== bIdx || interpState.pointIndex !== pIdx) {
        interpState.branchIndex = bIdx;
        interpState.pointIndex = pIdx;
        interpState.currentSegment = 0;
        interpState.segmentProgress = 0;
    }

    // Calculate total distance from current position to target station
    let totalDistanceToTarget = 0;
    let targetIdx = pIdx;
    
    for (let i = 0; i < branch.length; i++) {
        const dist = (branch[i][0] - nextSt.lat) ** 2 + (branch[i][1] - nextSt.lon) ** 2;
        if (dist < bestDist) {
            targetIdx = i;
            break;
        }
    }

    // Calculate distance from current position to target
    let tempIdx = interpState.pointIndex;
    while (tempIdx !== targetIdx) {
        const nextIdx = tempIdx + (targetIdx > tempIdx ? 1 : -1);
        if (nextIdx < 0 || nextIdx >= branch.length) break;
        totalDistanceToTarget += calculateDistance(branch[tempIdx], branch[nextIdx]);
        tempIdx = nextIdx;
    }

    // Dynamic velocity calculation
    const dynamicVelocity = totalDistanceToTarget > 0 ? (totalDistanceToTarget / timeToStation) : 12;
    const distanceToTravel = dt * dynamicVelocity;

    // Move along the track using cubic Bezier interpolation
    let remainingDistance = distanceToTravel;
    let currIdx = interpState.pointIndex;
    
    while (remainingDistance > 0 && currIdx >= 0 && currIdx < branch.length - 1) {
        const prevIdx = currIdx > 0 ? currIdx - 1 : currIdx;
        const nextIdx = currIdx + 1;
        const nextNextIdx = nextIdx < branch.length - 1 ? nextIdx + 1 : nextIdx;

        const segmentDist = calculateDistance(branch[currIdx], branch[nextIdx]);
        
        if (remainingDistance <= segmentDist) {
            // Interpolate within current segment using cubic Bezier
            const t = remainingDistance / segmentDist;
            const controlPoints = calculateBezierControlPoints(
                branch[prevIdx],
                branch[currIdx],
                branch[nextIdx],
                branch[nextNextIdx]
            );
            
            const smoothPos = cubicBezierInterpolate(
                controlPoints[0],
                controlPoints[1],
                controlPoints[2],
                controlPoints[3],
                t
            );
            
            interpState.segmentProgress = t;
            return smoothPos;
        }
        
        remainingDistance -= segmentDist;
        currIdx = nextIdx;
        interpState.pointIndex = currIdx;
        interpState.currentSegment++;
        interpState.segmentProgress = 0;
    }

    return branch[currIdx];
}

// Legacy button binding (toolbar.js now handles this via tb-btn-traffic)
const _legacyTrafficBtn = document.getElementById('btn-live-traffic');
if (_legacyTrafficBtn) {
    _legacyTrafficBtn.onclick = (e) => {
        TRAFFIC.active = !TRAFFIC.active;
        const btn = e.target;

        if (TRAFFIC.active) {
            btn.classList.add('active');
            btn.textContent = 'Stop Live Data';
            TRAFFIC.group.addTo(map);
            syncLiveTfL();
            TRAFFIC.syncInterval = setInterval(syncLiveTfL, 20000);
            TRAFFIC.lastTime = performance.now();
            TRAFFIC.animationId = requestAnimationFrame(animateAllTraffic);
            Logger.log("[LIVE] Connected to true TfL vehicle streams.");
        } else {
            btn.classList.remove('active');
            btn.textContent = 'Simulate Traffic';
            map.removeLayer(TRAFFIC.group);
            cancelAnimationFrame(TRAFFIC.animationId);
            clearInterval(TRAFFIC.syncInterval);
            TRAFFIC.syncInterval = null;
            showToast("Live Tracker Offline.", "info");
        }
    };
}

// Expose start/stop for toolbar.js
TRAFFIC.startSimulation = function() {
    TRAFFIC.active = true;
    TRAFFIC.group.addTo(map);
    syncLiveTfL();
    TRAFFIC.syncInterval = setInterval(syncLiveTfL, 20000);
    TRAFFIC.lastTime = performance.now();
    TRAFFIC.animationId = requestAnimationFrame(animateAllTraffic);
    Logger.log("[LIVE] Connected to true TfL vehicle streams.");
};
TRAFFIC.stopSimulation = function() {
    TRAFFIC.active = false;
    if (typeof map !== 'undefined') map.removeLayer(TRAFFIC.group);
    cancelAnimationFrame(TRAFFIC.animationId);
    clearInterval(TRAFFIC.syncInterval);
    TRAFFIC.syncInterval = null;
    if (typeof showToast !== 'undefined') showToast("Live Tracker Offline.", "info");
};


/* ===== js\ui.js ===== */
/**
 * ui.js — Toast notifications, modal system, logger, and status grid
 */

/**
 * Shows a premium confirmation modal with animated transitions.
 * Returns a Promise that resolves to true (confirmed) or false (cancelled).
 *
 * @param {string} title - The title text.
 * @param {string} description - The description text.
 * @param {string} [confirmText='Destroy'] - The text for the confirm button.
 * @param {string} [icon='fa-exclamation-triangle'] - FontAwesome icon class.
 * @returns {Promise<boolean>}
 */
function showConfirmModal(title, description, confirmText = 'Destroy', icon = 'fa-exclamation-triangle') {
    return new Promise(resolve => {
        const overlay = document.getElementById('confirm-modal');
        if (!overlay) { resolve(confirm(title)); return; }

        const titleEl = document.getElementById('confirm-modal-title');
        const descEl = document.getElementById('confirm-modal-desc');
        const okBtn = document.getElementById('confirm-modal-ok');
        const cancelBtn = document.getElementById('confirm-modal-cancel');
        const iconEl = document.getElementById('confirm-modal-icon');

        if (titleEl) titleEl.textContent = title;
        if (descEl) descEl.textContent = description;
        if (okBtn) okBtn.textContent = confirmText;
        if (iconEl) iconEl.innerHTML = `<i class="fas ${icon}"></i>`;

        overlay.classList.add('active');

        const cleanup = (result) => {
            overlay.classList.remove('active');
            okBtn.removeEventListener('click', onOk);
            cancelBtn.removeEventListener('click', onCancel);
            overlay.removeEventListener('click', onBackdrop);
            document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
            resolve(result);
        };

        const onOk = () => cleanup(true);
        const onCancel = () => cleanup(false);
        const onBackdrop = (e) => { if (e.target === overlay) cleanup(false); };
        const onKey = (e) => { 
            if (e.key === 'Escape') cleanup(false); 
            if (e.key === 'Enter') cleanup(true);
        };

        okBtn.addEventListener('click', onOk);
        cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', onCancel);
        overlay.addEventListener('click', onBackdrop);
        document.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    });
}
/**
 * Spawns a temporary, auto-dismissing toast notification on the screen.
 *
 * @param {string} message - The text content to display.
 * @param {string} [type='info'] - The severity class ('info', 'success', 'warn', 'error').
 * @returns {void}
 */
function showToast(message, type = 'info') {
    const container = document.getElementById('toast-container');
    const toast = document.createElement('div');
    toast.className = `toast ${type}`;
    toast.textContent = message;
    container.appendChild(toast);
    
    void toast.offsetWidth;
    toast.classList.add('show');
    
    setTimeout(() => {
        toast.classList.remove('show');
        setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 400);
    }, 4000);
}

/**
 * Creates a persistent toast with an animated progress bar.
 * Returns an object with update(progress, msg) and finish(msg) methods.
 */
function showProgressToast(label) {
    const container = document.getElementById('toast-container');
    const toast = document.createElement('div');
    toast.className = 'toast info';
    toast.style.cssText = 'min-width:280px;';
    toast.innerHTML = `
        <div style="font-weight:600;font-size:12px;margin-bottom:6px;">${label}</div>
        <div style="background:rgba(255,255,255,0.1);border-radius:4px;height:6px;overflow:hidden;">
            <div class="pbar" style="height:100%;width:0%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#00ffff,#00e5ff);border-radius:4px;transition:width 0.3s ease;"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="plabel" style="font-size:10px;color:#aaa;margin-top:4px;">Starting...</div>
    `;
    container.appendChild(toast);
    void toast.offsetWidth;
    toast.classList.add('show');
    
    const bar = toast.querySelector('.pbar');
    const plabel = toast.querySelector('.plabel');
    
    return {
        update(pct, msg) {
            bar.style.width = Math.min(100, Math.round(pct * 100)) + '%';
            if (msg) plabel.textContent = msg;
        },
        finish(msg) {
            bar.style.width = '100%';
            bar.style.background = 'linear-gradient(90deg,#4caf50,#66bb6a)';
            plabel.textContent = msg || 'Done!';
            setTimeout(() => {
                toast.classList.remove('show');
                setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 400);
            }, 2000);
        },
        fail(msg) {
            bar.style.background = '#f44336';
            plabel.textContent = msg || 'Failed';
            setTimeout(() => {
                toast.classList.remove('show');
                setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 400);
            }, 4000);
        }
    };
}

let pendingStationCallback = null;

/**
 * Opens the global modal for editing a station's name, capturing the user's focus
 * and awaiting a confirmation callback.
 *
 * @param {string} defaultName - The current station name to pre-fill.
 * @param {Function} callback - The function to execute with the new string upon confirmation.
 * @returns {void}
 */
function openStationModal(defaultName, callback) {
    const modal = document.getElementById('station-modal');
    const input = document.getElementById('station-name-input');
    input.value = defaultName || '';
    pendingStationCallback = callback;
    modal.classList.add('active');
    input.focus();
    input.select();
}

/**
 * Closes the station editing modal and nullifies any pending callbacks.
 *
 * @returns {void}
 */
function closeStationModal() {
    const modal = document.getElementById('station-modal');
    modal.classList.remove('active');
    pendingStationCallback = null;
}

document.getElementById('btn-confirm-station').onclick = () => {
    if (pendingStationCallback) {
        const val = document.getElementById('station-name-input').value.trim();
        if (val) {
            pendingStationCallback(val);
            closeStationModal();
        } else {
            showToast("Station name cannot be empty.", "error");
        }
    }
};

document.getElementById('station-name-input').addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault();
        document.getElementById('btn-confirm-station').click();
    }
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        e.preventDefault();
        closeStationModal();
    }
});

/**
 * Console logging facade that duplicates logs to a visible DOM element for debugging.
 * @namespace
 */
const Logger = {
    dom: document.getElementById('log-content'),
    pinned: false,
    log(msg) { this._p(msg, 'log-info'); console.log(msg); },
    warn(msg) { this._p(msg, 'log-warn'); console.warn(msg); },
    err(msg) { this._p(msg, 'log-error'); console.error(msg); },
    _p(msg, cls) {
        if (!this.dom) return;
        const div = document.createElement('div'); div.className = cls;
        div.textContent = `[${new Date().toISOString().substring(11, 23)}] ${msg}`;
        this.dom.appendChild(div);
        this.dom.scrollTop = this.dom.scrollHeight;
    },
    getRawText() { return Array.from(this.dom.childNodes).map(n => n.innerText).join('\n'); }
};


/**
 * Core UI initialization and state management object.
 * @namespace
 */
const UI = {
    /**
     * Bootstraps the secondary UI components, primarily the status grid
     * and complex legend interactions (search, sort, pin).
     *
     * @returns {void}
     */
    init() {
        const grid = document.getElementById('status-grid'); grid.innerHTML = '';
        Object.keys(TUBE_LINES).forEach(id => {
            grid.innerHTML += `<div class="status-row" id="st-${id}"><span class="status-name" title="${TUBE_LINES[id].name}">${TUBE_LINES[id].name}</span><span class="status-badge status-pending">Wait</span></div>`;
        });

        // Setup Tabs
        const tabCore = document.getElementById('tab-core');
        const tabCustom = document.getElementById('tab-custom');
        const paneCore = document.getElementById('legend-items');
        const paneCustom = document.getElementById('legend-items-custom');
        const btnClearCustom = document.getElementById('btn-clear-custom');

        if (tabCore && tabCustom) {
            tabCore.onclick = () => {
                tabCore.classList.add('active');
                tabCustom.classList.remove('active');
                paneCore.classList.add('active');
                paneCustom.classList.remove('active');
                if (btnClearCustom) btnClearCustom.style.display = 'none';
            };
            tabCustom.onclick = () => {
                tabCustom.classList.add('active');
                tabCore.classList.remove('active');
                paneCustom.classList.add('active');
                paneCore.classList.remove('active');
                if (btnClearCustom) btnClearCustom.style.display = 'block';
            };
        }

        const btnLegendSort = document.getElementById('btn-legend-sort');
        if (btnLegendSort) {
            btnLegendSort.onclick = () => {
                UI.sortAlphabetical = !UI.sortAlphabetical;
                btnLegendSort.classList.toggle('active', UI.sortAlphabetical);
                UI.refreshLegend();
            };
        }

        if (btnClearCustom) {
            btnClearCustom.onclick = async () => {
                const confirmed = await showConfirmModal(
                    'Destroy All Custom Lines?',
                    'This will permanently erase all AI-generated networks, custom lines, and free stations. This cannot be undone.',
                    'Destroy All',
                    'fa-skull-crossbones'
                );
                if (!confirmed) return;

                    try { localStorage.removeItem(SYSTEM.CACHE_KEY); } catch(err){}
                    try { localStorage.removeItem(SYSTEM.CACHE_KEY + '_stations'); } catch(err){}
                    try { localStorage.removeItem('tfl_free_stations'); } catch(err){}
                    try { if (typeof setIndexedDBCache === 'function') setIndexedDBCache('USER_ADDITIONS', {}); } catch(err){}

                    if (typeof showToast !== 'undefined') showToast("All custom configurations purged. Resetting UI...", "success");
                    
                    // Hard purge using location.reload for guaranteed absolute destruction
                    if (typeof showToast !== 'undefined') showToast("All custom configurations purged. Reloading...", "success");
                    setTimeout(() => location.reload(), 500);
            };
        }

        // Setup Search and Sort Engine
        const searchInput = document.getElementById('legend-search');
        const sortBtn = document.getElementById('btn-legend-sort');
        let sortMode = 'Default';

        const applySearchSort = () => {
            const query = searchInput.value.toLowerCase().trim();
            [paneCore, paneCustom].forEach(pane => {
                let items = Array.from(pane.querySelectorAll('.legend-item-container'));
                
                // Filtering
                items.forEach(item => {
                    const name = item.querySelector('.legend-name').textContent.toLowerCase();
                    item.style.display = name.includes(query) ? 'block' : 'none';
                });

                // Sorting
                if (sortMode === 'A-Z' || sortMode === 'Z-A') {
                    items.sort((a, b) => {
                        const nameA = a.querySelector('.legend-name').textContent.toLowerCase();
                        const nameB = b.querySelector('.legend-name').textContent.toLowerCase();
                        return sortMode === 'A-Z' ? nameA.localeCompare(nameB) : nameB.localeCompare(nameA);
                    });
                    items.forEach(item => pane.appendChild(item));
                }
            });
        };

        if (searchInput) searchInput.addEventListener('keyup', applySearchSort);
        if (sortBtn) {
            sortBtn.onclick = () => {
                if (sortMode === 'Default') sortMode = 'A-Z';
                else if (sortMode === 'A-Z') sortMode = 'Z-A';
                else sortMode = 'Default';
                
                sortBtn.textContent = sortMode === 'Default' ? 'Sort' : sortMode;
                if (sortMode === 'Default') {
                    sortMode = 'A-Z';
                    sortBtn.textContent = 'A-Z';
                }
                applySearchSort();
            };
        }
        
        // Setup Pin Legend
        const pinBtn = document.getElementById('btn-pin-legend');
        if (pinBtn) {
            pinBtn.onclick = () => {
                const legend = document.getElementById('legend');
                if (legend) {
                    legend.classList.toggle('pinned');
                    pinBtn.style.background = legend.classList.contains('pinned') ? 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)' : 'transparent';
                    if(typeof showToast !== 'undefined') showToast(legend.classList.contains('pinned') ? "Legend pinned open." : "Legend unpinned.", "info");
                }
            };
        }

        // Setup Disruption Matrix Dropdown
        const healthBtn = document.getElementById('network-health');
        const detailsDropdown = document.getElementById('disruption-details-list');
        if (healthBtn && detailsDropdown) {
            healthBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                detailsDropdown.classList.toggle('hidden');
            });
            document.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                if (!detailsDropdown.contains(e.target) && e.target !== healthBtn) {
                    detailsDropdown.classList.add('hidden');
                }
            });
        }
    },
    
    // Fallback stub for legacy calls
    updateDiagnostic: () => {},

    /**
     * Updates the text and color state of a specific line's badge in the status grid.
     */
    set(id, status, text) {
        const b = document.querySelector(`#st-${id} .status-badge`);
        if (b) { b.className = `status-badge status-${status}`; b.textContent = text; }
    },
    
    /**
     * Constructs a single legend item with nested station dropdowns and fly-to functionality.
     */
    buildLegendItem(id, config, lineData) {
        const legCore = document.getElementById('legend-items');
        const legCustom = document.getElementById('legend-items-custom');
        const leg = (config.isNew || config.isCustom || id.startsWith('ai_')) ? legCustom : legCore;
        if (!leg) return;

        let div = leg.querySelector(`[data-line-id="${id}"]`);
        if (!div) {
            div = document.createElement('div');
            div.className = 'legend-item-container';
            div.dataset.lineId = id;
            div.style.marginBottom = '4px';
            leg.appendChild(div);
        }

        let stationsHtml = '';
        if (lineData && lineData.stations && lineData.stations.length > 0) {
            // Find interchanges (stations shared with other lines)
            const interchanges = new Set();
            if (window.globalExportPayload && window.globalExportPayload.data) {
                lineData.stations.forEach(st => {
                    let count = 0;
                    Object.values(window.globalExportPayload.data).forEach(l => {
                        if (l.stations && l.stations.some(s => s.id === st.id)) count++;
                    });
                    if (count > 1) interchanges.add(st.id);
                });
            }

            let sortedStations = [...lineData.stations];
            if (UI.sortAlphabetical) {
                sortedStations.sort((a,b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
            } else if (lineData.routes) {
                let orderedStations = [];
                let seenStations = new Set();
                lineData.routes.forEach(branch => {
                    branch.forEach(coord => {
                        let st = sortedStations.find(s => 
                            Math.abs(s.lat - coord[0]) < 0.0001 && 
                            Math.abs(s.lon - coord[1]) < 0.0001
                        );
                        if (st && !seenStations.has(st.id)) {
                            orderedStations.push(st);
                            seenStations.add(st.id);
                        }
                    });
                });
                sortedStations.forEach(st => {
                    if (!seenStations.has(st.id)) orderedStations.push(st);
                });
                sortedStations = orderedStations;
            }

            stationsHtml = sortedStations.map(st => {
                const isInt = interchanges.has(st.id);
                const weight = isInt ? '800' : '400';
                const color = isInt ? '#ffffff' : '#cccccc';
                const icon = isInt ? '<i class="fas fa-random" style="font-size:9px; margin-right:5px; color:#ffcc00;"></i>' : '<i class="fas fa-bullseye" style="font-size:8px; margin-right:5px;"></i>';
                return `
                <div class="legend-station-item" data-lat="${st.lat}" data-lon="${st.lon}" style="padding: 5px 10px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: ${weight}; color: ${color}; cursor: pointer; border-left: 3px solid ${config.color}; margin-left: 12px; transition: background 0.2s;">
                    ${icon}${st.name} ${isInt ? '<span style="color:#ffcc00; font-size:9px; margin-left:4px;">(Interchange)</span>' : ''}
                </div>
                `;
            }).join('');
        }

        div.innerHTML = `
            <div class="legend-item" style="display:flex; align-items:center; position:relative; padding:4px 0;">
                <div class="legend-color" style="background:${config.color}; cursor:pointer;"></div>
                <div class="legend-name" style="color:${config.color}; flex-grow:1; cursor:pointer; font-weight:700;">${config.name}</div>
                <div style="display:flex; gap:6px; position:relative; z-index:10; align-items:center;">
                    ${stationsHtml ? `<button class="leg-expand-btn" style="background:transparent; border:1px solid #555; color:#fff; border-radius:4px; cursor:pointer; font-size:10px; padding:2px 6px;"><i class="fas fa-chevron-down"></i> STATIONS</button>` : ''}
                    <button class="leg-edit-btn" style="background:#444;border:none;color:#fff;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font-size:10px;padding:2px 6px;">EDIT</button>
                    <button class="leg-del-btn" style="background:#d32f2f;border:none;color:#fff;border-radius:4px;cursor:pointer;font-size:10px;padding:2px 6px;">DEL</button>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div class="legend-stations-dropdown" style="display:none; max-height: 250px; overflow-y: auto; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.3); margin-top: 4px; border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 0;">
                ${stationsHtml}
            </div>
        `;

        const toggleVisibility = () => {
            try {
                const lInfo = mapLayers.lines[id];
                if (!lInfo) return;
                lInfo.active = !lInfo.active;
                div.querySelector('.legend-item').classList.toggle('disabled', !lInfo.active);
                lInfo.active ? map.addLayer(lInfo.group) : map.removeLayer(lInfo.group);
                mapLayers.hubs.forEach(h => {
                    const anyActive = h.lines.some(lId => mapLayers.lines[lId] && mapLayers.lines[lId].active);
                    anyActive ? map.addLayer(h.marker) : map.removeLayer(h.marker);
                });
            } catch(e) { console.error("Legend toggle failed:", e); }
        };

        div.querySelector('.legend-name').onclick = toggleVisibility;
        div.querySelector('.legend-color').onclick = toggleVisibility;

        const expandBtn = div.querySelector('.leg-expand-btn');
        if (expandBtn) {
            expandBtn.onclick = (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                const dropdown = div.querySelector('.legend-stations-dropdown');
                const isHidden = dropdown.style.display === 'none';
                dropdown.style.display = isHidden ? 'block' : 'none';
                expandBtn.innerHTML = isHidden ? '<i class="fas fa-chevron-up"></i> HIDE' : '<i class="fas fa-chevron-down"></i> STATIONS';
                expandBtn.style.background = isHidden ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)' : 'transparent';
            };
        }

        const stItems = div.querySelectorAll('.legend-station-item');
        stItems.forEach(stItem => {
            stItem.onclick = (e) => {
                e.stopPropagation();
                if (typeof map !== 'undefined') {
                    map.flyTo([stItem.dataset.lat, stItem.dataset.lon], 16, { animate: true, duration: 1.5 });
                }
            };
            stItem.onmouseover = () => { stItem.style.background = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.1)'; };
            stItem.onmouseout = () => { stItem.style.background = 'transparent'; };
        });

        div.querySelector('.leg-edit-btn').onclick = (e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            if (typeof CONSTRUCTION !== 'undefined' && CONSTRUCTION.active) {
                if (typeof showToast !== 'undefined') showToast("Finish current drawing first.", "warn");
                return;
            }
            if (typeof editLine === 'function') editLine(id);
        };

        div.querySelector('.leg-del-btn').onclick = async (e) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
            const confirmed = await showConfirmModal(
                `Destroy ${config.name}?`,
                `This will permanently remove the ${config.name} line and all its stations from the map.`,
                'Destroy',
                'fa-trash-alt'
            );
            if (!confirmed) return;
                if (window.globalExportPayload && window.globalExportPayload.data) {
                    delete window.globalExportPayload.data[id];
                    try { localStorage.setItem(SYSTEM.CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(window.globalExportPayload)); } catch(err){}
                }
                if (typeof TUBE_LINES !== 'undefined') delete TUBE_LINES[id];
                if (mapLayers.lines[id] && mapLayers.lines[id].group) map.removeLayer(mapLayers.lines[id].group);
                mapLayers.hubs.forEach(h => map.removeLayer(h.marker));
                mapLayers.hubs = [];
                if (mapLayers.labels) mapLayers.labels.clearLayers();
                if (typeof renderNetwork === 'function') renderNetwork(window.globalExportPayload.data);
                div.remove();
                if (typeof showToast !== 'undefined') showToast(`${config.name} destroyed.`, "success");
        };
    }
};

/**
 * Opens the TfL-Go style bottom sheet for station details and AI diagnostics.
 * @param {Object} st - The station object.
 * @param {Object} config - The line configuration object.
 */
window.openStationBottomSheet = function(st, config) {
    const sheet = document.getElementById('station-bottom-sheet');
    if (!sheet) return;

    document.getElementById('sheet-station-name').textContent = st.name || 'Unknown Station';
    document.getElementById('sheet-station-status').textContent = (config && (config.isNew || config.isCustom)) ? 'Proposed AI Intervention' : 'Existing Station';
    document.getElementById('sheet-station-status').style.color = config ? config.color : '#00ffff';
    document.getElementById('sheet-station-status').style.borderColor = config ? config.color : '#00ffff';

    const diag = st.aiDiagnostic;
    let customRationale = '';
    if (config && config.rationale) customRationale += `<div style="margin-bottom:8px;"><strong>Line Strategy:</strong><br>${config.rationale}</div>`;
    if (st.rationale) customRationale += `<div><strong>Station Placement:</strong><br>${st.rationale}</div>`;

    if (customRationale) {
        document.getElementById('sheet-pop-uplift').textContent = 'N/A';
        document.getElementById('sheet-land-type').textContent = 'N/A';
        document.getElementById('sheet-eng-cost').textContent = 'N/A';
        document.getElementById('sheet-land-cost').textContent = 'N/A';
        
        document.getElementById('sheet-ai-rationale').innerHTML = customRationale;
        const scoreFill = document.getElementById('sheet-score-fill');
        if (scoreFill && scoreFill.parentElement) scoreFill.parentElement.style.display = 'none';
        
        document.querySelector('.ai-diagnostic-section').style.display = 'block';
    } else if (diag) {
        document.getElementById('sheet-pop-uplift').textContent = Math.round(diag.popUplift).toLocaleString();
        document.getElementById('sheet-land-type').textContent = (diag.landType || 'unknown').toUpperCase();
        document.getElementById('sheet-eng-cost').textContent = diag.engineeringCost.toFixed(2) + 'x';
        document.getElementById('sheet-land-cost').textContent = diag.landCost.toFixed(2) + 'x';
        
        const isIdeal = diag.landCost <= 1.0;
        document.getElementById('sheet-ai-rationale').innerHTML = `
            This station was systematically placed by the AI solver to eliminate a structural coverage gap in this borough. 
            <br><br>
            It achieved a <strong>Benefit/Cost ratio of ${diag.score.toFixed(2)}</strong>. 
            ${isIdeal ? 'It is ideally situated on low-friction land (Brownfield/Industrial/Rail).' : 'It incurred high land-acquisition penalties due to proximity to private property or green space.'}
        `;
        
        // Max score visually is capped at 50 for the bar
        const fillPct = Math.min(100, Math.max(5, (diag.score / 50) * 100));
        const scoreFill = document.getElementById('sheet-score-fill');
        if (scoreFill) {
            scoreFill.style.width = fillPct + '%';
            if (scoreFill.parentElement) scoreFill.parentElement.style.display = 'block';
        }
        
        document.querySelector('.ai-diagnostic-section').style.display = 'block';
    } else {
        document.getElementById('sheet-pop-uplift').textContent = 'N/A';
        document.getElementById('sheet-land-type').textContent = 'EXISTING';
        document.getElementById('sheet-eng-cost').textContent = '0.00x';
        document.getElementById('sheet-land-cost').textContent = '0.00x';
        document.querySelector('.ai-diagnostic-section').style.display = 'none';
    }

    sheet.classList.remove('hidden');
};

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const btnClose = document.getElementById('btn-close-sheet');
    if (btnClose) {
        btnClose.onclick = () => {
            document.getElementById('station-bottom-sheet').classList.add('hidden');
        };
    }
});

// ===== DIABOLICAL ERROR INTERCEPTOR =====
const EXTREME_ERROR_CATCHER = {
    init() {
        const originalError = console.error;
        const originalWarn = console.warn;
        
        console.error = function(...args) {
            originalError.call(console, '🚨 [DIABOLICAL TRAP: CONSOLE.ERROR]', ...args);
        };
        
        // console.warn interceptor removed to prevent spam during expected HTTP 504 fallbacks

        window.addEventListener('error', (e) => {
            originalError.call(console, `🚨 [DIABOLICAL TRAP: UNHANDLED ERROR] ${e.message}`, '\nSource:', e.filename, 'Line:', e.lineno, '\nStack:', e.error?.stack);
        });

        window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection', (e) => {
            originalError.call(console, `🚨 [DIABOLICAL TRAP: PROMISE REJECTION] ${e.reason?.message || e.reason}`, '\nStack:', e.reason?.stack);
        });
    }
};
EXTREME_ERROR_CATCHER.init();

const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));

// ===== STRICT VALIDATION (Self-Healing) =====
function isValidCoordPair(p) {
    return Array.isArray(p) && p.length === 2 && 
           Number.isFinite(p[0]) && Number.isFinite(p[1]) && 
           p[0] >= -90 && p[0] <= 90 && p[1] >= -180 && p[1] <= 180;
}

function isValidBranch(branch) {
    return Array.isArray(branch) && branch.length >= 2 && branch.every(isValidCoordPair);
}

function isValidLinePayload(line) {
    return line && Array.isArray(line.routes) && line.routes.length > 0 && 
           line.routes.every(isValidBranch) &&
           Array.isArray(line.stations) && 
           line.stations.every(st => typeof st.id === 'string' && Number.isFinite(st.lat));
}

function validateWrappedPayload(payload) {
    if (!payload || payload._version !== SYSTEM.CACHE_KEY || !payload.data) {
        Logger.err("[VALIDATION] Schema check failed. Triggering self-heal.");
        return false;
    }
    let validCount = 0;
    Object.keys(TUBE_LINES).forEach(id => {
        if (payload.data[id] && isValidLinePayload(payload.data[id])) validCount++;
    });
    if (validCount >= (Object.keys(TUBE_LINES).length * 0.3)) {
        Logger.log(`[VALIDATION] Success. ${validCount} lines physically intact.`);
        return true;
    }
    Logger.err(`[VALIDATION FATAL] Cache poisoned. Discarding.`);
    return false;
}

// ===== MATH UTILS =====
function calculateDistance(p1, p2) {
    // Approx distance in meters
    const dx = (p2[1] - p1[1]) * 71500;
    const dy = (p2[0] - p1[0]) * 111300;
    return Math.sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy);
}

// ===== INDEXED DB CACHING WRAPPER =====
function getIndexedDBCache(key) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const request = indexedDB.open("LondonTransitDB", 1);
        request.onupgradeneeded = (e) => {
            const db = e.target.result;
            if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains('cache')) db.createObjectStore('cache');
        };
        request.onsuccess = (e) => {
            const db = e.target.result;
            if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains('cache')) { resolve(null); return; }
            const tx = db.transaction('cache', 'readonly');
            const store = tx.objectStore('cache');
            const getReq = store.get(key);
            getReq.onsuccess = () => resolve(getReq.result);
            getReq.onerror = () => reject(getReq.error);
        };
        request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
    });
}

function setIndexedDBCache(key, value) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const request = indexedDB.open("LondonTransitDB", 1);
        request.onupgradeneeded = (e) => {
            const db = e.target.result;
            if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains('cache')) db.createObjectStore('cache');
        };
        request.onsuccess = (e) => {
            const db = e.target.result;
            const tx = db.transaction('cache', 'readwrite');
            const store = tx.objectStore('cache');
            const putReq = store.put(value, key);
            putReq.onsuccess = () => resolve();
            putReq.onerror = () => reject(putReq.error);
        };
        request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
    });
}

// @ts-nocheck
// Copyright 2018-2025 the Deno authors. MIT license.
// Copyright the Browserify authors. MIT License.
function assertPath(path) {
  if (typeof path !== "string") {
    throw new TypeError(`Path must be a string, received "${JSON.stringify(path)}"`);
  }
}

// Copyright 2018-2025 the Deno authors. MIT license.
// This module is browser compatible.
function stripSuffix(name, suffix) {
  if (suffix.length >= name.length) {
    return name;
  }
  const lenDiff = name.length - suffix.length;
  for(let i = suffix.length - 1; i >= 0; --i){
    if (name.charCodeAt(lenDiff + i) !== suffix.charCodeAt(i)) {
      return name;
    }
  }
  return name.slice(0, -suffix.length);
}
function lastPathSegment(path, isSep, start = 0) {
  let matchedNonSeparator = false;
  let end = path.length;
  for(let i = path.length - 1; i >= start; --i){
    if (isSep(path.charCodeAt(i))) {
      if (matchedNonSeparator) {
        start = i + 1;
        break;
      }
    } else if (!matchedNonSeparator) {
      matchedNonSeparator = true;
      end = i + 1;
    }
  }
  return path.slice(start, end);
}
function assertArgs$1(path, suffix) {
  assertPath(path);
  if (path.length === 0) return path;
  if (typeof suffix !== "string") {
    throw new TypeError(`Suffix must be a string, received "${JSON.stringify(suffix)}"`);
  }
}

// Copyright 2018-2025 the Deno authors. MIT license.
// This module is browser compatible.
function assertArg$3(url) {
  url = url instanceof URL ? url : new URL(url);
  if (url.protocol !== "file:") {
    throw new TypeError(`URL must be a file URL: received "${url.protocol}"`);
  }
  return url;
}

// Copyright 2018-2025 the Deno authors. MIT license.
// This module is browser compatible.
/**
 * Converts a file URL to a path string.
 *
 * @example Usage
 * ```ts
 * import { fromFileUrl } from "@std/path/posix/from-file-url";
 * import { assertEquals } from "@std/assert";
 *
 * assertEquals(fromFileUrl(new URL("file:///home/foo")), "/home/foo");
 * ```
 *
 * @param url The file URL to convert.
 * @returns The path string.
 */ function fromFileUrl(url) {
  url = assertArg$3(url);
  return decodeURIComponent(url.pathname.replace(/%(?![0-9A-Fa-f]{2})/g, "%25"));
}

// Copyright 2018-2025 the Deno authors. MIT license.
// Copyright the Browserify authors. MIT License.
// Ported from https://github.com/browserify/path-browserify/
// This module is browser compatible.
function stripTrailingSeparators(segment, isSep) {
  if (segment.length <= 1) {
    return segment;
  }
  let end = segment.length;
  for(let i = segment.length - 1; i > 0; i--){
    if (isSep(segment.charCodeAt(i))) {
      end = i;
    } else {
      break;
    }
  }
  return segment.slice(0, end);
}

// Copyright 2018-2025 the Deno authors. MIT license.

// Ported from https://github.com/browserify/path-browserify/
// This module is browser compatible.
// Alphabet chars.
// Non-alphabetic chars.
const CHAR_DOT = 46; /* . */ 
const CHAR_FORWARD_SLASH = 47; /* / */

// Copyright 2018-2025 the Deno authors. MIT license.
// Copyright the Browserify authors. MIT License.
// Ported from https://github.com/browserify/path-browserify/
// This module is browser compatible.
function isPosixPathSeparator(code) {
  return code === CHAR_FORWARD_SLASH;
}

// Copyright 2018-2025 the Deno authors. MIT license.
// This module is browser compatible.
/**
 * Return the last portion of a `path`.
 * Trailing directory separators are ignored, and optional suffix is removed.
 *
 * @example Usage
 * ```ts
 * import { basename } from "@std/path/posix/basename";
 * import { assertEquals } from "@std/assert";
 *
 * assertEquals(basename("/home/user/Documents/"), "Documents");
 * assertEquals(basename("/home/user/Documents/image.png"), "image.png");
 * assertEquals(basename("/home/user/Documents/image.png", ".png"), "image");
 * assertEquals(basename(new URL("file:///home/user/Documents/image.png")), "image.png");
 * assertEquals(basename(new URL("file:///home/user/Documents/image.png"), ".png"), "image");
 * ```
 *
 * @example Working with URLs
 *
 * Note: This function doesn't automatically strip hash and query parts from
 * URLs. If your URL contains a hash or query, remove them before passing the
 * URL to the function. This can be done by passing the URL to `new URL(url)`,
 * and setting the `hash` and `search` properties to empty strings.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { basename } from "@std/path/posix/basename";
 * import { assertEquals } from "@std/assert";
 *
 * assertEquals(basename("https://deno.land/std/path/mod.ts"), "mod.ts");
 * assertEquals(basename("https://deno.land/std/path/mod.ts", ".ts"), "mod");
 * assertEquals(basename("https://deno.land/std/path/mod.ts?a=b"), "mod.ts?a=b");
 * assertEquals(basename("https://deno.land/std/path/mod.ts#header"), "mod.ts#header");
 * ```
 *
 * @param path The path to extract the name from.
 * @param suffix The suffix to remove from extracted name.
 * @returns The extracted name.
 */ function basename(path, suffix = "") {
  if (path instanceof URL) {
    path = fromFileUrl(path);
  }
  assertArgs$1(path, suffix);
  const lastSegment = lastPathSegment(path, isPosixPathSeparator);
  const strippedSegment = stripTrailingSeparators(lastSegment, isPosixPathSeparator);
  return suffix ? stripSuffix(strippedSegment, suffix) : strippedSegment;
}

/**
 * The character used to separate entries in the PATH environment variable.
 */ const DELIMITER = ":";
/**
 * The character used to separate components of a file path.
 */ const SEPARATOR = "/";
/**
 * A regular expression that matches one or more path separators.
 */ const SEPARATOR_PATTERN = /\/+/;

// Copyright 2018-2025 the Deno authors. MIT license.

function assertArg$2(path) {
  assertPath(path);
  if (path.length === 0) return ".";
}

// Copyright 2018-2025 the Deno authors. MIT license.
// This module is browser compatible.
/**
 * Return the directory path of a `path`.
 *
 * @example Usage
 * ```ts
 * import { dirname } from "@std/path/posix/dirname";
 * import { assertEquals } from "@std/assert";
 *
 * assertEquals(dirname("/home/user/Documents/"), "/home/user");
 * assertEquals(dirname("/home/user/Documents/image.png"), "/home/user/Documents");
 * assertEquals(dirname("https://deno.land/std/path/mod.ts"), "https://deno.land/std/path");
 * assertEquals(dirname(new URL("file:///home/user/Documents/image.png")), "/home/user/Documents");
 * ```
 *
 * @example Working with URLs
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { dirname } from "@std/path/posix/dirname";
 * import { assertEquals } from "@std/assert";
 *
 * assertEquals(dirname("https://deno.land/std/path/mod.ts"), "https://deno.land/std/path");
 * assertEquals(dirname("https://deno.land/std/path/mod.ts?a=b"), "https://deno.land/std/path");
 * assertEquals(dirname("https://deno.land/std/path/mod.ts#header"), "https://deno.land/std/path");
 * ```
 *
 * @param path The path to get the directory from.
 * @returns The directory path.
 */ function dirname(path) {
  if (path instanceof URL) {
    path = fromFileUrl(path);
  }
  assertArg$2(path);
  let end = -1;
  let matchedNonSeparator = false;
  for(let i = path.length - 1; i >= 1; --i){
    if (isPosixPathSeparator(path.charCodeAt(i))) {
      if (matchedNonSeparator) {
        end = i;
        break;
      }
    } else {
      matchedNonSeparator = true;
    }
  }
  // No matches. Fallback based on provided path:
  //
  // - leading slashes paths
  //     "/foo" => "/"
  //     "///foo" => "/"
  // - no slash path
  //     "foo" => "."
  if (end === -1) {
    return isPosixPathSeparator(path.charCodeAt(0)) ? "/" : ".";
  }
  return stripTrailingSeparators(path.slice(0, end), isPosixPathSeparator);
}

// Copyright 2018-2025 the Deno authors. MIT license.
// This module is browser compatible.
/**
 * Return the extension of the `path` with leading period.
 *
 * @example Usage
 * ```ts
 * import { extname } from "@std/path/posix/extname";
 * import { assertEquals } from "@std/assert";
 *
 * assertEquals(extname("/home/user/Documents/file.ts"), ".ts");
 * assertEquals(extname("/home/user/Documents/"), "");
 * assertEquals(extname("/home/user/Documents/image.png"), ".png");
 * assertEquals(extname(new URL("file:///home/user/Documents/file.ts")), ".ts");
 * assertEquals(extname(new URL("file:///home/user/Documents/file.ts?a=b")), ".ts");
 * assertEquals(extname(new URL("file:///home/user/Documents/file.ts#header")), ".ts");
 * ```
 *
 * @example Working with URLs
 *
 * Note: This function doesn't automatically strip hash and query parts from
 * URLs. If your URL contains a hash or query, remove them before passing the
 * URL to the function. This can be done by passing the URL to `new URL(url)`,
 * and setting the `hash` and `search` properties to empty strings.
 *
 * ```ts
 * import { extname } from "@std/path/posix/extname";
 * import { assertEquals } from "@std/assert";
 *
 * assertEquals(extname("https://deno.land/std/path/mod.ts"), ".ts");
 * assertEquals(extname("https://deno.land/std/path/mod.ts?a=b"), ".ts?a=b");
 * assertEquals(extname("https://deno.land/std/path/mod.ts#header"), ".ts#header");
 * ```
 *
 * @param path The path to get the extension from.
 * @returns The extension (ex. for `file.ts` returns `.ts`).
 */ function extname(path) {
  if (path instanceof URL) {
    path = fromFileUrl(path);
  }
  assertPath(path);
  let startDot = -1;
  let startPart = 0;
  let end = -1;
  let matchedSlash = true;
  // Track the state of characters (if any) we see before our first dot and
  // after any path separator we find
  let preDotState = 0;
  for(let i = path.length - 1; i >= 0; --i){
    const code = path.charCodeAt(i);
    if (isPosixPathSeparator(code)) {
      // If we reached a path separator that was not part of a set of path
      // separators at the end of the string, stop now
      if (!matchedSlash) {
        startPart = i + 1;
        break;
      }
      continue;
    }
    if (end === -1) {
      // We saw the first non-path separator, mark this as the end of our
      // extension
      matchedSlash = false;
      end = i + 1;
    }
    if (code === CHAR_DOT) {
      // If this is our first dot, mark it as the start of our extension
      if (startDot === -1) startDot = i;
      else if (preDotState !== 1) preDotState = 1;
    } else if (startDot !== -1) {
      // We saw a non-dot and non-path separator before our dot, so we should
      // have a good chance at having a non-empty extension
      preDotState = -1;
    }
  }
  if (startDot === -1 || end === -1 || // We saw a non-dot character immediately before the dot
  preDotState === 0 || // The (right-most) trimmed path component is exactly '..'
  preDotState === 1 && startDot === end - 1 && startDot === startPart + 1) {
    return "";
  }
  return path.slice(startDot, end);
}

// Copyright 2018-2025 the Deno authors. MIT license.
// This module is browser compatible.
function _format(sep, pathObject) {
  const dir = pathObject.dir || pathObject.root;
  const base = pathObject.base || (pathObject.name ?? "") + (pathObject.ext ?? "");
  if (!dir) return base;
  if (base === sep) return dir;
  if (dir === pathObject.root) return dir + base;
  return dir + sep + base;
}
function assertArg$1(pathObject) {
  if (pathObject === null || typeof pathObject !== "object") {
    throw new TypeError(`The "pathObject" argument must be of type Object, received type "${typeof pathObject}"`);
  }
}

/**
 * Generate a path from `ParsedPath` object.
 *
 * @example Usage
 * ```ts
 * import { format } from "@std/path/posix/format";
 * import { assertEquals } from "@std/assert";
 *
 * const path = format({
 *   root: "/",
 *   dir: "/path/dir",
 *   base: "file.txt",
 *   ext: ".txt",
 *   name: "file"
 * });
 * assertEquals(path, "/path/dir/file.txt");
 * ```
 *
 * @param pathObject The path object to format.
 * @returns The formatted path.
 */ function format(pathObject) {
  assertArg$1(pathObject);
  return _format("/", pathObject);
}

/**
 * Verifies whether provided path is absolute.
 *
 * @example Usage
 * ```ts
 * import { isAbsolute } from "@std/path/posix/is-absolute";
 * import { assert, assertFalse } from "@std/assert";
 *
 * assert(isAbsolute("/home/user/Documents/"));
 * assertFalse(isAbsolute("home/user/Documents/"));
 * ```
 *
 * @param path The path to verify.
 * @returns Whether the path is absolute.
 */ function isAbsolute(path) {
  assertPath(path);
  return path.length > 0 && isPosixPathSeparator(path.charCodeAt(0));
}
