import URI_PROTOCOL from "./regexps-uri";
import IRI_PROTOCOL from "./regexps-iri";
import punycode from "punycode";
import { toUpperCase, typeOf, assign } from "./util";
export const SCHEMES = {};
export function pctEncChar(chr) {
    const c = chr.charCodeAt(0);
    let e;
    if (c < 16)
        e = "%0" + c.toString(16).toUpperCase();
    else if (c < 128)
        e = "%" + c.toString(16).toUpperCase();
    else if (c < 2048)
        e = "%" + ((c >> 6) | 192).toString(16).toUpperCase() + "%" + ((c & 63) | 128).toString(16).toUpperCase();
    else
        e = "%" + ((c >> 12) | 224).toString(16).toUpperCase() + "%" + (((c >> 6) & 63) | 128).toString(16).toUpperCase() + "%" + ((c & 63) | 128).toString(16).toUpperCase();
    return e;
}
export function pctDecChars(str) {
    let newStr = "";
    let i = 0;
    const il = str.length;
    while (i < il) {
        const c = parseInt(str.substr(i + 1, 2), 16);
        if (c < 128) {
            newStr += String.fromCharCode(c);
            i += 3;
        }
        else if (c >= 194 && c < 224) {
            if ((il - i) >= 6) {
                const c2 = parseInt(str.substr(i + 4, 2), 16);
                newStr += String.fromCharCode(((c & 31) << 6) | (c2 & 63));
            }
            else {
                newStr += str.substr(i, 6);
            }
            i += 6;
        }
        else if (c >= 224) {
            if ((il - i) >= 9) {
                const c2 = parseInt(str.substr(i + 4, 2), 16);
                const c3 = parseInt(str.substr(i + 7, 2), 16);
                newStr += String.fromCharCode(((c & 15) << 12) | ((c2 & 63) << 6) | (c3 & 63));
            }
            else {
                newStr += str.substr(i, 9);
            }
            i += 9;
        }
        else {
            newStr += str.substr(i, 3);
            i += 3;
        }
    }
    return newStr;
}
function _normalizeComponentEncoding(components, protocol) {
    function decodeUnreserved(str) {
        const decStr = pctDecChars(str);
        return (!decStr.match(protocol.UNRESERVED) ? str : decStr);
    }
    if (components.scheme)
        components.scheme = String(components.scheme).replace(protocol.PCT_ENCODED, decodeUnreserved).toLowerCase().replace(protocol.NOT_SCHEME, "");
    if (components.userinfo !== undefined)
        components.userinfo = String(components.userinfo).replace(protocol.PCT_ENCODED, decodeUnreserved).replace(protocol.NOT_USERINFO, pctEncChar).replace(protocol.PCT_ENCODED, toUpperCase);
    if (components.host !== undefined)
        components.host = String(components.host).replace(protocol.PCT_ENCODED, decodeUnreserved).toLowerCase().replace(protocol.NOT_HOST, pctEncChar).replace(protocol.PCT_ENCODED, toUpperCase);
    if (components.path !== undefined)
        components.path = String(components.path).replace(protocol.PCT_ENCODED, decodeUnreserved).replace((components.scheme ? protocol.NOT_PATH : protocol.NOT_PATH_NOSCHEME), pctEncChar).replace(protocol.PCT_ENCODED, toUpperCase);
    if (components.query !== undefined)
        components.query = String(components.query).replace(protocol.PCT_ENCODED, decodeUnreserved).replace(protocol.NOT_QUERY, pctEncChar).replace(protocol.PCT_ENCODED, toUpperCase);
    if (components.fragment !== undefined)
        components.fragment = String(components.fragment).replace(protocol.PCT_ENCODED, decodeUnreserved).replace(protocol.NOT_FRAGMENT, pctEncChar).replace(protocol.PCT_ENCODED, toUpperCase);
    return components;
}
;
function _stripLeadingZeros(str) {
    return str.replace(/^0*(.*)/, "$1") || "0";
}
function _normalizeIPv4(host, protocol) {
    const matches = host.match(protocol.IPV4ADDRESS) || [];
    const [, address] = matches;
    if (address) {
        return address.split(".").map(_stripLeadingZeros).join(".");
    }
    else {
        return host;
    }
}
function _normalizeIPv6(host, protocol) {
    const matches = host.match(protocol.IPV6ADDRESS) || [];
    const [, address, zone] = matches;
    if (address) {
        const [last, first] = address.toLowerCase().split('::').reverse();
        const firstFields = first ? first.split(":").map(_stripLeadingZeros) : [];
        const lastFields = last.split(":").map(_stripLeadingZeros);
        const isLastFieldIPv4Address = protocol.IPV4ADDRESS.test(lastFields[lastFields.length - 1]);
        const fieldCount = isLastFieldIPv4Address ? 7 : 8;
        const lastFieldsStart = lastFields.length - fieldCount;
        const fields = Array(fieldCount);
        for (let x = 0; x < fieldCount; ++x) {
            fields[x] = firstFields[x] || lastFields[lastFieldsStart + x] || '';
        }
        if (isLastFieldIPv4Address) {
            fields[fieldCount - 1] = _normalizeIPv4(fields[fieldCount - 1], protocol);
        }
        const allZeroFields = fields.reduce((acc, field, index) => {
            if (!field || field === "0") {
                const lastLongest = acc[acc.length - 1];
                if (lastLongest && lastLongest.index + lastLongest.length === index) {
                    lastLongest.length++;
                }
                else {
                    acc.push({ index, length: 1 });
                }
            }
            return acc;
        }, []);
        const longestZeroFields = allZeroFields.sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length)[0];
        let newHost;
        if (longestZeroFields && longestZeroFields.length > 1) {
            const newFirst = fields.slice(0, longestZeroFields.index);
            const newLast = fields.slice(longestZeroFields.index + longestZeroFields.length);
            newHost = newFirst.join(":") + "::" + newLast.join(":");
        }
        else {
            newHost = fields.join(":");
        }
        if (zone) {
            newHost += "%" + zone;
        }
        return newHost;
    }
    else {
        return host;
    }
}
const URI_PARSE = /^(?:([^:\/?#]+):)?(?:\/\/((?:([^\/?#@]*)@)?(\[[^\/?#\]]+\]|[^\/?#:]*)(?:\:(\d*))?))?([^?#]*)(?:\?([^#]*))?(?:#((?:.|\n|\r)*))?/i;
const NO_MATCH_IS_UNDEFINED = ("").match(/(){0}/)[1] === undefined;
export function parse(uriString, options = {}) {
    const components = {};
    const protocol = (options.iri !== false ? IRI_PROTOCOL : URI_PROTOCOL);
    if (options.reference === "suffix")
        uriString = (options.scheme ? options.scheme + ":" : "") + "//" + uriString;
    const matches = uriString.match(URI_PARSE);
    if (matches) {
        if (NO_MATCH_IS_UNDEFINED) {
            //store each component
            components.scheme = matches[1];
            components.userinfo = matches[3];
            components.host = matches[4];
            components.port = parseInt(matches[5], 10);
            components.path = matches[6] || "";
            components.query = matches[7];
            components.fragment = matches[8];
            //fix port number
            if (isNaN(components.port)) {
                components.port = matches[5];
            }
        }
        else { //IE FIX for improper RegExp matching
            //store each component
            components.scheme = matches[1] || undefined;
            components.userinfo = (uriString.indexOf("@") !== -1 ? matches[3] : undefined);
            components.host = (uriString.indexOf("//") !== -1 ? matches[4] : undefined);
            components.port = parseInt(matches[5], 10);
            components.path = matches[6] || "";
            components.query = (uriString.indexOf("?") !== -1 ? matches[7] : undefined);
            components.fragment = (uriString.indexOf("#") !== -1 ? matches[8] : undefined);
            //fix port number
            if (isNaN(components.port)) {
                components.port = (uriString.match(/\/\/(?:.|\n)*\:(?:\/|\?|\#|$)/) ? matches[4] : undefined);
            }
        }
        if (components.host) {
            //normalize IP hosts
            components.host = _normalizeIPv6(_normalizeIPv4(components.host, protocol), protocol);
        }
        //determine reference type
        if (components.scheme === undefined && components.userinfo === undefined && components.host === undefined && components.port === undefined && !components.path && components.query === undefined) {
            components.reference = "same-document";
        }
        else if (components.scheme === undefined) {
            components.reference = "relative";
        }
        else if (components.fragment === undefined) {
            components.reference = "absolute";
        }
        else {
            components.reference = "uri";
        }
        //check for reference errors
        if (options.reference && options.reference !== "suffix" && options.reference !== components.reference) {
            components.error = components.error || "URI is not a " + options.reference + " reference.";
        }
        //find scheme handler
        const schemeHandler = SCHEMES[(options.scheme || components.scheme || "").toLowerCase()];
        //check if scheme can't handle IRIs
        if (!options.unicodeSupport && (!schemeHandler || !schemeHandler.unicodeSupport)) {
            //if host component is a domain name
            if (components.host && (options.domainHost || (schemeHandler && schemeHandler.domainHost))) {
                //convert Unicode IDN -> ASCII IDN
                try {
                    components.host = punycode.toASCII(components.host.replace(protocol.PCT_ENCODED, pctDecChars).toLowerCase());
                }
                catch (e) {
                    components.error = components.error || "Host's domain name can not be converted to ASCII via punycode: " + e;
                }
            }
            //convert IRI -> URI
            _normalizeComponentEncoding(components, URI_PROTOCOL);
        }
        else {
            //normalize encodings
            _normalizeComponentEncoding(components, protocol);
        }
        //perform scheme specific parsing
        if (schemeHandler && schemeHandler.parse) {
            schemeHandler.parse(components, options);
        }
    }
    else {
        components.error = components.error || "URI can not be parsed.";
    }
    return components;
}
;
function _recomposeAuthority(components, options) {
    const protocol = (options.iri !== false ? IRI_PROTOCOL : URI_PROTOCOL);
    const uriTokens = [];
    if (components.userinfo !== undefined) {
        uriTokens.push(components.userinfo);
        uriTokens.push("@");
    }
    if (components.host !== undefined) {
        //normalize IP hosts, add brackets and escape zone separator for IPv6
        uriTokens.push(_normalizeIPv6(_normalizeIPv4(String(components.host), protocol), protocol).replace(protocol.IPV6ADDRESS, (_, $1, $2) => "[" + $1 + ($2 ? "%25" + $2 : "") + "]"));
    }
    if (typeof components.port === "number" || typeof components.port === "string") {
        uriTokens.push(":");
        uriTokens.push(String(components.port));
    }
    return uriTokens.length ? uriTokens.join("") : undefined;
}
;
const RDS1 = /^\.\.?\//;
const RDS2 = /^\/\.(\/|$)/;
const RDS3 = /^\/\.\.(\/|$)/;
const RDS4 = /^\.\.?$/;
const RDS5 = /^\/?(?:.|\n)*?(?=\/|$)/;
export function removeDotSegments(input) {
    const output = [];
    while (input.length) {
        if (input.match(RDS1)) {
            input = input.replace(RDS1, "");
        }
        else if (input.match(RDS2)) {
            input = input.replace(RDS2, "/");
        }
        else if (input.match(RDS3)) {
            input = input.replace(RDS3, "/");
            output.pop();
        }
        else if (input === "." || input === "..") {
            input = "";
        }
        else {
            const im = input.match(RDS5);
            if (im) {
                const s = im[0];
                input = input.slice(s.length);
                output.push(s);
            }
            else {
                throw new Error("Unexpected dot segment condition");
            }
        }
    }
    return output.join("");
}
;
export function serialize(components, options = {}) {
    const protocol = (options.iri ? IRI_PROTOCOL : URI_PROTOCOL);
    const uriTokens = [];
    //find scheme handler
    const schemeHandler = SCHEMES[(options.scheme || components.scheme || "").toLowerCase()];
    //perform scheme specific serialization
    if (schemeHandler && schemeHandler.serialize)
        schemeHandler.serialize(components, options);
    if (components.host) {
        //if host component is an IPv6 address
        if (protocol.IPV6ADDRESS.test(components.host)) {
            //TODO: normalize IPv6 address as per RFC 5952
        }
        //if host component is a domain name
        else if (options.domainHost || (schemeHandler && schemeHandler.domainHost)) {
            //convert IDN via punycode
            try {
                components.host = (!options.iri ? punycode.toASCII(components.host.replace(protocol.PCT_ENCODED, pctDecChars).toLowerCase()) : punycode.toUnicode(components.host));
            }
            catch (e) {
                components.error = components.error || "Host's domain name can not be converted to " + (!options.iri ? "ASCII" : "Unicode") + " via punycode: " + e;
            }
        }
    }
    //normalize encoding
    _normalizeComponentEncoding(components, protocol);
    if (options.reference !== "suffix" && components.scheme) {
        uriTokens.push(components.scheme);
        uriTokens.push(":");
    }
    const authority = _recomposeAuthority(components, options);
    if (authority !== undefined) {
        if (options.reference !== "suffix") {
            uriTokens.push("//");
        }
        uriTokens.push(authority);
        if (components.path && components.path.charAt(0) !== "/") {
            uriTokens.push("/");
        }
    }
    if (components.path !== undefined) {
        let s = components.path;
        if (!options.absolutePath && (!schemeHandler || !schemeHandler.absolutePath)) {
            s = removeDotSegments(s);
        }
        if (authority === undefined) {
            s = s.replace(/^\/\//, "/%2F"); //don't allow the path to start with "//"
        }
        uriTokens.push(s);
    }
    if (components.query !== undefined) {
        uriTokens.push("?");
        uriTokens.push(components.query);
    }
    if (components.fragment !== undefined) {
        uriTokens.push("#");
        uriTokens.push(components.fragment);
    }
    return uriTokens.join(""); //merge tokens into a string
}
;
export function resolveComponents(base, relative, options = {}, skipNormalization) {
    const target = {};
    if (!skipNormalization) {
        base = parse(serialize(base, options), options); //normalize base components
        relative = parse(serialize(relative, options), options); //normalize relative components
    }
    options = options || {};
    if (!options.tolerant && relative.scheme) {
        target.scheme = relative.scheme;
        //target.authority = relative.authority;
        target.userinfo = relative.userinfo;
        target.host = relative.host;
        target.port = relative.port;
        target.path = removeDotSegments(relative.path || "");
        target.query = relative.query;
    }
    else {
        if (relative.userinfo !== undefined || relative.host !== undefined || relative.port !== undefined) {
            //target.authority = relative.authority;
            target.userinfo = relative.userinfo;
            target.host = relative.host;
            target.port = relative.port;
            target.path = removeDotSegments(relative.path || "");
            target.query = relative.query;
        }
        else {
            if (!relative.path) {
                target.path = base.path;
                if (relative.query !== undefined) {
                    target.query = relative.query;
                }
                else {
                    target.query = base.query;
                }
            }
            else {
                if (relative.path.charAt(0) === "/") {
                    target.path = removeDotSegments(relative.path);
                }
                else {
                    if ((base.userinfo !== undefined || base.host !== undefined || base.port !== undefined) && !base.path) {
                        target.path = "/" + relative.path;
                    }
                    else if (!base.path) {
                        target.path = relative.path;
                    }
                    else {
                        target.path = base.path.slice(0, base.path.lastIndexOf("/") + 1) + relative.path;
                    }
                    target.path = removeDotSegments(target.path);
                }
                target.query = relative.query;
            }
            //target.authority = base.authority;
            target.userinfo = base.userinfo;
            target.host = base.host;
            target.port = base.port;
        }
        target.scheme = base.scheme;
    }
    target.fragment = relative.fragment;
    return target;
}
;
export function resolve(baseURI, relativeURI, options) {
    const schemelessOptions = assign({ scheme: 'null' }, options);
    return serialize(resolveComponents(parse(baseURI, schemelessOptions), parse(relativeURI, schemelessOptions), schemelessOptions, true), schemelessOptions);
}
;
export function normalize(uri, options) {
    if (typeof uri === "string") {
        uri = serialize(parse(uri, options), options);
    }
    else if (typeOf(uri) === "object") {
        uri = parse(serialize(uri, options), options);
    }
    return uri;
}
;
export function equal(uriA, uriB, options) {
    if (typeof uriA === "string") {
        uriA = serialize(parse(uriA, options), options);
    }
    else if (typeOf(uriA) === "object") {
        uriA = serialize(uriA, options);
    }
    if (typeof uriB === "string") {
        uriB = serialize(parse(uriB, options), options);
    }
    else if (typeOf(uriB) === "object") {
        uriB = serialize(uriB, options);
    }
    return uriA === uriB;
}
;
export function escapeComponent(str, options) {
    return str && str.toString().replace((!options || !options.iri ? URI_PROTOCOL.ESCAPE : IRI_PROTOCOL.ESCAPE), pctEncChar);
}
;
export function unescapeComponent(str, options) {
    return str && str.toString().replace((!options || !options.iri ? URI_PROTOCOL.PCT_ENCODED : IRI_PROTOCOL.PCT_ENCODED), pctDecChars);
}

/* ===== node_modules\uri-js\dist\esnext\util.js ===== */
export function merge(...sets) {
    if (sets.length > 1) {
        sets[0] = sets[0].slice(0, -1);
        const xl = sets.length - 1;
        for (let x = 1; x < xl; ++x) {
            sets[x] = sets[x].slice(1, -1);
        }
        sets[xl] = sets[xl].slice(1);
        return sets.join('');
    }
    else {
        return sets[0];
    }
}
export function subexp(str) {
    return "(?:" + str + ")";
}
export function typeOf(o) {
    return o === undefined ? "undefined" : (o === null ? "null" : Object.prototype.toString.call(o).split(" ").pop().split("]").shift().toLowerCase());
}
export function toUpperCase(str) {
    return str.toUpperCase();
}
export function toArray(obj) {
    return obj !== undefined && obj !== null ? (obj instanceof Array ? obj : (typeof obj.length !== "number" || obj.split || obj.setInterval || obj.call ? [obj] : Array.prototype.slice.call(obj))) : [];
}
export function assign(target, source) {
    const obj = target;
    if (source) {
        for (const key in source) {
            obj[key] = source[key];
        }
    }
    return obj;
}

/* ===== node_modules\which\which.js ===== */
const isWindows = process.platform === 'win32' ||
    process.env.OSTYPE === 'cygwin' ||
    process.env.OSTYPE === 'msys'

const path = require('path')
const COLON = isWindows ? ';' : ':'
const isexe = require('isexe')

const getNotFoundError = (cmd) =>
  Object.assign(new Error(`not found: ${cmd}`), { code: 'ENOENT' })

const getPathInfo = (cmd, opt) => {
  const colon = opt.colon || COLON

  // If it has a slash, then we don't bother searching the pathenv.
  // just check the file itself, and that's it.
  const pathEnv = cmd.match(/\//) || isWindows && cmd.match(/\\/) ? ['']
    : (
      [
        // windows always checks the cwd first
        ...(isWindows ? [process.cwd()] : []),
        ...(opt.path || process.env.PATH ||
          /* istanbul ignore next: very unusual */ '').split(colon),
      ]
    )
  const pathExtExe = isWindows
    ? opt.pathExt || process.env.PATHEXT || '.EXE;.CMD;.BAT;.COM'
    : ''
  const pathExt = isWindows ? pathExtExe.split(colon) : ['']

  if (isWindows) {
    if (cmd.indexOf('.') !== -1 && pathExt[0] !== '')
      pathExt.unshift('')
  }

  return {
    pathEnv,
    pathExt,
    pathExtExe,
  }
}

const which = (cmd, opt, cb) => {
  if (typeof opt === 'function') {
    cb = opt
    opt = {}
  }
  if (!opt)
    opt = {}

  const { pathEnv, pathExt, pathExtExe } = getPathInfo(cmd, opt)
  const found = []

  const step = i => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (i === pathEnv.length)
      return opt.all && found.length ? resolve(found)
        : reject(getNotFoundError(cmd))

    const ppRaw = pathEnv[i]
    const pathPart = /^".*"$/.test(ppRaw) ? ppRaw.slice(1, -1) : ppRaw

    const pCmd = path.join(pathPart, cmd)
    const p = !pathPart && /^\.[\\\/]/.test(cmd) ? cmd.slice(0, 2) + pCmd
      : pCmd

    resolve(subStep(p, i, 0))
  })

  const subStep = (p, i, ii) => new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    if (ii === pathExt.length)
      return resolve(step(i + 1))
    const ext = pathExt[ii]
    isexe(p + ext, { pathExt: pathExtExe }, (er, is) => {
      if (!er && is) {
        if (opt.all)
          found.push(p + ext)
        else
          return resolve(p + ext)
      }
      return resolve(subStep(p, i, ii + 1))
    })
  })

  return cb ? step(0).then(res => cb(null, res), cb) : step(0)
}

const whichSync = (cmd, opt) => {
  opt = opt || {}

  const { pathEnv, pathExt, pathExtExe } = getPathInfo(cmd, opt)
  const found = []

  for (let i = 0; i < pathEnv.length; i ++) {
    const ppRaw = pathEnv[i]
    const pathPart = /^".*"$/.test(ppRaw) ? ppRaw.slice(1, -1) : ppRaw

    const pCmd = path.join(pathPart, cmd)
    const p = !pathPart && /^\.[\\\/]/.test(cmd) ? cmd.slice(0, 2) + pCmd
      : pCmd

    for (let j = 0; j < pathExt.length; j ++) {
      const cur = p + pathExt[j]
      try {
        const is = isexe.sync(cur, { pathExt: pathExtExe })
        if (is) {
          if (opt.all)
            found.push(cur)
          else
            return cur
        }
      } catch (ex) {}
    }
  }

  if (opt.all && found.length)
    return found

  if (opt.nothrow)
    return null

  throw getNotFoundError(cmd)
}

module.exports = which
which.sync = whichSync

function trimEnd(str) {
  let lastCharPos = str.length - 1;
  let lastChar = str[lastCharPos];
  while(lastChar === ' ' || lastChar === '\t') {
    lastChar = str[--lastCharPos];
  }
  return str.substring(0, lastCharPos + 1);
}

function trimTabAndSpaces(str) {
  const lines = str.split('\n');
  const trimmedLines = lines.map((line) => trimEnd(line));
  return trimmedLines.join('\n');
}

module.exports = function(str, options) {
  options = options || {};
  if (str == null) {
    return str;
  }

  var width = options.width || 50;
  var indent = (typeof options.indent === 'string')
    ? options.indent
    : '  ';

  var newline = options.newline || '\n' + indent;
  var escape = typeof options.escape === 'function'
    ? options.escape
    : identity;

  var regexString = '.{1,' + width + '}';
  if (options.cut !== true) {
    regexString += '([\\s\u200B]+|$)|[^\\s\u200B]+?([\\s\u200B]+|$)';
  }

  var re = new RegExp(regexString, 'g');
  var lines = str.match(re) || [];
  var result = indent + lines.map(function(line) {
    if (line.slice(-1) === '\n') {
      line = line.slice(0, line.length - 1);
    }
    return escape(line);
  }).join(newline);

  if (options.trim === true) {
    result = trimTabAndSpaces(result);
  }
  return result;
};

function identity(str) {
  return str;
}


/* ===== node_modules\yocto-queue\index.js ===== */
class Node {
	/// value;
	/// next;

	constructor(value) {
		this.value = value;

		// TODO: Remove this when targeting Node.js 12.
		this.next = undefined;
	}
}

class Queue {
	// TODO: Use private class fields when targeting Node.js 12.
	// #_head;
	// #_tail;
	// #_size;

	constructor() {
		this.clear();
	}

	enqueue(value) {
		const node = new Node(value);

		if (this._head) {
			this._tail.next = node;
			this._tail = node;
		} else {
			this._head = node;
			this._tail = node;
		}

		this._size++;
	}

	dequeue() {
		const current = this._head;
		if (!current) {
			return;
		}

		this._head = this._head.next;
		this._size--;
		return current.value;
	}

	clear() {
		this._head = undefined;
		this._tail = undefined;
		this._size = 0;
	}

	get size() {
		return this._size;
	}

	* [Symbol.iterator]() {
		let current = this._head;

		while (current) {
			yield current.value;
			current = current.next;
		}
	}
}

module.exports = Queue;

/* ===== fetch_abandoned.js ===== */
const fs = require('fs');
const https = require('https');

const OVERPASS_URL = 'https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter';

// Full British Isles Bounding Box
const UK_BOUNDS = { s: 49.8, n: 61.0, w: -8.5, e: 1.8 };
const TILE_SIZE = 2.0; // degrees (points are light, we can use larger tiles)

function sleep(ms) { return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); }

async function fetchTile(s, w, n, e) {
    const bbox = `${s},${w},${n},${e}`;
    const query = `
        [out:json][timeout:180];
        (
          node["railway"="abandoned"](${bbox});
          node["railway"="disused"](${bbox});
          node["historic"="railway_station"](${bbox});
          node["disused:railway"="station"](${bbox});
          node["abandoned:railway"="station"](${bbox});
          node["railway"="station"]["disused"="yes"](${bbox});
        );
        out center;
    `;
    
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const req = https.request(OVERPASS_URL, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
                'User-Agent': 'windsurf-project-transport'
            }
        }, (res) => {
            if (res.statusCode === 429) return reject(new Error('Rate Limited'));
            let data = '';
            res.on('data', chunk => data += chunk);
            res.on('end', () => {
                try {
                    const j = JSON.parse(data);
                    const stations = [];
                    if (j.elements) {
                        j.elements.forEach(el => {
                            let lat = el.lat;
                            let lon = el.lon;
                            if (el.type === 'way' || el.type === 'relation') {
                                if (el.center) {
                                    lat = el.center.lat;
                                    lon = el.center.lon;
                                } else return;
                            }
                            const name = el.tags?.name || el.tags?.['old_name'] || 'Historic Station';
                            stations.push({ lat, lon, name, id: 'hist_' + el.id });
                        });
                    }
                    resolve(stations);
                } catch (e) {
                    if (data.includes('rate_limit')) reject(new Error('Rate Limited'));
                    else resolve([]);
                }
            });
        });
        req.on('error', reject);
        req.write('data=' + encodeURIComponent(query));
        req.end();
    });
}

async function fetchAll() {
    console.log("Fetching abandoned and historic stations for entire British Isles...");
    const allStations = [];
    const seen = new Set();
    
    for (let lat = UK_BOUNDS.s; lat < UK_BOUNDS.n; lat += TILE_SIZE) {
        for (let lon = UK_BOUNDS.w; lon < UK_BOUNDS.e; lon += TILE_SIZE) {
            let success = false;
            let attempts = 0;
            const n = Math.min(lat + TILE_SIZE, UK_BOUNDS.n);
            const e = Math.min(lon + TILE_SIZE, UK_BOUNDS.e);
            
            while (!success && attempts < 3) {
                attempts++;
                try {
                    console.log(`Fetching tile [${lat.toFixed(2)}, ${lon.toFixed(2)}]...`);
                    const stations = await fetchTile(lat, lon, n, e);
                    
                    stations.forEach(st => {
                        if (!seen.has(st.id)) {
                            seen.add(st.id);
                            allStations.push(st);
                        }
                    });
                    
                    success = true;
                    await sleep(500);
                } catch (err) {
                    if (err.message === 'Rate Limited') {
                        console.log("Rate limited! Waiting 30s...");
                        await sleep(30000);
                    } else {
                        success = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    if (!fs.existsSync('data')) fs.mkdirSync('data');
    fs.writeFileSync('data/abandoned_stations.json', JSON.stringify(allStations));
    console.log('Saved ' + allStations.length + ' abandoned stations to data/abandoned_stations.json');
}

fetchAll().catch(console.error);

/* ===== fetch_boundary.js ===== */
const fs = require('node:fs');
const https = require('node:https');

const query = `[out:json][timeout:30];
relation["boundary"="administrative"]["name"="Greater London"];
out geom;`;

const postData = 'data=' + encodeURIComponent(query);

const options = {
    hostname: 'overpass-api.de',
    port: 443,
    path: '/api/interpreter',
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
        'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(postData)
    }
};

const req = https.request(options, (res) => {
    let rawData = '';
    res.setEncoding('utf8');
    res.on('data', (chunk) => { rawData += chunk; });
    res.on('end', () => {
        try {
            const data = JSON.parse(rawData);
            if (!data || !data.elements || data.elements.length === 0) {
                console.error('No boundary data from any endpoint');
                return;
            }
            
            const relation = data.elements.find(el => el.type === 'relation');
            if (!relation || !relation.members) {
                console.error('Invalid relation');
                return;
            }

            const ways = relation.members.filter(m => m.type === 'way' && m.geometry);
            let polygon = [];
            
            if (ways.length > 0) {
                // simple reconstruction: just use the longest outer way or concat all outer ways
                const outerWays = ways.filter(w => w.role === 'outer');
                outerWays.forEach(w => {
                    polygon = polygon.concat(w.geometry.map(g => [g.lat, g.lon]));
                });
            }

            if (polygon.length > 0) {
                fs.writeFileSync('data/londonBoundary.json', JSON.stringify(polygon));
                console.log(`Saved London boundary with ${polygon.length} points.`);
            } else {
                console.error("Failed to reconstruct polygon.");
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.error(e.message);
        }
    });
});

req.on('error', (e) => console.error(e.message));
req.write(postData);
req.end();

/* ===== fetch_data.js ===== */
const fs = require('node:fs');
const https = require('node:https');

const TUBE_LINES = [
    "bakerloo", "central", "circle", "district", "hammersmith-city", "jubilee",
    "metropolitan", "northern", "piccadilly", "victoria", "waterloo-city",
    "elizabeth", "dlr", "tram", "liberty", "lioness", "mildmay", "suffragette",
    "weaver", "windrush"
];

const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));

async function fetchAPI(url, retries = 5) {
    for (let i = 0; i <= retries; i++) {
        try {
            return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                https.get(url, {
                    headers: { 'User-Agent': 'TfLDataFetcher/1.0' }
                }, (res) => {
                    let data = '';
                    res.on('data', chunk => data += chunk);
                    res.on('end', () => {
                        if (res.statusCode === 200) {
                            try { resolve(JSON.parse(data)); } catch (e) { reject(e); }
                        } else if (res.statusCode === 429) {
                            reject(new Error('429'));
                        } else if (res.statusCode === 404) {
                            resolve(null);
                        } else {
                            reject(new Error(`HTTP ${res.statusCode} on ${url}`));
                        }
                    });
                }).on('error', reject);
            });
        } catch (e) {
            if (e.message === '429' || e.message.includes('429')) {
                if (i === retries) throw new Error(`HTTP 429 on ${url}`);
                console.log(`Rate limited on ${url}, waiting ${5000 * (i + 1)}ms...`);
                await sleep(5000 * (i + 1));
            } else {
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }
}

function isValidCoordPair(p) {
    return Array.isArray(p) && p.length === 2 && Number.isFinite(p[0]) && Number.isFinite(p[1]) && p[0] >= -90 && p[0] <= 90 && p[1] >= -180 && p[1] <= 180;
}

function isValidBranch(branch) {
    return Array.isArray(branch) && branch.length >= 2 && branch.every(isValidCoordPair);
}

function extractGeometry(routeRaw, lineId) {
    const routes = [];
    if (routeRaw && routeRaw.lineStrings) {
        routeRaw.lineStrings.forEach(ls => {
            try {
                const parsed = typeof ls === 'string' ? JSON.parse(ls) : ls;
                function extract(node) {
                    if (!node) return;
                    if (Array.isArray(node)) {
                        if (node.length > 0 && Array.isArray(node[0]) && typeof node[0][0] === 'number') {
                            const branch = node.map(p => [p[1], p[0]]);
                            if (isValidBranch(branch)) routes.push(branch);
                        } else {
                            node.forEach(extract);
                        }
                    }
                }
                extract(parsed);
            } catch (e) { console.error(`[PARSE] Failed mapping geometry on ${lineId}`); }
        });
    }
    return routes;
}

function projectPointToSegment(pLat, pLng, aLat, aLng, bLat, bLng) {
    const apx = pLng - aLng, apy = pLat - aLat;
    const abx = bLng - aLng, aby = bLat - aLat;
    const ab2 = abx * abx + aby * aby;
    if (ab2 === 0) return { lat: aLat, lng: aLng, dist: Math.hypot(apy, apx) };
    const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (apx * abx + apy * aby) / ab2));
    const projLat = aLat + aby * t;
    const projLng = aLng + abx * t;
    return { lat: projLat, lng: projLng, dist: Math.hypot(pLat - projLat, pLng - projLng) };
}

function snapToRoutes(targetLat, targetLon, routes) {
    let bestLat = targetLat, bestLng = targetLon, minDist = Infinity;
    routes.forEach(branch => {
        for (let i = 0; i < branch.length - 1; i++) {
            const [alat, alng] = branch[i];
            const [blat, blng] = branch[i + 1];
            const proj = projectPointToSegment(targetLat, targetLon, alat, alng, blat, blng);
            if (proj.dist < minDist) { minDist = proj.dist; bestLat = proj.lat; bestLng = proj.lng; }
        }
    });
    return { lat: bestLat, lon: bestLng, dist: minDist };
}

async function main() {
    const rawData = {};
    for (const lineId of TUBE_LINES) {
        console.log(`Fetching ${lineId}...`);
        try {
            const outbound = await fetchAPI(`https://api.tfl.gov.uk/Line/${lineId}/Route/Sequence/outbound`);
            await sleep(500);

            let inbound = null;
            try {
                inbound = await fetchAPI(`https://api.tfl.gov.uk/Line/${lineId}/Route/Sequence/inbound`);
            } catch (e) {
                console.warn(`Ignoring inbound failure for ${lineId}`);
            }
            await sleep(500);

            const stopsRaw = await fetchAPI(`https://api.tfl.gov.uk/Line/${lineId}/StopPoints`);
            await sleep(500);

            const routes = [
                ...extractGeometry(outbound, lineId),
                ...extractGeometry(inbound, lineId)
            ];

            const stationsMap = new Map();
            if (stopsRaw) {
                stopsRaw.forEach(s => stationsMap.set(s.naptanId, {
                    id: s.naptanId,
                    name: s.commonName.replace(/ Underground Station| Rail Station| DLR Station| Tram Stop/ig, '').trim(),
                    lat: s.lat,
                    lon: s.lon
                }));
            }

            const snappedStations = Array.from(stationsMap.values()).map(st => {
                const snapped = snapToRoutes(st.lat, st.lon, routes);
                return snapped.dist < 0.005 ? { ...st, lat: snapped.lat, lon: snapped.lon } : st;
            });

            if (routes.length > 0) {
                rawData[lineId] = { routes, stations: snappedStations };
            } else {
                console.warn(`No routes found for ${lineId}`);
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.error(`Failed ${lineId}: ${e.message}`);
        }
        await sleep(3000); // 3000ms delay between lines to avoid rate limits
    }

    const payload = {
        _version: 'tfl_diabolical_network_data_v15_truth',
        timestamp: Date.now(),
        data: rawData
    };

    fs.writeFileSync('tfl_network_data.json', JSON.stringify(payload));
    console.log('Saved tfl_network_data.json successfully!');
}

main();


/* ===== fetch_exclusions.js ===== */
const fs = require('fs');
const https = require('https');

const OVERPASS_URL = 'https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter';

// Full British Isles Bounding Box
const UK_BOUNDS = { s: 49.8, n: 61.0, w: -8.5, e: 1.8 };
const TILE_SIZE = 1.5; // degrees

function getAreaSqM(poly) {
    if (poly.length < 3) return 0;
    let area = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < poly.length - 1; i++) {
        const p1 = poly[i], p2 = poly[i+1];
        const x1 = p1[1] * 111320 * Math.cos(p1[0] * Math.PI / 180);
        const y1 = p1[0] * 111320;
        const x2 = p2[1] * 111320 * Math.cos(p2[0] * Math.PI / 180);
        const y2 = p2[0] * 111320;
        area += x1 * y2 - x2 * y1;
    }
    return Math.abs(area / 2);
}

function simplifyDP(points, epsilon) {
    if (points.length <= 2) return points;
    let maxDist = 0;
    let index = 0;
    const end = points.length - 1;
    for (let i = 1; i < end; i++) {
        const d = pointLineDistance(points[i], points[0], points[end]);
        if (d > maxDist) { maxDist = d; index = i; }
    }
    if (maxDist > epsilon) {
        const left = simplifyDP(points.slice(0, index + 1), epsilon);
        const right = simplifyDP(points.slice(index), epsilon);
        return left.slice(0, -1).concat(right);
    } else {
        return [points[0], points[end]];
    }
}

function pointLineDistance(p, a, b) {
    const area = Math.abs((b[0]-a[0])*(p[1]-a[1]) - (p[0]-a[0])*(b[1]-a[1]));
    const bottom = Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0], b[1]-a[1]);
    return bottom === 0 ? Math.hypot(p[0]-a[0], p[1]-a[1]) : area / bottom;
}

function sleep(ms) { return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); }

async function fetchTile(s, w, n, e, attempt = 1) {
    const bbox = `${s},${w},${n},${e}`;
    const query = `
        [out:json][timeout:180];
        (
          way["leisure"~"park|nature_reserve|golf_course|recreation_ground|pitch|garden"](${bbox});
          relation["leisure"~"park|nature_reserve|golf_course|recreation_ground|pitch|garden"](${bbox});
          way["natural"~"water|wood|scrub|wetland|heath|moor"](${bbox});
          relation["natural"~"water|wood|scrub|wetland|heath|moor"](${bbox});
          way["landuse"~"grass|forest|farmland|meadow|allotments|greenfield|recreation_ground|village_green|reservoir|basin"](${bbox});
          relation["landuse"~"grass|forest|farmland|meadow|allotments|greenfield|recreation_ground|village_green|reservoir|basin"](${bbox});
          way["waterway"~"riverbank|dock"](${bbox});
          relation["waterway"~"riverbank|dock"](${bbox});
        );
        out geom;
    `;
    
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const req = https.request(OVERPASS_URL, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
                'User-Agent': 'windsurf-project-transport'
            }
        }, (res) => {
            if (res.statusCode === 429) return reject(new Error('Rate Limited'));
            let data = '';
            res.on('data', chunk => data += chunk);
            res.on('end', () => {
                try {
                    const j = JSON.parse(data);
                    const polys = [];
                    if (j.elements) {
                        j.elements.forEach(el => {
                            if (el.type === 'way' && el.geometry && el.geometry.length > 2) {
                                const poly = el.geometry.map(pt => [pt.lat, pt.lon]);
                                if (getAreaSqM(poly) > 20000) polys.push(poly);
                            } else if (el.type === 'relation' && el.members) {
                                const outerWays = el.members.filter(m => m.role === 'outer' && m.geometry && m.geometry.length > 2);
                                outerWays.forEach(w => {
                                    const poly = w.geometry.map(pt => [pt.lat, pt.lon]);
                                    if (getAreaSqM(poly) > 20000) polys.push(poly);
                                });
                            }
                        });
                    }
                    resolve(polys);
                } catch (e) {
                    if (data.includes('rate_limit')) reject(new Error('Rate Limited'));
                    else resolve([]);
                }
            });
        });
        req.on('error', reject);
        req.write('data=' + encodeURIComponent(query));
        req.end();
    });
}

async function fetchAll() {
    console.log("Fetching exhaustive greenspaces for entire British Isles...");
    const allPolys = [];
    
    for (let lat = UK_BOUNDS.s; lat < UK_BOUNDS.n; lat += TILE_SIZE) {
        for (let lon = UK_BOUNDS.w; lon < UK_BOUNDS.e; lon += TILE_SIZE) {
            let success = false;
            let attempts = 0;
            const n = Math.min(lat + TILE_SIZE, UK_BOUNDS.n);
            const e = Math.min(lon + TILE_SIZE, UK_BOUNDS.e);
            
            while (!success && attempts < 3) {
                attempts++;
                try {
                    console.log(`Fetching tile [${lat.toFixed(2)}, ${lon.toFixed(2)}]...`);
                    const polys = await fetchTile(lat, lon, n, e);
                    
                    const EPSILON = 0.0003; 
                    polys.forEach(p => {
                        const simplified = simplifyDP(p, EPSILON).map(coord => [Math.round(coord[0]*10000)/10000, Math.round(coord[1]*10000)/10000]);
                        allPolys.push({ polygon: simplified });
                    });
                    
                    success = true;
                    await sleep(1000);
                } catch (err) {
                    if (err.message === 'Rate Limited') {
                        console.log("Rate limited! Waiting 30s...");
                        await sleep(30000);
                    } else {
                        success = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    if (!fs.existsSync('data')) fs.mkdirSync('data');
    fs.writeFileSync('data/greenspaces.json', JSON.stringify(allPolys));
    console.log('Saved ' + allPolys.length + ' greenspaces to data/greenspaces.json');
}

fetchAll().catch(console.error);


/* ===== fetch_greenspaces.js ===== */
const fs = require('node:fs');
const https = require('node:https');

const parks = [
    "Hyde Park, London",
    "Regent's Park, London",
    "Richmond Park, London",
    "Hampstead Heath, London",
    "Greenwich Park, London",

const greenSpaces = [];

function processNominatimResponse(data, resolve) {
    try {
        const j = JSON.parse(data);
        if (j.features && j.features.length > 0) {
            const geom = j.features[0].geometry;
            if (geom.type === 'Polygon') {
                greenSpaces.push({ polygon: geom.coordinates[0].map(c => [c[1], c[0]]) });
            } else if (geom.type === 'MultiPolygon') {
                geom.coordinates.forEach(poly => {
                    greenSpaces.push({ polygon: poly[0].map(c => [c[1], c[0]]) });
                });
            }
        }
    } catch (e) {
        console.warn('Failed to parse Nominatim response:', e);
    }
    resolve();
}

async function fetchPark(parkName) {
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const url = `https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?q=${encodeURIComponent(parkName)}&format=geojson&polygon_geojson=1&limit=1`;
        https.get(url, { headers: { 'User-Agent': 'windsurf-project-transport' } }, (res) => {
            let data = '';
            res.on('data', c => data += c);
            res.on('end', () => processNominatimResponse(data, resolve));
        }).on('error', (err) => {
            console.error('Request error:', err);
            resolve();
        });
    });
}

async function run() {
    for (const park of parks) {
        console.log(`Fetching ${park}...`);
        await fetchPark(park);
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1500)); // Respect Nominatim rate limits (1 req/sec)
    }
    
    if (!fs.existsSync('data')) fs.mkdirSync('data');
    fs.writeFileSync('data/greenspaces.json', JSON.stringify(greenSpaces));
    console.log(`Saved ${greenSpaces.length} parks to data/greenspaces.json`);
}

run();


/* ===== fetch_landuse.js ===== */
const fs = require('fs');
const https = require('https');

const BBOX = {
    minLat: 49.8,
    minLon: -8.5,
    maxLat: 60.9,
    maxLon: 1.8
};
const TILE_SIZE = 1.0; 
const OVERPASS_URL = 'https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter';

function sleep(ms) {
    return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

function fetchOverpass(query) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const req = https.request(OVERPASS_URL, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded' }
        }, res => {
            let data = '';
            res.on('data', chunk => data += chunk);
            res.on('end', () => {
                if (res.statusCode === 429) return reject(new Error('429'));
                if (res.statusCode !== 200) return reject(new Error(`HTTP ${res.statusCode}: ${data.substring(0,200)}`));
                try { resolve(JSON.parse(data)); } catch(e) { reject(e); }
            });
        });
        req.on('error', reject);
        req.write('data=' + encodeURIComponent(query));
        req.end();
    });
}

async function run() {
    console.log("Fetching land-use feasibility polygons for the UK...");
    const outData = [];
    
    for (let lat = BBOX.minLat; lat < BBOX.maxLat; lat += TILE_SIZE) {
        for (let lon = BBOX.minLon; lon < BBOX.maxLon; lon += TILE_SIZE) {
            const bboxStr = `${lat.toFixed(2)},${lon.toFixed(2)},${(lat+TILE_SIZE).toFixed(2)},${(lon+TILE_SIZE).toFixed(2)}`;
            console.log(`Fetching tile [${lat.toFixed(2)}, ${lon.toFixed(2)}]...`);
            
            const query = `
                [out:json][timeout:60];
                (
                  way["landuse"~"industrial|brownfield|commercial|retail"](${bboxStr});
                  way["amenity"~"parking"](${bboxStr});
                  way["landuse"~"residential"](${bboxStr});
                  way["leisure"~"park|recreation_ground"](${bboxStr});
                );
                out center qt;
            `;
            
            let success = false;
            while (!success) {
                try {
                    const data = await fetchOverpass(query);
                    if (data && data.elements) {
                        data.elements.forEach(el => {
                            if (el.center && el.tags) {
                                let type = 'unknown';
                                if (el.tags.landuse === 'residential') type = 'residential';
                                else if (el.tags.leisure) type = 'park';
                                else if (el.tags.landuse === 'industrial' || el.tags.landuse === 'brownfield') type = 'industrial';
                                else if (el.tags.amenity === 'parking') type = 'parking';
                                else if (el.tags.landuse) type = 'commercial';
                                
                                outData.push({
                                    lat: parseFloat(el.center.lat.toFixed(4)),
                                    lon: parseFloat(el.center.lon.toFixed(4)),
                                    t: type
                                });
                            }
                        });
                    }
                    success = true;
                    await sleep(1500); // polite delay
                } catch(e) {
                    if (e.message === '429') {
                        console.log("Rate limited! Waiting 30s...");
                        await sleep(30000);
                    } else {
                        console.error("Error:", e.message);
                        success = true; // Skip tile on bad error
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    fs.writeFileSync('data/land_feasibility.json', JSON.stringify(outData));
    console.log(`Done! Wrote ${outData.length} land-use centers.`);
}

run();


/* ===== fetch_london_residential.js ===== */
const fs = require('fs');
const https = require('https');

// Simplified Douglas-Peucker algorithm to reduce geometry
function simplifyDP(points, epsilon) {
    if (points.length < 3) return points;
    let dmax = 0;
    let index = 0;
    const end = points.length - 1;

    for (let i = 1; i < end; i++) {
        const d = perpendicularDistance(points[i], points[0], points[end]);
        if (d > dmax) {
            index = i;
            dmax = d;
        }
    }

    if (dmax > epsilon) {
        const recResults1 = simplifyDP(points.slice(0, index + 1), epsilon);
        const recResults2 = simplifyDP(points.slice(index), epsilon);
        return recResults1.slice(0, recResults1.length - 1).concat(recResults2);
    } else {
        return [points[0], points[end]];
    }
}

function perpendicularDistance(point, lineStart, lineEnd) {
    const x = point[0];
    const y = point[1];
    const x1 = lineStart[0];
    const y1 = lineStart[1];
    const x2 = lineEnd[0];
    const y2 = lineEnd[1];

    const A = x - x1;
    const B = y - y1;
    const C = x2 - x1;
    const D = y2 - y1;

    const dot = A * C + B * D;
    const len_sq = C * C + D * D;
    let param = -1;
    if (len_sq != 0) param = dot / len_sq;

    let xx, yy;
    if (param < 0) {
        xx = x1;
        yy = y1;
    } else if (param > 1) {
        xx = x2;
        yy = y2;
    } else {
        xx = x1 + param * C;
        yy = y1 + param * D;
    }

    const dx = x - xx;
    const dy = y - yy;
    return Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
}

const OVERPASS_URL = 'https://overpass.kumi.systems/api/interpreter';
// We use the same bounding box as the main map!
const bbox = '50.8,-1.6,52.5,1.2';
const EPSILON = 0.001; // ~100m simplification

const query = `
    [out:json][timeout:180];
    (
        way["landuse"="residential"](${bbox});
        relation["landuse"="residential"](${bbox});
    );
    out geom;
`;

console.log("Fetching London residential zones...");
const req = https.request(OVERPASS_URL, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 
        'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
        'User-Agent': 'windsurf-project-transport/1.0 (contact@example.com)'
    }
}, (res) => {
    let data = '';
    res.on('data', chunk => data += chunk);
    res.on('end', () => {
        try {
            const j = JSON.parse(data);
            let londonPolys = [];
            
            if (j.elements) {
                j.elements.forEach(el => {
                    if (el.type === 'way' && el.geometry) {
                        const pts = el.geometry.map(pt => [pt.lat, pt.lon]);
                        const simplified = simplifyDP(pts, EPSILON);
                        if (simplified.length > 2) londonPolys.push({ polygon: simplified });
                    } else if (el.type === 'relation' && el.members) {
                        el.members.forEach(m => {
                            if (m.type === 'way' && m.geometry) {
                                const pts = m.geometry.map(pt => [pt.lat, pt.lon]);
                                const simplified = simplifyDP(pts, EPSILON);
                                if (simplified.length > 2) londonPolys.push({ polygon: simplified });
                            }
                        });
                    }
                });
            }
            console.log(`Found ${londonPolys.length} residential polygons in London.`);
            
            const raw = fs.readFileSync('data/residential.json', 'utf8');
            const allPolys = JSON.parse(raw);
            
            // Remove any existing London polygons to avoid overlap if any existed
            const filtered = allPolys.filter(p => {
                if(!p.polygon || p.polygon.length===0) return false;
                const lat = p.polygon[0][0];
                const lon = p.polygon[0][1];
                return !(lat > 51.3 && lat < 51.7 && lon > -0.6 && lon < 0.4);
            });
            
            filtered.push(...londonPolys);
            
            fs.writeFileSync('data/residential.json', JSON.stringify(filtered));
            console.log("Successfully injected London residential data into residential.json!");
        } catch(e) {
            console.error("Failed:", e.message);
        }
    });
});

/* ===== fetch_real_tracks.js ===== */
const fs = require('fs');
const https = require('https');

const OVERPASS_URL = 'https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter';

const LINE_MAPPING = {
    "bakerloo": "Bakerloo line",
    "central": "Central line",
    "circle": "Circle line",
    "district": "District line",
    "hammersmith-city": "Hammersmith & City line",
    "jubilee": "Jubilee line",
    "metropolitan": "Metropolitan line",
    "northern": "Northern line",
    "piccadilly": "Piccadilly line",
    "victoria": "Victoria line",
    "waterloo-city": "Waterloo & City line",
    "elizabeth": "Elizabeth line",
    "dlr": "Docklands Light Railway",
    "tram": "London Tramlink",
    "liberty": "Liberty line",
    "lioness": "Lioness line",
    "mildmay": "Mildmay line",
    "suffragette": "Suffragette line",
    "weaver": "Weaver line",
    "windrush": "Windrush line"
};

async function queryOverpass(query) {
    const data = `data=${encodeURIComponent(query)}`;
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const req = https.request(OVERPASS_URL, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
                'Content-Length': data.length,
                'User-Agent': 'TfLDataFetcher/1.0'
            }
        }, (res) => {
            let body = '';
            res.on('data', chunk => body += chunk);
            res.on('end', () => {
                if (res.statusCode === 200) {
                    try { resolve(JSON.parse(body)); } catch (e) { reject(e); }
                } else {
                    reject(new Error(`Overpass API error: ${res.statusCode} ${body}`));
                }
            });
        });
        req.on('error', reject);
        req.write(data);
        req.end();
    });
}

async function getRealTracks() {
    console.log("Fetching real physical tracks from OpenStreetMap (Overpass API)...");
    
    const query = `
    [out:json][timeout:180];
    (
      relation["route"~"subway|train|tram|light_rail|railway"]["network"~"London Underground|Elizabeth line|London Overground|DLR|Docklands Light Railway|Tramlink|London Trams"];
      relation["route"~"subway|train|tram|light_rail|railway"]["operator"~"Transport for London|London Underground|DLR|Docklands Light Railway|Tramlink|MTR Elizabeth line"];
      relation["route"~"train|light_rail|subway"]["name"~"Elizabeth|DLR|Docklands"];
    );
    out body;
    >;
    out skel qt;
    `;

    try {
        const osmData = await queryOverpass(query);
        const nodes = new Map();
        osmData.elements.forEach(el => {
            if (el.type === 'node') nodes.set(el.id, [el.lat, el.lon]);
        });

        const ways = new Map();
        osmData.elements.forEach(el => {
            if (el.type === 'way') {
                const pts = el.nodes.map(nid => nodes.get(nid)).filter(p => !!p);
                ways.set(el.id, pts);
            }
        });

        const lineTracks = {};

        osmData.elements.forEach(el => {
            if (el.type === 'relation') {
                const tags = el.tags || {};
                const name = (tags.name || "").toLowerCase();
                const network = (tags.network || "").toLowerCase();
                const ref = (tags.ref || "").toLowerCase();
                const operator = (tags.operator || "").toLowerCase();
                
                let targetLineId = null;

                for (const [id, osmName] of Object.entries(LINE_MAPPING)) {
                    const lowerOsmName = osmName.toLowerCase();
                    if (name.includes(lowerOsmName) || 
                        (ref && ref.includes(lowerOsmName)) ||
                        (network && network.includes(lowerOsmName))) {
                        targetLineId = id;
                        break;
                    }
                }

                if (!targetLineId) {
                    if (network.includes("dlr") || operator.includes("dlr") || network.includes("docklands") || name.includes("dlr") || name.includes("docklands")) targetLineId = "dlr";
                    else if (network.includes("tram") || operator.includes("tram")) targetLineId = "tram";
                    else if (network.includes("elizabeth") || operator.includes("elizabeth") || name.includes("elizabeth")) targetLineId = "elizabeth";
                }

                if (!targetLineId && (network.includes("london overground") || operator.includes("overground") || network.includes("overground"))) {
                    if (name.includes("liberty")) targetLineId = "liberty";
                    else if (name.includes("lioness")) targetLineId = "lioness";
                    else if (name.includes("mildmay")) targetLineId = "mildmay";
                    else if (name.includes("suffragette")) targetLineId = "suffragette";
                    else if (name.includes("weaver")) targetLineId = "weaver";
                    else if (name.includes("windrush")) targetLineId = "windrush";
                }

                if (targetLineId) {
                    if (!lineTracks[targetLineId]) lineTracks[targetLineId] = [];
                    (el.members || []).forEach(mem => {
                        if (mem.type === 'way' && ways.has(mem.ref)) {
                            lineTracks[targetLineId].push(ways.get(mem.ref));
                        }
                    });
                }
            }
        });

        return lineTracks;
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Failed to fetch from Overpass:", e);
        return null;
    }
}

async function main() {
    const networkDataFile = 'tfl_network_data.json';
    if (!fs.existsSync(networkDataFile)) {
        console.error("tfl_network_data.json not found. Run fetch_data.js first.");
        return;
    }

    const networkData = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(networkDataFile));
    const realTracks = await getRealTracks();

    if (!realTracks) return;

    let updatedCount = 0;
    for (const lineId in networkData.data) {
        if (realTracks[lineId] && realTracks[lineId].length > 0) {
            console.log(`Injecting real physical tracks for ${lineId} (${realTracks[lineId].length} segments)`);
            networkData.data[lineId].routes = realTracks[lineId];
            updatedCount++;
        } else {
            console.warn(`No real tracks found for ${lineId}, keeping existing data.`);
        }
    }

    networkData._version = 'tfl_diabolical_network_data_v17_supreme';
    networkData.timestamp = Date.now();

    fs.writeFileSync(networkDataFile, JSON.stringify(networkData));
    console.log(`Successfully injected physical truth for ${updatedCount} lines!`);
}

main();


/* ===== fetch_residential.js ===== */
const fs = require('fs');
const https = require('https');

const OVERPASS_URL = 'https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter';

// Full British Isles Bounding Box
const UK_BOUNDS = { s: 49.8, n: 61.0, w: -8.5, e: 1.8 };
const TILE_SIZE = 1.5; // degrees

function getAreaSqM(poly) {
    if (poly.length < 3) return 0;
    let area = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < poly.length - 1; i++) {
        const p1 = poly[i], p2 = poly[i+1];
        const x1 = p1[1] * 111320 * Math.cos(p1[0] * Math.PI / 180);
        const y1 = p1[0] * 111320;
        const x2 = p2[1] * 111320 * Math.cos(p2[0] * Math.PI / 180);
        const y2 = p2[0] * 111320;
        area += x1 * y2 - x2 * y1;
    }
    return Math.abs(area / 2);
}

// Simple Douglas-Peucker to massively reduce polygon points for the browser
function simplifyDP(points, epsilon) {
    if (points.length <= 2) return points;
    let maxDist = 0;
    let index = 0;
    const end = points.length - 1;

    for (let i = 1; i < end; i++) {
        const d = pointLineDistance(points[i], points[0], points[end]);
        if (d > maxDist) { maxDist = d; index = i; }
    }

    if (maxDist > epsilon) {
        const left = simplifyDP(points.slice(0, index + 1), epsilon);
        const right = simplifyDP(points.slice(index), epsilon);
        return left.slice(0, -1).concat(right);
    } else {
        return [points[0], points[end]];
    }
}

function pointLineDistance(p, a, b) {
    const area = Math.abs((b[0]-a[0])*(p[1]-a[1]) - (p[0]-a[0])*(b[1]-a[1]));
    const bottom = Math.hypot(b[0]-a[0], b[1]-a[1]);
    return bottom === 0 ? Math.hypot(p[0]-a[0], p[1]-a[1]) : area / bottom;
}

function sleep(ms) { return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); }

async function fetchTile(s, w, n, e, attempt = 1) {
    const bbox = `${s},${w},${n},${e}`;
    const query = `
        [out:json][timeout:180];
        (
          way["landuse"~"residential|commercial|retail"](${bbox});
          relation["landuse"~"residential|commercial|retail"](${bbox});
        );
        out geom;
    `;
    
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const req = https.request(OVERPASS_URL, {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
                'User-Agent': 'windsurf-project-transport'
            }
        }, (res) => {
            if (res.statusCode === 429) {
                return reject(new Error('Rate Limited'));
            }
            let data = '';
            res.on('data', chunk => data += chunk);
            res.on('end', () => {
                try {
                    const j = JSON.parse(data);
                    const polys = [];
                    if (j.elements) {
                        j.elements.forEach(el => {
                            if (el.type === 'way' && el.geometry && el.geometry.length > 2) {
                                const poly = el.geometry.map(pt => [pt.lat, pt.lon]);
                                if (getAreaSqM(poly) > 10000) polys.push(poly);
                            } else if (el.type === 'relation' && el.members) {
                                const outerWays = el.members.filter(m => m.role === 'outer' && m.geometry && m.geometry.length > 2);
                                outerWays.forEach(w => {
                                    const poly = w.geometry.map(pt => [pt.lat, pt.lon]);
                                    if (getAreaSqM(poly) > 10000) polys.push(poly);
                                });
                            }
                        });
                    }
                    resolve(polys);
                } catch (e) {
                    if (data.includes('rate_limit')) reject(new Error('Rate Limited'));
                    else resolve([]); // Empty or corrupt, skip to avoid crashing the whole process
                }
            });
        });
        req.on('error', reject);
        req.write('data=' + encodeURIComponent(query));
        req.end();
    });
}

async function fetchAll() {
    console.log("Fetching exhaustive residential areas for entire British Isles...");
    const allPolys = [];
    
    for (let lat = UK_BOUNDS.s; lat < UK_BOUNDS.n; lat += TILE_SIZE) {
        for (let lon = UK_BOUNDS.w; lon < UK_BOUNDS.e; lon += TILE_SIZE) {
            let success = false;
            let attempts = 0;
            const n = Math.min(lat + TILE_SIZE, UK_BOUNDS.n);
            const e = Math.min(lon + TILE_SIZE, UK_BOUNDS.e);
            
            while (!success && attempts < 3) {
                attempts++;
                try {
                    console.log(`Fetching tile [${lat.toFixed(2)}, ${lon.toFixed(2)}]...`);
                    const polys = await fetchTile(lat, lon, n, e);
                    
                    // Simplify polygons heavily (approx 25 meters epsilon) to prevent browser crash
                    const EPSILON = 0.0002; 
                    polys.forEach(p => {
                        const simplified = simplifyDP(p, EPSILON).map(coord => [Math.round(coord[0]*10000)/10000, Math.round(coord[1]*10000)/10000]);
                        allPolys.push({ polygon: simplified });
                    });
                    
                    success = true;
                    await sleep(1000); // polite delay
                } catch (err) {
                    if (err.message === 'Rate Limited') {
                        console.log("Rate limited! Waiting 30s...");
                        await sleep(30000);
                    } else {
                        console.error("Error fetching tile:", err.message);
                        success = true; // Skip tile on unrecoverable error
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    if (!fs.existsSync('data')) fs.mkdirSync('data');
    fs.writeFileSync('data/residential.json', JSON.stringify(allPolys));
    console.log('Saved ' + allPolys.length + ' residential areas to data/residential.json');
}

fetchAll().catch(console.error);


/* ===== fetch_roads.js ===== */
const fs = require('fs');

async function fetchRoads() {
    const query = `
        [out:json][timeout:25];
        (
          way["highway"~"motorway|trunk|primary"](51.3,-0.5,51.7,0.3);
        );
        out geom;
    `;
    console.log("Fetching primary roads...");
    const res = await fetch('https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
            'User-Agent': 'windsurf-project/1.0'
        },
        body: "data=" + encodeURIComponent(query)
    });
    
    const text = await res.text();
    if (!text.startsWith('{')) {
        console.error("Not JSON:", text.substring(0, 200));
        return;
    }
    const data = JSON.parse(text);
    
    const paths = data.elements.map(e => e.geometry.map(pt => [pt.lat, pt.lon]));
    
    fs.writeFileSync('data/roads.json', JSON.stringify(paths));
    console.log(`Saved ${paths.length} road segments to data/roads.json`);
}

/* ===== fetch_thameslink.js ===== */
const fs = require('fs');
const https = require('https');

const OVERPASS_URL = 'https://overpass.kumi.systems/api/interpreter';
const LONDON_BBOX = '51.2,-0.6,51.8,0.4';

const query = `
    [out:json][timeout:180];
    (
      relation["network"~"Thameslink"](${LONDON_BBOX});
      way["ref"="BML1"](${LONDON_BBOX});
    );
    out geom;
`;

console.log("Fetching Thameslink & BML1 geometry from Overpass...");

const req = https.request(OVERPASS_URL, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
        'User-Agent': 'windsurf-project-transport'
    }
}, (res) => {
    let data = '';
    res.on('data', chunk => data += chunk);
    res.on('end', () => {
        try {
            const j = JSON.parse(data);
            const nodes = {};
            if (j.elements) {
                j.elements.forEach(el => {
                    if (el.type === 'node') {
                        nodes[el.id] = { lat: el.lat, lon: el.lon };
                    }
                });

                let rawTracks = [];
                let stations = [];
                
                j.elements.forEach(el => {
                    if (el.type === 'way' && el.geometry) {
                        const coords = el.geometry.map(g => [g.lat, g.lon]);
                        if (coords.length > 1) rawTracks.push(coords);
                    } else if (el.type === 'node' && el.tags && (el.tags.railway === 'station' || el.tags.railway === 'halt')) {
                        stations.push({
                            id: 'tl_' + el.id,
                            name: el.tags.name || 'Unknown',
                            lat: el.lat,
                            lon: el.lon
                        });
                    } else if (el.type === 'relation' && el.members) {
                        el.members.forEach(m => {
                            if (m.type === 'way' && m.geometry) {
                                const coords = m.geometry.map(g => [g.lat, g.lon]);
                                if (coords.length > 1) rawTracks.push(coords);
                            } else if (m.type === 'node' && m.role === 'stop') {
                                stations.push({
                                    id: 'tl_' + m.ref,
                                    name: 'Thameslink Station',
                                    lat: m.lat,
                                    lon: m.lon
                                });
                            }
                        });
                    }
                });

                console.log(`Found ${rawTracks.length} track segments and ${stations.length} stations for Thameslink.`);

                const raw = fs.readFileSync('tfl_network_data.json', 'utf8');
                const payload = JSON.parse(raw);
                const ndata = payload.data || payload;

                ndata.thameslink = {
                    name: "Thameslink",
                    color: "#e6007e", // TfL Thameslink Pink
                    routes: rawTracks,
                    stations: stations
                };

                fs.writeFileSync('tfl_network_data.json', JSON.stringify(payload));
                console.log("Successfully injected Thameslink & BML1 into the map!");
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.error("Failed:", e.message);
        }
    });
});
req.on('error', console.error);
req.write('data=' + encodeURIComponent(query));
req.end();
