/* ===== patch_overground.js ===== */
/**
 * patch_overground.js — One-time script to fetch high-fidelity physical track geometry
 * for the 3 missing Overground lines (Suffragette, Weaver, Windrush) from OpenStreetMap
 * and patch them into tfl_network_data.json
 */

const https = require('https');
const fs = require('fs');

const OVERGROUND_LINES = {
    suffragette: {
        name: "Suffragette",
        color: "#18A95D",
        // Gospel Oak to Barking Riverside
        searchTerms: ["gospel oak", "barking riverside", "suffragette", "gospel oak to barking"]
    },
    weaver: {
        name: "Weaver",
        color: "#9B0058",
        // Liverpool Street to Cheshunt/Enfield Town/Chingford
        searchTerms: ["liverpool street", "cheshunt", "enfield town", "chingford", "weaver"]
    },
    windrush: {
        name: "Windrush",
        color: "#DC241F",
        // Highbury & Islington to Clapham Junction / Crystal Palace / New Cross / West Croydon
        searchTerms: ["east london", "windrush", "highbury", "clapham junction", "crystal palace", "new cross", "west croydon"]
    }
};

function httpPost(url, bodyStr) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const parsed = new URL(url);
        const postData = bodyStr;
        const options = {
            hostname: parsed.hostname,
            port: 443,
            path: parsed.pathname + parsed.search,
            method: 'POST',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=UTF-8',
                'Content-Length': Buffer.byteLength(postData, 'utf8'),
                'Accept': 'application/json',
                'User-Agent': 'OvergroundPatcher/1.0'
            }
        };
        const req = https.request(options, (res) => {
            let data = '';
            res.on('data', chunk => data += chunk);
            res.on('end', () => {
                if (res.statusCode !== 200) {
                    reject(new Error(`HTTP ${res.statusCode}: ${data.substring(0, 200)}`));
                } else {
                    try { resolve(JSON.parse(data)); }
                    catch(e) { reject(new Error('JSON parse failed: ' + data.substring(0, 100))); }
                }
            });
        });
        req.on('error', reject);
        req.write(postData);
        req.end();
    });
}

function httpGet(url) {
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        https.get(url, (res) => {
            let data = '';
            res.on('data', chunk => data += chunk);
            res.on('end', () => {
                if (res.statusCode !== 200) reject(new Error(`HTTP ${res.statusCode}`));
                else resolve(JSON.parse(data));
            });
        }).on('error', reject);
    });
}

async function fetchOverpassGeometry(lineId, lineDef) {
    console.log(`\n[${lineId.toUpperCase()}] Fetching physical track geometry from OpenStreetMap...`);

    // Strategy: Fetch the OSM route relations for London Overground that match this line
    const query = `
        [out:json][timeout:60];
        (
          relation["type"="route"]["route"~"train|railway"]["network"~"London Overground|National Rail"]["name"~"${lineDef.name}",i];
          relation["type"="route"]["route"~"train|railway"]["colour"="${lineDef.color}"];
          relation["type"="route"]["route"~"train|railway"]["ref"~"${lineDef.name}",i];
        );
        (._;>;);
        out body;
    `;

    const body = 'data=' + encodeURIComponent(query);
    let data;
    try {
        data = await httpPost('https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter', body);
    } catch (e) {
        console.log(`  [WARN] Primary query failed: ${e.message}. Trying broader search...`);
        // Fallback: broader query using the Overground operator
        const fallbackQuery = `
            [out:json][timeout:60];
            relation["type"="route"]["route"~"train"]["operator"~"London Overground|Arriva Rail London"]["name"~"${lineDef.name}",i];
            (._;>;);
            out body;
        `;
        data = await httpPost('https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter', 'data=' + encodeURIComponent(fallbackQuery));
    }

    if (!data || !data.elements || data.elements.length === 0) {
        console.log(`  [WARN] No OSM route relation found for ${lineDef.name}. Using station-chain approach...`);
        return null;
    }

    // Parse nodes
    const nodes = {};
    data.elements.forEach(el => {
        if (el.type === 'node') nodes[el.id] = [el.lat, el.lon];
    });

    // Parse ways into coordinate arrays
    const ways = data.elements
        .filter(el => el.type === 'way' && el.nodes)
        .map(way => ({
            id: way.id,
            coords: way.nodes.map(nid => nodes[nid]).filter(n => n),
            tags: way.tags || {}
        }))
        .filter(w => w.coords.length > 1);

    console.log(`  Found ${ways.length} track ways from OSM relations.`);

    if (ways.length === 0) return null;

    // Chain consecutive ways into branches
    const branches = chainWays(ways);
    console.log(`  Chained into ${branches.length} physical branches.`);
    
    return branches;
}

function chainWays(ways) {
    // Build an adjacency map to chain ways end-to-end
    const used = new Set();
    const branches = [];
    const PREC = 5;
    const round = v => v.toFixed(PREC);
    const key = c => `${round(c[0])},${round(c[1])}`;

    // Index way endpoints
    const endpointMap = {};
    ways.forEach((w, idx) => {
        const start = key(w.coords[0]);
        const end = key(w.coords[w.coords.length - 1]);
        if (!endpointMap[start]) endpointMap[start] = [];
        if (!endpointMap[end]) endpointMap[end] = [];
        endpointMap[start].push({ idx, end: 'start' });
        endpointMap[end].push({ idx, end: 'end' });
    });

    for (let i = 0; i < ways.length; i++) {
        if (used.has(i)) continue;
        used.add(i);
        let chain = [...ways[i].coords];

        // Extend forward
        let extended = true;
        while (extended) {
            extended = false;
            const tailKey = key(chain[chain.length - 1]);
            const candidates = (endpointMap[tailKey] || []).filter(c => !used.has(c.idx));
            if (candidates.length > 0) {
                const c = candidates[0];
                used.add(c.idx);
                const w = ways[c.idx];
                if (c.end === 'start') {
                    chain = chain.concat(w.coords.slice(1));
                } else {
                    chain = chain.concat([...w.coords].reverse().slice(1));
                }
                extended = true;
            }
        }

        // Extend backward
        extended = true;
        while (extended) {
            extended = false;
            const headKey = key(chain[0]);
            const candidates = (endpointMap[headKey] || []).filter(c => !used.has(c.idx));
            if (candidates.length > 0) {
                const c = candidates[0];
                used.add(c.idx);
                const w = ways[c.idx];
                if (c.end === 'end') {
                    chain = w.coords.concat(chain.slice(1));
                } else {
                    chain = [...w.coords].reverse().concat(chain.slice(1));
                }
                extended = true;
            }
        }

        if (chain.length > 5) {
            branches.push(chain);
        }
    }

    return branches;
}

async function fetchStationsFromTfL(lineId) {
    console.log(`  Fetching stations from TfL API...`);
    try {
        const data = await httpGet(`https://api.tfl.gov.uk/Line/${lineId}/StopPoints`);
        if (!Array.isArray(data)) return [];
        return data
            .filter(s => s.naptanId && s.lat && s.lon)
            .map(s => ({
                id: s.naptanId,
                name: s.commonName.replace(/ Underground Station| Rail Station| DLR Station| Tram Stop| Overground Station/ig, '').trim(),
                lat: s.lat,
                lon: s.lon
            }));
    } catch (e) {
        console.log(`  [WARN] TfL StopPoints failed: ${e.message}`);
        return [];
    }
}

async function main() {
    console.log("=== OVERGROUND PHYSICAL TRUTH PATCHER ===\n");

    // Load existing data
    const filePath = 'tfl_network_data.json';
    let existing;
    try {
        existing = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf8'));
    } catch (e) {
        console.error(`Cannot read ${filePath}: ${e.message}`);
        process.exit(1);
    }

    const data = existing.data || existing;
    let patched = 0;

    for (const [lineId, lineDef] of Object.entries(OVERGROUND_LINES)) {
        try {
            // Get physical track from Overpass
            let routes = await fetchOverpassGeometry(lineId, lineDef);

            // Get stations from TfL
            const stations = await fetchStationsFromTfL(lineId);
            console.log(`  ${stations.length} stations from TfL.`);

            if (!routes || routes.length === 0) {
                // Last resort: connect station dots in order
                if (stations.length > 1) {
                    console.log(`  Using station coordinates as fallback geometry.`);
                    routes = [stations.map(s => [s.lat, s.lon])];
                } else {
                    console.log(`  [ERROR] No geometry available for ${lineId}. Skipping.`);
                    continue;
                }
            }

            // Count total coordinate points
            const totalPts = routes.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.length, 0);
            console.log(`  Total coordinate points: ${totalPts}`);

            data[lineId] = { routes, stations };
            patched++;
            console.log(`  [OK] ${lineDef.name} patched successfully.`);

            // Small delay between lines to avoid Overpass rate limiting
            await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2000));

        } catch (e) {
            console.error(`  [ERROR] Failed to patch ${lineId}: ${e.message}`);
        }
    }

    // Save
    if (patched > 0) {
        const output = existing._version
            ? { ...existing, data, timestamp: Date.now() }
            : data;
        fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(output));
        console.log(`\n=== DONE. Patched ${patched} lines into ${filePath} (${(fs.statSync(filePath).size / 1024 / 1024).toFixed(2)} MB) ===`);
    } else {
        console.log("\n=== No lines patched. ===");
    }
}

main().catch(e => console.error("Fatal:", e));

];

    const raw = fs.readFileSync('tfl_network_data.json', 'utf8');
    const payload = JSON.parse(raw);
    const data = payload.data || payload;

    // 1. Add Old Oak Common to Elizabeth Line
    if (data.elizabeth && !data.elizabeth.stations.some(s => s.id === 'ooc_2040')) {
        data.elizabeth.stations.push(OOC_STATION);
        console.log("Added Old Oak Common to Elizabeth Line.");
    }

    // 2. Add Old Oak Common to Mildmay Line (Overground)
    if (data.mildmay && !data.mildmay.stations.some(s => s.id === 'ooc_2040')) {
        data.mildmay.stations.push(OOC_STATION);
        console.log("Added Old Oak Common to Mildmay Line.");
    }

    if (data.tram && !data.tram.stations.some(s => s.id === 'tram_sutton')) {
        data.tram.routes.push(SUTTON_ROUTE);
        data.tram.stations.push(...SUTTON_STATIONS);
        console.log("Added Sutton Tramlink Extension to Tramlink.");
    }

    // Save
    fs.writeFileSync('tfl_network_data.json', JSON.stringify(payload));
    console.log("Successfully injected TfL 2040 Additional Plans!");
}

/* ===== remove_bakerloo_lch.js ===== */
const fs = require('fs');

const raw = fs.readFileSync('tfl_network_data.json', 'utf8');
const payload = JSON.parse(raw);
const data = payload.data || payload;

if (data.bakerloo) {
    // Remove the BLE routes (those going south of Elephant & Castle)
    data.bakerloo.routes = data.bakerloo.routes.filter(r => {
        if (!r || r.length === 0) return false;
        // Check if route contains Hayes (approx lat < 51.48 and lon < 0)
        // Actually, just check if it contains any of the BLE stations
        return !r.some(pt => pt[0] < 51.49); // E&C is 51.494. The BLE goes south.
    });
    
    // Also keep the main Bakerloo routes that go south to E&C
    // Wait, E&C is 51.4943. Waterloo is 51.503. So normal Bakerloo doesn't go below 51.49.
    
    data.bakerloo.stations = data.bakerloo.stations.filter(s => !s.id.startsWith("ble_"));
    
    fs.writeFileSync('tfl_network_data.json', JSON.stringify(payload));
    console.log("Successfully removed Bakerloo Extension from default dataset!");
}

/* ===== test_reconstruct.js ===== */
const q = `[out:json][timeout:10];
area["name"="Greater London"]->.a;
relation(area.a)["admin_level"="8"]["boundary"="administrative"];
out geom;`;

fetch('https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: 'data=' + encodeURIComponent(q),
    headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded',
        'User-Agent': 'windsurf-project-test/1.0'
    }
})
.then(r => r.json())
.then(data => {
    let validCount = 0;
    data.elements.forEach(el => {
        const members = el.members || [];
        const outerWays = members.filter(m => m.role === 'outer' && m.geometry && m.geometry.length > 0);
        if (outerWays.length === 0) return;

        const ways = outerWays.map(w => w.geometry.map(pt => [pt.lat, pt.lon]));
        const result = [...ways[0]];
        const used = new Set([0]);
        let currentEnd = result.at(-1);
        const EPS = 0.00005;

        let safety = 0;
        while (used.size < ways.length && safety++ < ways.length * 3) {
            let found = false;
            for (let i = 0; i < ways.length; i++) {
                if (used.has(i)) continue;
                const way = ways[i];
                const first = way[0];
                const last = way[way.length - 1];

                if (Math.hypot(first[0] - currentEnd[0], first[1] - currentEnd[1]) < EPS) {
                    result.push(...way.slice(1));
                    currentEnd = way[way.length - 1];
                    used.add(i);
                    found = true;
                    break;
                } else if (Math.hypot(last[0] - currentEnd[0], last[1] - currentEnd[1]) < EPS) {
                    const reversed = [...way].reverse();
                    result.push(...reversed.slice(1));
                    currentEnd = reversed.at(-1);
                    used.add(i);
                    found = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!found) break;
        }
        
        console.log(`${el.tags.name}: ways=${ways.length}, used=${used.size}, polygonSize=${result.length}`);
        if (result.length > 0) validCount++;
    });
    console.log("Total valid polygons reconstructed:", validCount);
})
.catch(console.error);
